bsgyur ba mi legs so//lnga pa rigs pa dang 'gal ba'i dmigs bsal ni/ gzhal bya yin yang gzhal bya min/ /cha ldad yin yang cha ldan min/ /gcig nyid yin yang gcig nyid min/ /sna tshogs gzigs khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /gsal ba'i gzugs su snang zhing rjes dpags kyi tshad mas rtogs bya'i yul du gyur pa'i phyir gzhal bya yin yang ngo bo mi gsal zhing mchog dam pa'i don nyid —mngon sum gyis rtogs bya'i yul du ma gyur pa'i phyir gzhal bya ma yin pa dang / sa la sogs pa ji snyed pa'i gzugs yin pas cha ldan yin yang /dam pa'i bdag nyid kyi ngo bo ni cha dang bral bas cha ldan min no/ /tshangs pa'i gzugs rtag pa gcig pu nyid yin yang / yongs su 'gyur ba sna tshogs yod pa'i phyir gcig pu nyid min ba yang ste/de lta bu sna tshogs pa'i gzugs can brtan g.yo kun gyi rang bzhin tshangs pa chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa 'di ni gzhi gcig tshangs pa'i steng du gzhal bya yin min sogs gnyis ka tshang ba 'di lta du gnas skabs su rig pas dpyad na 'gal ba ltar snang yang / tshangs pa dam pa'i gzugs sna tshogs rnam pa thams cad par gsal bar byed pa'i skabs yin pas na skyon med pa'o//'dir brjod don dang phyag bya ba'i yul bod 'grel mang por lha dbang phyug yin par bshad pa ni nor ba ste/ rgya 'grel nas tshangs pa kho nar bshad do//drug pa lung dang 'gal ba'i dmigs bsal ni/ skya bseng du lnga dag gi ni//chung ma lnga len bu mo ste//dag pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur//'di 'dra 678

lha yi sgrub byed do//'di ni sngon byung gi lo rgyus las rtogs shing shes par bya dgos pas/ de yang 'di ltar thos te/ g.yul ngor brtad pa dang /'jigs sde dang / srid spub dang / lhar bcas dang / rigs med de/ skya bseng bu lngar grags pa'i pha rgyal po skya bseng de nyid ri dwags la chas pa dang /de'i tshe drang srong ngan 'dul zhes bya ba zhig ri dwags kyi gzugs su gyur nas ri dwags mo dang lhan cig 'dod pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong bar gyur pa na/ skya bseng gis ngo ma shes te mdas brtsan pa dang / de'i rjes thogs nyid la drang srong de rang gi gzugs su gnas te/ khro ba'i dbang gis ji ltar khyod kyis nga dga' ba spyod pa na/dga' ba nyams su ma spyong ba nyid du 'jig rten gzhan du 'gro bar 'gyur bar byas pas khyod kyang de bzhin du 'chi bar gyur cig ces dmod pa btab bo//drang srong gi chung mas kyang shing gi phung po chen po'i steng du 'dzegs te/khyod kyi chung ma yang khyod shi nas bsreg pa'i shing brtsis pa la 'dzegs par gyur cig ces dmod pa'i tshig smras so//skya bseng la ma dri dang kun dī zhes bya ba'i chung ma gnyis yod pa dang /rgyal po dmod pa'i 'jigs pas de dang lhan cig spyod par byed ma nus so/ de'i tshe kun dris bsam pa/ ngas ni drang srong gnas ngan las rig sngags thob la/ de'i nga'i mngon par 'dod pa gcig ni bsgrubs zin mod kyi/des ni da dung yang lad bzhi'i bar du 'dod pa'i don byed par 'gyur gyis/gal te rgyul pos gnang na de'i tshe ngas du skyed pa'i bya ba bya'o snyam mo/ /rgyal po yang thabs gang gis nga la du yod par 'gyur snyam du sems so//de nas dben par song ste rgyal po la don de smras 679

pa dang /de thos pas rgyal po dga' ste/de la rjes su gnang ba byin no//de khang par zhugs nas rig sngags bzlas nas chos zhes bya ba'i lha nga dang spyad pa'i phyir shog cig ces smras pa dang /ji tsam na chos 'ongs te de dang lhan cig 'dus pa las g.yul ngor brtan pa zhes bya ba'i du skyes so/ /de bzhin du rlung lha bkug ste 'dus pa las 'jigs sde'o//de bzhin du brgya byin bkug ste 'dus pa las srid spub skyes so/ /ji tsam na ma dri bu med pas mya ngad gyis yid gdungs te/ nga ni 'chi bar bya'o zhes smras zhing mya ngan byed la/zhum pa'i tshig gis kun dī la gsol ba btab pa/rig sngags de nga la lan cig byin cig gal te bdag la yang bu skye bar 'gyur ro zhes smras pa dang /de skya bseng la dris te rig sngags de byin no//des kyang rig sngags bzlas nas lha'i sman pa tha skar spun gnyis bkug ste/de gnyis dang 'dus pa las lhar bcas dang / na ku la zhes bya ba gnyis mtshe mar dus gcig tu skyes so/ /ji tsam na skya bseng gis sa chen po las rgyal bar byas te yul 'khor srung la byin nas/bdag nyid dang /chung ma gnyis dang /bu yang khyer te/ri bo rtse mo brgya par song nas tshangs par spyod pa brtson par gnas pa na/ de yun ring por tshangs par spyod pa spyad pa dang / ma dri'i gzugs sdug pa mthong bas 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyes te/ kho bo shi ba ni bla'i 'di dang lhan cig dga' ba nye bar longs mi spyod pa ni de lta ma yin no snyam nas de dang lhan cig tu spyod par brtsams pa dang / de'i tshe nyid dus las 'das par gyur to/ /ji tsam da bste gnas de na drang srong chen po gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad sdug bsngal bar mthong bas 680

mgon med par gyur pa'i ro dang / ma dri dang /kun dī dang bu lnga po ba te yul 'khor srung gi gan du phyin nas/de dang ji ltar 'tsham pa'i bsreg shing brtsigs te/ bsnyen bkur chen pos steng du bzhag nas skya bseng la yul 'khor srung gis mchod do//ma dris kyang bu gnyis kun dī la gtad de/ro bsregs sar bdag nyid dor ro//de nas ji tsam na 'thab dka' la sogs pa dang / g.yul ngor brtan pa la sogs pa 'phong slob pa'i gnas su lhan cig tshogs te/ kri pa dang kro na la sogs pa'i mtshon cha'i thabs kyi rig pa slob pa nas/rna can las 'khon gcugs su gyur te/skya bseng gi du lnga rgya skyegs kyi khang par bcug pa dang /de nas mtshan mo bros nas srin po nyi dim pa bsad te/de'i sring mo 'jigs sdes blangs nas de las bu dum skra zhes bya ba skyes so//de nas song ste grong khyer 'khor lo gcig par song ba dang / de'i lam khar rgyas pa dang phrad nas da dugs phyung ste/ rgyal srid dang chung ma thob pa'i mchog byin to//de nas grong khyer der phyin nas bram ze zhig gi khyim du lo bzhi 'dug ste/de la phan par bya ba'i phyir srin po chu skyar zhes bya ba bsad nas grong khyer lnga len du song ste/rgyal po rnams bud med bdam pa'i skabs su/dro pa dī zhes bya ba'i chung ma thob pa dang / spun lngas spyir blangs nas lo gcig 'dug ste/ dbang po'i gnas zhes bya bar song nas rgyal srid thob bo/ /zhes grags so/ /de ltar na chung ma gcig la skyes pa mang pos thun mong du longs spyad na/ dud med de 'chol bar 'byung zhes rig byed kyi lung las bshad pa'i nyes pa 'gyur ngam zhe na mi 'byung ste/ chung ma dro pa dī de bdag po'i brtul zhugs can rnams las 681

mchog tu gyur cing / skya bseng bu lnga po ni bshad zen ma thag pa'i lo rgyus las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhid lha'i rigs su gyur pas/lha de rnams kyi mthu ni sus kyang bsam pa dang gzhal bar mi nus pa'i phyir/phal pa rnams kyi spyod yul las yongs su 'das pas chung ma dro pa dī de rgyal po skya bseng gi bu spun lngas thun mong du longs spyad pa de lta na'ang 'chol bar mi 'gyur bar ma zad/ dag cing gtsang ba rnams kyi'ang mchog tu 'gyur te lha'i mthu'am lha'i sgrub byed kyis so//zhes chung ma dag pa'i spub byed du lha'i mthu bkod pa 'di lta bu ni rigs pa'am grub mtha' dang 'gal ba ltar snang mod kyang / lha'i mthu gsal bar byed pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir skyon med par bsams nas 'dir dper brjod pa'o//de yang de dag la mchog tu 'dzin pa'i phyi rol pa rnams kyi bsam pa'i dbang du byas nas dper brjod pa yin mod/ /yang dag par na skyon du ci'i phyir mi 'gyur te nges par 'gyur bas/ slob dpon mtho btsun grub rjes khyad par 'phags bstod du/skya bseng bu ni brjod byas na//bsod nams 'gyur zhes so sor smra//gang zhig bgrod min bgrod byed pa//de rnams khyod kyi bstan la smad//ces dang / 'di thad kyi 'grel par/slob dpon shes rab go chas/de ltar na skya bseng gi bu de rnams kyi ming brjod pa byas pas kyang bsod nams chen po bsags pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro//zhes so so skye bo dag smra'o zhes 'jig rten na thos so/ /de yang / mkhas pa skya bseng rnams kyi ni/ /ming ni bzung ba tsam gyis kyang / /bsod nams che dang ldan par ni/ /'gyur ba nyid du the tshom med//ces zer ba yin no//brjod byas na zhes bya ba ni kun 682

tu brjod cing ming 'dzin la de dang ldan pa'i gtam brjod par zhes bya ba'i don no//gang brjod pas she na/skya bseng bu ni zhes bya ba smos te/rgyal po skya bseng gi bu yin pas na skya bseng gi bu ste/ g.yul ngor brtan pa la sogs pa'o/ /bsod nams 'gyur zhes bya ba ni bsod nams la sogs la 'gyur ro zhes rgyas par smra'o/ /ci thams cad kyi brjod pa'am/ 'on te re re'i brjod pas she na/ so so'i zhes bya ba smos te re re nas zhes bya ba'i don no//gang zhig bgrod min bgrod byed pa//zhes bya ba la/spun zla'i chung ma ni bgrod par bya ba ma yin pa ste/ de la gang zhig bgrod pa de dag ni khyed kyi brtan pa la shin tu mad pa yin pas na de dag ni bgrod min bgrod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de lta bu'i rgyu mtshan ma go bar 'dir lung dang 'gal zhes pa'i lung de khyad par 'phags bstod kyi lung 'di nyid la ngos 'dzin pa ni mi 'thad de/'di ni mu stegs byed rnams kyi grub mtha'i skyon gang yin pa de rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rid po che dang 'gal ba'i khyad par brjod nas bstod pa yin pa'i phyir/de nu stegs pa'i lung du ga la 'gyur zhing / des na 'di dang 'gal ba tsam skabs 'di'i lung dang 'gal bar bzhag mi rung ste/de lta na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos rnams dang mi mthun pa'i phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' thams cad der 'gyur bar de rnams nyid kyis kyang 'dod dgos par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na lung dang 'gal rgyu ni skya bseng bu lngas thun mong du longs spyad kyang dud med 'chol bar mi 'gyur/zhes brjod pa 'di rig byed nas bshad pa'i lung dang 'gal ba'o//683

gsum pa snyan ngag gi mtshan nyid spyi'i don bsdu ba ni/sgra don rgyan ni bkra ba dang / /bya sga bya dka' dag gi lam/ /snyan ngag rnams kyi yon tan skyon/ /de lhar mdor bsdus rab tu bstan/ /snyan ngag gi lus rnam par mdzes par byed pa sgra'i rgyan dang / don gyi rgyan dag gi bye brag rnam par bkra ba sna tshogs pa dang /rtsom pa bde bas bya sla ba dang /de las ldog pa bya dka' ba dang / zung ldan gyi khyad par la sogs pa'i snyan ngag gi lam rnams dang /de rnams kyi yon tan dang skyon gyi khyad par dang /gzhan yang sbyar ba la sogs pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan ji ltar sbyor ba'i tshul rnams de ltar brjod zin pa'i rnam pas sngar thog mar dam bcas pa de ji lha ba bzhid du mdor bsdus nas bstan cing rtogs par byas so//

snyan ngag shes ba'i phan yon/gsum pa snyan ngag shes pa'i phan yon di/ spub byed bstan pa'i lam 'dis skyon dang yon tan dag /rab tu rtogs pa'i blo can skal bzang dbang gyur pa'i/ /tshig dang mngon par 'grogs byas chang mig ma dag dang //lang tsho can bzhin dga' dang grags pa thob par 'gyur//snyan ngag gi rgyan ji ltar sbyor ba'i tshul lam snyan ngag gi mtshan nyid sgrub par byed pa'i cho ga bstad pa'i lam 'dis snyan ngag dang 'brel ba'i spang bya skyod dang blang bya yon tan dag rab tu rtogs pa'i blo gros can gyi mkhas pa/tshul bzhin legs par rtogs shing shes pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dbang du gyur pa gang de la sbyor ba skyod dang bral zhing legs pa'i yon tan gyi dpal thams cad dang ldan pas mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog par nus pa'i snyan ngag gi tshig phun sum tshogs pa dag rang gi blo las ngang gis 'byung zhing de dang nam yang 'bral med du 'grogs pas snying la dga' ba dang /de lha bu'i grags pa yon tan gyi sgo das skye bo mang pos thos pa dang de thams cad kyang shin tu yid 'phrog cing smon pa thob par 'gyur ba ni/ji ltar chang mig ma ste chang gis myos pa'i mig ltar zim bur ba lta ba'i mdzes ma dag dang /skyes phran lang tsho'i dang po la babs pa dag gsar du 'grogs pa bzhin du snying la dga' ba dang gzhan la grags pa thob par 'gyur zhes pa 'di ni gnas skabs 'jig rten na ji ltar grags pa tsam gyi dbang du byas pas mtshon nas/ gzhan yang 'dul ba gzhir/ bram ze zhig 685

gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la/gser gyi mdog can mig tu sdug pa dang //sogs tshigs su bcad pa'i snyan ngag gis bstod pas/dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bskal pa nyi shur log par ltung bar 'gro bar mi 'gyur te/'on kyang lha dang mi rnams su nying mtshams sbyar zhing 'khor nas srid pa phyi ma/skye gnas phyi ma dang /lus phyi ma dang /bdag gi ngo bo thob pa phyi ma la rang sangs rgyas bstod 'os zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pas dge slong dmas the tshom skyes nas slar yang de'i rgyu zhus pas/ da ltar 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi ji ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang / bā rā ṇa ka'i rgyal po tshangs sbyin zhes bya ba snyan ngag la lhag par dga' ba zhig gi bzhon pa glang po cher nga nyid gyur pa'i tshe na'ang /'di bram ze snyan ngag mkhan zhig tu gyur pas/ sa srung bu yi lus kyi sha tshugs ltar/ /sogs tshigs su bcad pas bzhon pa glang po'i dam pa la mngon par bstod par gyur to//de'i tshe de'i dus kyi glang po che dam pa gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no/ /bram ze gang yin pa de ni bram ze 'di nyid yin te/rgyal pos grong khyer gyi mchog lnga yang de'i tshe de la byin par gyur to/ /zhes 'byung ba dang / sngar le'u dang por yang bshad zin pa ltar byang chub tu sems skyed cing yul dam pa la snyan ngag gi tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa ni mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyur yang nges par 'gyur na/lhag ma sde gsum gyi 'bras bu mtha' dag ci dgar 'byung ba lha smos kyang ci dgos pas blo ldan rnams kyis 'bad pas don du gnyer bar bya'o//zhes slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa'i rgyan gyi bstan bcos snyad ngag gi me long las bya dka'i 686

rnam par bcad pa ste le'u gsum pa'i don rab tu zu ba rdzogs so/ /'dir bkod pa'i gzhung tshig gi 'gyur ni shong 'gyur rtsa ba la dpang lo chen pos cung zad bcos pa dag dang / dus phyis zha lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang pos kyang 'gyur bcos cung zad mdzad pa bzhin skyogs ston rin chen bkra shis kyi phyag bris ma ngo ma skad gnyis shan sbyar la phyi mor mdzad de gdan sa chen po dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor du par la sngar nas 'khod zin pa nyid la sgar yang rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu 'brug lor 'jam mgon kun mkhyen bla mas rgya dpe gnyis dang bstun nas/ rgya skad la zhus dag dang / bod skad la'ang mi bcos ka med rnams —par la 'chos skyor gnang ba rnams dang / gzhung 'di'i lngags bshad kho bo la snga phyir bka' drin du stsal ba'i ba su rgya 'grel gnyis kyi dgongs don dang bstun nas 'phral 'phral 'gyur bcos gnang ba rnams zin bris su btab nas bkod pa yid no/ / —687

mjug byang /de ltar rmad byung grags pa'i gter gyur mkhas pa rnams kyi smra ba'i sgo/ /rgyan gyi bstan bcos me long zhes grags dpal ldan dka'i gzhung lugs 'di/ /sngon gyi mkhas pa'i rjes 'brangs ma 'ongs mkhas pa du ma 'byung ba'i gzhir/ /da lha sa la mtshungs med kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung bzhin 'bad pas bris/ /sngon chad gangs ljongs 'chi med lam yangs por/ /dpang ston mkhas pa'i legs bshad zla tshes la/ /rang 'od 'bad das spro ba'i mkhas mang gi /'grel tshogs rgyu skar gyis bskor bar med khengs/ /slar yang snyigs lnga'i smag rum stug po 'dir/ /blo ngan bdag 'dra'i blo yi dri ma yi/ /nun pas gsal 'debs 'dis ko ci bya zhes/ /mkhas rmongs kun kyang khrel ba'i gnas su rigs//'on kyang rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs bskyed kyi//'jug pa dus las mi yol chos nyid kyis//phyogs las rnam rgyal gnas lnga'i paṇa chen mchog /kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed dus 'dir shar//chos kun gzigs pa'i rdo rje rdon po de//mkhas dbang rgya mtsho'i slob tshogs dang bcas pas/ /gzhung lugs rgya che rnam mang gzhan dang gzhan/ /'chad rtsod rtsom sogs rnam dkar 'phrin las rgyas/ /nyung ngu'i gzhung 'di bdag skal babs pa bzhin/ /dka' ba'i 'phrangs la brdar nas yang yang zhus/ /dgyes bzhid stsal ba'i gsung rgyun brjed 'phangs pas//snang byed 'od stong can 'dir ngang gis grub//tshe 'di phal cher don med kho nar zad//cung zad thos dang bsam par byas pa'ang / /688

tha snyad byis pa'i rtsed mo la g.yengs pa/ /'di 'dras dal 'byo ra don med byas kyi dogs/ /'on kyang gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pa yis/ /'khrul pa'i dri sbyangs don rnams legs bkrol te/ /gzhung don drang por bsrangs pa'i ngag gis ni/ /tshig 'grel 'di bzhin kho bos bag brkyangs bshad/ /'dir yang ma rtogs log rtog 'khrul pa'i dri/ /mchis gang bdag blo rmongs pa'i skyon du zad/ /des na slan chad mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis kyang / /kho bos nongs par mkhyen mdzod gzhan du min/ /gna' dus rgan po'i yid la ma shar ba'i/ /'phags yul legs bshad gsar pa'i skyes kun dang / /rnam dag rig pa tshad ma'i spub byed sogs/ /bla ma'i drin las yin gyi rang blos min/ /de der shes pas slar yang khyod mchod na/ /gang gi bzhed pa ji bzhin skyong ba dad / /rgyal ba'i dam chos mi 'jigs se de'i sgra/ /skye ba kun tu sgrog pa'i byed por shog 1gang zhig 'dir ni sdang bas dbang byas dam pa rnams la'ang sun ci byin/ /rgol zhing bdag nyid sgrog pa'i dgag bzhag rtog mas nyes pa'i khur ma blangs/ /'on kyang bsreg bcad bdar ba'i gsere bzhid rnam dag gnung don lhad༄byin phyir/ /ji bzhin bshad dang log par bkral ba'i rnam 'byed med na dgos pa ci/ /de 'dra'i nus pa bdag la ci mchis bod yul 'di yi mkhas rnams kyi/ /snga 'grel de dag tshul bzhin go ba'i blo yang dmad pa lhar gyur mod/ /de lta mod kyang shong dpang smra ba'i nyi ma nub nas da lha'i bar/ — /lan brgyar bsngags 'os mkhas grub rnam mang lo sgyur grags pa'ang mang skod kyi1— /legs spyar skad las 'phags yul legs bshad sna sna ba bdag gi tshe ma shad ma/1 4 da nyid ces 689

gzu bo'i blo can mkhas pa srid na mkhyen par bla/ /des na bdag gis 'bad pa 'di yang legs par bshad la dgyes pa yi//dam pa'i skyes bu kho na'i mdun sar don dang bcas mod gzhan du min/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba gang / /rnam par dkar bas 'gro ba kun//thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes//ngag gi dbang phyug nyid gyur cig/ces pa 'di'ang mkhas shing rig pa smra ba kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i bdag nyid chen po ta'i sī tu paṇa chen dharmā ka ra'i bzhed pa dang gsung rgyun ji lta bar/ dpal 'brug pa rin po che'i bka' 'bangs su skyes shing /rje 'di nyid las kyang tha snyad kyi gtsug lag mang po dang / mdo rgyud dbang man ngag gi bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob pa'i shar mdo khams kyi btsun pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma'am/ ming gzhan sgra dbyangs zla ba bdud rtsi'i lang tshor grags pas bod yul dbus 'gyur sa'i theg le g.yor po 'ching ru'i cha/bla ma'i gdan sa bde ba chen po'i chos 'khor du rang lo nyer lnga'i rtser son pa na rdzogs par bris pa la/ slar yang 'jam mgon paṇa chen bla ma'i spyan sngar 'dri gtugs dang dogs gcod yang nas yang du zhus te/ ji ltar bka' stsal ba'i dgongs don ji bzhin pa nyid rang blos ci nus su bzung nas dbri bsnan dang bcos bsgyur dag par byas te drung yig mi pham chos 'phel gyis yi ge pa byas nas/ rang gnas dpal phun tshogs chos 'khor gling gi gtsug lag khang chen por lcags pho stag gi lo/tha skar can gyi yar tshes la grub par bgyis pa phyogs dang dus dang gdas skabs thams cad du sa dā 690

ka phya rde// //oṃ gā ste/ngag gi rang bzhin me long 'di//snang ba dam pa 'jig rten rgyan/ /legs ldan nyi ma zla ba'i 'od/ /sprin bral 'di dag mkha' yi rgyan/ /1de tshul zon pa'i rol mo pa/ /'di na rab dga'i rgyud mangs bzhin/ /snga 'grel mkhan po rnam mang po'i/ /rjes 'jug rna ba'i bcud len du/ /2bcom ldan rgyal ba'i rnam sprul gang / /pi wang len pa ji bzhin du/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i legs bshad kyi/ /grags snyan bdud rtsi lhung ba'i mod/ /3de dag dgud gyi khu byug bzhid/ /smra bcad rgya la 'thum mthong nas/ /'grol 'dod gtam gyi dus bzang 'di/ /dpyid ka'i dpal bzhin 'ong ba gyur//4ngo mtshar dus kyi dang po de//phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna rgyan du//gdags par bzod pa'i rig byed mkhan/ /gang gi sor mo'i 'du byed kyis/ /5be+e shas ngal ba skyengs byed par/ /ngag dbang lha mos mchog byen pa/ /chos tshul rgya mtsho 'phel byed sogs/ /gzhan yang 'phrul brkos rig byed mkhan/ /6mtha' dag phyogs kyi grangs ldan pas/ /dpal ldan grub rig snying po pa//sprin sgras sgeg pa'i mtshan gyi dbyangs//'jig rten gsum du khyab pa yi/ /7ring lugs dar ba'i chos grwa che/ /phun tshogs chos 'khor gling chen por/ /bsgrubs pa'i dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /8maṅga lo//691
snyan ngag me long gzhung gis bstan pa'i dper brjod legs par bshad pa sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//pod mkhas ba mi pham dge megs nam rgyam gyis brtsams/

༄༅/ /na mo wā gen+d+ra ba badz+ra ya/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes chu gter tshad med snying rjes bsrubs pa las/ /srid zhi'i mtshar sdug rdzogs pa'i rang zhal bstan pa'i dpal mo bzhad pa ste/ /rin chen rgyud mangs sbong ba'i zol gyis chos sgo mtha' yas glur len pa/ /rgyal yum dbyangs can ma kye mgrin pa'i tshal 'dir byon la rol rtsed mdzod//de yi rig pa'i khyad par ba yi//rgyud las 'phos pa'i rgyan gyi ut+pal 'dab//rnam dpyod —nyi zer stong gis zu ste slar/ /blo gsal rna ba'i rgyan du byin gyis longs/ /rgyan gyi khyad par de dang de dag gi /gnad don gar song ma dmigs bzhin du yang / /snyan par mngon rlom dper brjod phreng ngom pa/ /ra gan gser du brdzu bas bslus pa bzhid/ /snyigs ma'i nun par 'phyan pa'i mkhas zlom gyi/ /sprang ma grong pa'i skad kyis nu cor glu/ /dpyad kyin snying pos dben rnams bag byos la/ /sngon byon lo paṇa dam pa'i lugs 'di sten/ /ces bde legs shis par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pas mdun bsus te/ 'dir snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos chen po me long gzhung las byung ba'i rgyan gyi bye brag rnams dper brjod pa'i tshul gyis gsal bar bya ba la zhugs so/ /de las le'u dang po lam rnam par dbye ba nas dngos su bstan pa thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan/ dngos lho phyogs bai dka dang /bzlog pa shar phyogs go ḍā ba'i lam srol gnyis su phye ba yon tan rnam pa bcu ste/ sbyar ba rab dwangs mnyam nyid dang / /snyan dang shin tu gzhon pa dang //don gsal ba dang rgya che ba//brjid dang mdzes dang ting nge 'dzin//zhes pa ltar las/ dang po sbyor ba'i yon tan la/ ma yig bskor ba rjes 695

khrid kyi sgras go ḍā ba'i 'dod pa sbyar ba'i yon tan/ nyi ma'i 'od min nang gi snang byed ma/ /nu tig 'od ldan ma gcig blo gter ma/ /kye ma ma la yid ni ma dka' ba'i//ma ma kun la ma g.yel brtse bar mdzod//sbyor ba spru ba bai dka'i 'dod pa sbyar pa'i yon tan/ kai la sha ri'i mgul gyi snyan ngag mkhan/ /phar cher yon tan rnam bcu'i 'jug pa yis/ /tshig sbyor sa chen 'degs tshe ri mo la//bris pa'i sgron me mtshungs par gsal chas dben//bai da lha'i rab tu dwangs pa'i yon tan/ pha mtha' bral ba'i nam mkha' sngo bsangs mar/ /bgrod pa'i zla ba bdud rtsi'i 'od snang can/ /mun pa'i go 'phang 'jig la mkhas pa yi/ /ngo mtshar mi mjid 'jig rten 'di na gsal/ /go ḍā ba'i rab dwangs kyi yon tan/ snang min lam du 'phyan la brtse ba'i gnyen/ /bdud rtsi'i zer brgyas yongs gang chu las skyes/ /'gro 'dis legs byas kyis drangs lha rtsen mar//rol 'di tshangs pa'i du yi yi kar 'ong //bai dka'i mnyam nyid kyi yon tan/ rtswa ljang myu gu'i 'dab dang ka ma la/ /rnam bkra dbyar gyi dpal mo yid 'ong mar/ /'khril phyir sprin tshogs sgrog la 'brug sgra yis//sgeg rnams sgro gdugs zang zhing gar bsgyur ro/ /go ḍā ba'i mnyam nyid/ nyi 'od dal bus 'khyud pa pad+mo'i jing / /yang yang nyul ba bung ba'i bu mo'i grus/ /len tshul rje yi snyeg mo la/ /co 'drir byed 'di dpyid kyi yon tan no//snyan pa lho phyogs pa'i sgra'i nyams las/ tshigs mtshungs nye ba'i nyams/ pad+ma'i dpal la bung ba'i bu mo bzhin/ /zab rgyas rgyud dang rgyud 'grel rgya che'i gzhung / /shes 'dod rnam dpyod lang tsho yongs gang rnams/ /yang nas yang du yang dag don la 696

sems/ /yang na/ puṇ+ḍa rī ka dag dang zla ba'i dpal/ /rgya che khengs 'phrog dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i phyag /nor du'i rgyud mangs 'gying zhing 'khrol ba'i sgras/ /yang dag chos kyi snang ba yang yang spro/ /rkang pa la bskor ba'i rjes khrid/ rgyal ba'i thugs rje ris med kun la stoms//rgya che sems can khams kyi rjes su 'jug /rgya'am 'ching ba las ni rnam grol byed/ /rgya mtsho las lhag gnying mtha' zad mi shes//tshig la bskor ba'i rjes khrid/ legs byas las grub lang tsho'i dpal gyis sgeg /rab 'byams chos kyi rang bzhin ba ra'i//sgra dbyangs sgrog la sgra ldan lha'i bu mos//deng 'dir chos dod 'dod dmas rjes 'dzin 'tshal/ /yi ge ring por bskor ba'i rjes khrid/ yid srubs 'phrul gyis sbyor ba 'dod pa lnga'i//ltar snang mdzes sdug rdzogs pa'i rtse dga' yis/ /tshe 'dir rab bslus glog gi mar me bzhin/ /yal mthar rnam smin lhung tshe 'gyod pas gdungs//shar ba kho na 'dod pa'i rjes khrid/grang bas sbyibs ('khyags pa)pa'i sbrang bu sbrang rtsis ci//bkren pas sprubs(ltogs pa)pa'i lag sprang (slong mo ba)'khrig pas ci//'dod sbos gzhon nus chos 'dul 'dod kyang ci/ /chos don mthong min 'od kyis ci byar yod/ /spang bya don gyi grong pa'i tshig kun gyi snying du sdug pa'i bu mo khyod//mthong bas kho bo chags pa lhag par rgyas/ /'o dang 'khyud pas 'khrig pa'i bya ba la//mnyam du 'jug 'di yid smon gnas min nam//spong byed kyi nyams ji ltar sbyin pa/ zla bzhin ma kye 'dod pa'i chu gter la/ /'gro ba'i ba dad ltar dkar khyod lus kyis//yid srubs mtshon gyis reg la sim ster ba'i//longs spyod gsar ba 'ga' zhig mi spro'am/ /sgra'i grong pa tshig gi mtshams 697

sbyor gyis zhugs pa/rigs dang lang tshor ldan pa'i du mo mtshan//dam pa'i lam rab bgrod la mkhas pa'i rtags/ /bzang ba tshad du smin pa'i byang chub sems//dkar po'i chos ldan gang 'di mtshar che'o//ngag tshig gi don la zhugs pa'i grong pa/ sbos pa'i dmar bas bzhin ras gsal byas shing //shugs drag rdo rje che gdengs pha rol po'i//lus la lan brgyar bsnun pa'i cho ga des/ /zug rngu brnag par ma bzod 'ga' zhig 'khun/ /dmigs bsal skyon med ni/ gang zhig skyed byed ma ma'i 'dod pa'i don/ /bsgrub byar 'os pa bu las gzhan min phyir/ /mtha' yas 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i sems//mi 'dor bdag nyid chen po che ba'i rtags//bai dka'i shin tu gzhon pa'i yon tan/ pad+ma'i tshal dang lo 'dab yangs pa'i shing //kun tu rgyu zhing snyan pa'i glu len mkhan/ /sprang rtsis myos pa'i ra yig gnyis pa dang / /dpyid kyi pho nya bde bar rgyu rnams so/ /go ḍā ba'i 'dod pa brjod dka' ba/ sbrang rtsi'i dri yis rab dregs bh+ra ma raḥ / /bstu ka yi 'khri shing 'gram par rtse/ /rma bya rgyags pa'i gre 'gyur sgrog pa yang / /'khyog po'i mgrin ldan ba sā ras nyan//shar phyogs 'dod mthun don gsal gyi yon tan/ g.yo sgyus rab sbyar slong ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /mi'u thung zol gyis rgyu ba'i khyab 'jug tshig /ma brtags re ba las lhag sbyin pas kyang / /sa 'og 'ching ba'i 'bras thob sbyin skyes bu/ /shar ba res 'ga' tsam 'dod pa/slong dang rjes su mthud par gtong ba'i blo/ /'gog pa med pa'i snying stobs kyis bzung ba//ci 'dod sbyin pas lag brel dā nu'i bu//stobs dang ldan yang 'dzin ma'i 'og tu 'ching //bai da lha'i rgya che ba'i yon tan/e ma 698

ral gri'i gnyen gyur gang gi mtshan/ /cha tsam shub bur zlos tshe gzhan gyi sde'i//rtse dga'i 'khri shing ma noms 'dren byed ni//rab dmar ngogs las mchi ma'i chab rgyun 'brub/ /go ḍā ba'i rgya che ba'i yod tan/ me tog 'khri shing gis gang skyed tshal du/ /rin chen gdub kor 'khrol ba'i mdzes ma zhig/rnam bkra nor du'i ska rags las dpyangs pa'i/ /gser gyi dril chung snyan pa'i ca co sgrog /go ḍā ba'i brjid pa'i yon tan/ mdzes ma bzhin gyi zla rgyas mtshar ba/ /ga dur zer phreng ku nud la bzhin/ /'dzum dkar pha rol ba der spros na/ /yid la kun dga' ci phyir mi dgod/ /be+e dka'i brjid pa'i yod tan/kha dog zla ba chu shel bzhin du//dkar la mdzes pa'i sgra dbyangs lha khyod//ma la bdag sogs sgyu ma'i lus can//kun la brtse ba ci phyir mi g.yo/ /bai da lha'i mdzes pa'i yon tan gtam la sbyar ba/ zung 'jug rtogs pa'i gar mkhan mi la rje/ /ras dkar bla gos brkyangs pa'i 'phur lding gis/ /lan mang gshegs nas shis pa sgrub pa'i mkha'/ /'chi med lam chen zhes brjod don dang ldan/ /bai dka'i mdzes pa bsngags pa la sbyar ba/gar dgu'i nyams kyi sgeg 'chang gtum (spe brtsegs)po che//kun tu rmongs pa'i dngos po kham zas su//byed pa'i 'jigs zhal drag por glal(gdangs pa'am g.yal ba la zer)pa'i khyod//yangs pa'i bzhin ras mtha' la rdzogs ma gyur/ /go ḍā ba'i mdzes pa gtam la sbyar ba/ ras dkar 'dab ma rab bskyod mthu chen gyis/ /lan gcig min par gshegs shul sgo ṭa'i mkha'//dag pa'i snang ba rab 'byams 'og min zhing //stug po bkod pa'i yon tan las kyang brgal//go blo ba'i mdzis pa'i yon tan bsngags pa la 699

sbyar ba/ me dpung dbus su gar dgu'i nyams kyi ros//rab dgyes kun tu rmongs pa'i g.yul 'joms lha//khro bo'i rgyal po khyod zhal cher gdangs pa//stong gsum chen po'i khyod la'ang ci ste shong / /ting nge 'dzin gyi yod tan las spyir brjod pa/ grang reg rnam par rgyal ba mtshan dus kyi/ /nun pa 'thungs pas chu skyes long ba'i khyu//gcig pur mi skyo snang byed bdag po'i mig/'od zer stong gi thur mas 'byed la zhugs//chos gcig bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ dpyid dpal yongs su dar pa'i rlan drod rgyun/ /zags rnams 'thungs pas rab myos ko shu ka'i/ /'khri shing rang lus sgeg pas dmar ba'i rdul/ /yang nas yang du zags par byed pa bzhin/ /chos du ma bkod pa'i nying nge 'dzin/ nyin mo'i 'byung gnas 'od kyi rlabs g.yo bas//dri bzang khang ba dkar po kha bye tshe//sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs pa kun gnyid sad nas//chog mi shes pa'i rol rtsed 'thung don gnyer//zhes pa ni lam rnam par dbye ba'i skabs te dang po'o//gnyis pa don gyi rgyan gyi yongs su dpyad pa las byung ba'i don rgyan sum cu rtsa lnga las/ dang po rang bzhin brjod pa las/ rigs dang bya ba yon tan rdzas//zhes dbye ba bzhi las/ rigs kyi rang bzhin brjod pa ni/phul byung mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i sku mnga' zhing //yang dag don ldan yan lag drug cu'i gsung / /kun mkhyen rnam par mi rtog ye shes thugs/ /dus gsum rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la 'dud/ /bya ba brjod pa/ ye shes chen pos srid zhi mnyam par gzigs/ /brtse bas gdul bya 'dul la spro bas drangs//gzhom med gsung gis dam grol lam ston pa//gdul dka'i 700

zhing 'di yongs bzung shākya'i tog /yon tan brjod pa/rgyal ba de sras smra ba yongs kyi lha//'jam pa'i dbyangs de bsnyen pas thogs med kyi//rmongs pa rab tu zhi dang blo yi mchog /thob nas shes bya kun la 'jigs bral gyur/ /rdzas brjod pa/ shes rab ral gri 'bar ba'i mtshon 'phyar zhing / /ut+pal lte bar stoms zhugs glegs bam 'chang / /mthing sngon zur phud lnga bcings rin po che'i//rgyan ldan brtan pa'i 'khor lo zhing 'di'i dpal/ /gnyis pa dpe rgyan la/ chos dpe dngos po bzlog pa dang / /phan tshun dpe dang nges med bsdus/ /phul byung rab btags rmad byung rmongs/ /the tshom gtan 'bebs sbyar ba dang / /mnyam nyid blod dang bsngags pa'i dpe/ /brjod 'dod 'gal ba dgag dang mdzes/ /de nyid brjod dang thun mong min/ /byung min srid min mang ba dang / /rnam 'gyur phreng ba ngag don gnyis/ /zla bo dngos po mtshungs sbyor dang / /rgyu yi dpe ste sum cu gnyis/ /zhes pa ltar las/ chos dpe ni/ rgyal yum rdo rje dbyangs kyi dbang phyug ma'i//zhal (dpe can)gyi dkyil 'khor ston gyi zla rgyas (dpe)bzhin//'jig rten kun yid 'phrog pa'i 'dzum dkar can//bdag gi mig la mngon sum snang bar mdzod/ /'di yang chos dpe/ ne'u gsing g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal phyis 'drar sngo//me tog phreng mdzis skar tshogs bzhid du bkra//bung ba'i mgrin sgra rgyud mangs ltar snyan pa'i/ /dpyid kyi dus 'di lha yul lta bur mdzes/ /dngos po'i dpe/ 'o ma'i chu gter dang mtshungs zhal dkyil 'khor/ /spyan zung ut+pal mthing ga'i dpal 'phrog des/ /bskyod pa'i smin 'khyog bung ba'i rnam 'phrul lta'i/ /lha mo khyod ni dpyid kyi phun tshogs (dpyid kyi yon 701

11na)'dra//bzlog pa'i dpe/sa gzhi skyong ba khyod kyi gzi byin bzhin//nyin mor byed 'di snang ba ches bdo la//gang gi bka' khrims dang mtshungs go ‘pa'i 'gros//mkha' la rim par 'khor 'di mthong ngam kye//phan tshun dpe/— shā ba dris (rngon pa mo)gtses ri skyes bu mo bzhin/ /thar pa 'dod rnams ‘dben pa'i ri bor te/ /'du 'dzis yid rab byung ba de rnams bzhin/ /ri tsho1gas rnams ni bas mtha'i tshal na bde//nges pa'i dpe/mtha' dang zad du med pa sdug bsngal gyi//'byung gnas 'khor ba 'di nyid dug can mtsho//kho na'i rjes su rkang pa 'jog pa ste//dper 'os gzhan 'ga' 'jig rten shā rdod na med//nges med dpe/ rnyed dka' brgya lam thob na don che ba//dal nga1'i rten 'di 'jog po'i gtsug rgyan dang / /re zhig mtshan nyid mthun che /da de 'dra ba'i/ /dngos gzhan srid na mchis kyang rjes su 'gro/ /bsdus nga'i dpe/lus phra ma khyod mtshar sdu ga ldan kho nas//theg le mchog ma'i rjes tsu1 'gro min te//kun gyi yid bsgyur 'dod pa'i gar mdzes pa'i//skyed mos tshal 'dir shis pa bsgrubs pas kyang //phul byung dpe/khyod kyi 'dren byed da pal ni khyod gdong la//mthong zhing ut+pal nags kyi rdzing dur te//gzhan pa'i khyad par 'byed chos zhib mo'i blos/ /lan brgyar brtags kyang dmigs su yod min no/ /rab btags dpe/ lus can mdza' ba'i mtha' kud mi brtan par/ /mtshon phyir glog gi gya gyus snyems ma byed/ /zlos ba/ra mkhan po'i lag pa'i rnam 'gyur la'ang / /g.yo ba'i chos de nges par mthong phyir ro/ /rmad byung dpe/ ha ri tsan+dan ljon par mtshams sprin gyis/ /'khyud nas dal bu'i 'gros kyis rgyu byed la/ /blo gsal tshogs la legs 702

bshad 'doms shes na/ /tshangs par spyod ldan cad dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /rmongs pa'i dpe/ khyod lus 'bigs byed rlung gzhon gyis bskyed pa'i/ /'khri shing gzhon nur rab 'khrul mdzes sdug can/ /gang gis gzugs la mngon chags skyed tshal gyi/ /gsar 'khrungs ljon pa'i mgul nas 'khyud rtsom mo/ /'di yang / yid 'phros tshal na rol ba'i sgeg 'chang gzugs//g.yo ldan pad+ma'i sdong bur rnam brtags nas//mdzes ldan dga' ma'i reg pa don gnyer blos/ /puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i chu bar 'khyud la rings the tshom dpe/ 'dod dgu sbyin pa'i sa brtol ljon pa la/ /thun mtshams chu 'dzin gzhon nus mdzes sam ci/ /yang na rnam 'dren khyod sku ngur smrig gis//'khyud pa lags snyam bdag yid 'phyang mo nyug/gtan phebs dpe/srid gsum mdzes pa'i dpal kun zil gnon pa'i//khyod mthong tsam gyis mchog gi 'bras bu yang / /bde blag sbyin phyir yongs 'du'i shing min te/ /des ni 'khor ba'i phun tshogs ster nus tsam/ /sbyar ba'i dpe/ dkar gsal dri mas spangs pa'i bzhin ras can//chags ldan snying la kun dga' gsar pa'i ro//sbyin byed lang pa'i 'phel ba rtsom pa yi//bdag gi grogs de zla tshes gsar ba bzhin/ /mnyam nyid dpe/ rnam 'dren ngag gi dbang phyug ba zhabs/ /ma dros gdengs can bdag po'i ngo mtshar bzhin/ /phun tshogs kun gyi byed po de dbang chu'i/ /rgyun mchog rnam bzhi 'bebs la mkhas pas so/ /smad pa'i dpe/ lha yi jing ring stong yang rig chas dben//chu gter gting zab yangs pa ba tshwas rnyogs//yongs 'dzin khyod thugs ye shes chen po'i klong / /tshul des ji bzhin gzhal phyir ga la zhig /703

bsngags pa'i dpe/'chi med lam gyi phyogs cha gzhal mi phod//rgya mtsho rin chen phung po 'byung ba'i khungs//de dag nyid dang 'dren pa khyod kyi thugs//rnam pa kun tu mtshungs so rje bla ma//brjod 'dod dpe/sgrib dang bral ba'i yon tan gsal byed dam//gal te skyon gyi dam pa 'dzin kyang rung //khyod thugs ye shes che dang nam mkha'i klong //mtshungs zhes brjod 'dod bdag gi snying la gnas//'gal ba'i dpe//rab 'bar bskal pa'i zhugs dang rta gdong ri//khro bo'i rgyal po khyod kyi ral tshogs rnams//gcig kyang phan tshun rnam pa tha dad pa'i/ /ngang tshul 'di dang 'gal bar bdag sems so/ /dgag pa'i dpe/ yi ge gsal min snying pos dben pa'i sgras//gzhan yid bslu ba dri za'i rgyud mangs la//dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i gsung la 'gran bdo ba'i//spobs pa rdul phran tsam yang ga la yod/ /'di yang dgag dpe/ smad 'os 'dam las skyes shing rdul gyis nyams//mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur kun la 'du byed bral/ /ldum ra'i pad+mas mdzes ma khyod kyi gdong / /cha tsam mtshon pa'i nus pa yod min no/ /mdzes pa'i dpe/ ma spru ba glegs bam ral gres mtshan//kun nas rang grol mgon de pusta kaḥ//kho nas longs spyod 'khor lo brgyan gyur mod/ /mtshungs pa'i khyad chos thun mong gyur la ltos/ /'di yang mdzes dpe/ 'chi med dbang po lta byed stong phrag gis/ /rnam par brgyan cing sa gzhi skyong ba khyod/ /yangs pa'i 'dren byed zung zhig mnga' yang deng / /skye dgu'i spyod mtha' gzigs la mtshungs pa nyid/ /de nyid brjod dpe/ 'di nyid dpal ldan shākya seng ge'i sku/ /yin mod yongs sbyangs gser gyi rdul brtsegs min/ /mtshams sprin gsar bas bklubs 704

min ngur smrig gi /chos gos rnam gsum 'jibs par gsol ba lags/ /thun mong min pa'i dpe/ byu ru'i 'khri shing gsar ba'i mtshar sdug las/ /rnam par 'gongs pa badz+ra wā rā tī//khyod sku'i dpe zlar 'os pa srid gsum na/ /med phyir rang nyid mtshungs dper bstan la 'dud/ /byung min dpe/srid gsum sgra yi tshogs pa ma lus kun//gcig tu spungs ltar 'jigs su rung ba'i dbyangs//bdud sde'i snying rab 'gems phyir sgrog de la//phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i lha zhes grags//srid min dpe/chu rgyun bsrubs las me lho'i phreng ba dang //bsil byed zla bas me char spro ba ni//gzhar yang srid pa min bzhin rnam 'dren rje'i/ /zhal las nyes bshad 'byung ba'ang cang srid dam/ /mang ba'i dpe/ yid 'phrog kha ba dung dang pad rtsa li/ /zla 'od kun+da'i tshal bzhin dbyangs can lha'i/ /dri med sku ni rab dkar mdzes pa can/ /mthong bar 'tshal lo bcom ldan 'das ma kye/ /rnam 'gyur dpe/tshangs par spyod ldan gang gi bla gos ni//thun mtshams spren gyi khongs las drangs mtshungs la//tshul khrims dri bsrung zhim po'i ngad ldang ba'ang //spos ngad ldan pa'i ri las blangs pa bzhin/ /phreng pa'i dpe/ dbyar gyi sprin tshogs bzhin du de yis kyang / /char bzhin de mthus sa gzhi'i lo tog bzhin/ /'bru bcud smin pas skye bo'i lus stobs bzhin/ /kun nas rang grol mgon des thub bstan spel//ngag don las bzhin sgra gcig pa'i dpe/dus kyis bslad pa'i grogs ngan khro gnyer can//dmar pa'i sdang mig yon por bskyod ‘sgyu phal/ /dbyar gyi sprin mgo nag po mang gdengs par/ /glog phreng 'gyu bas mtshon bzhin ches mi sdug /bzhin sgra du ma'i dpe/'o ma'i chu 705

gter ji bzhin 'jo sgeg ma'i/ /rol pa'i rlabs bzhin smin ma 'khyog po can/ /ngang ba'i rgyal po bzhin du sred ldan gyis/ /longs su nye bar spyod cing mos bzhin rtse//zla bo dngos po'i dpe/srid pa'i khyon yangs 'di na smra ba'i dbang / /mang yang bdag gi 'dren par 'gran nus su/ /skyed tshal me tog phal pas gang gyur mod//phun tshogs u da ra skye ba dkon//mtshungs sbyor dpe/dpal ldan daṇ+ḍi 'phags pa'i yul ljongs dang //mkhas khyod kha ba can 'dir snyan ngag spru//des ni phyir rgol smra ba ngan rnams dang //khyod kyis ma rig 'thibs bu yongs su 'dul/ /rgyu'i dpe/ khyod sku mdzes pas pad+ma'i 'khri shing dang / /khyod gsung snyan pas rkang pa drug pa'i glu/ /khyod thugs rnam par bkra bas za 'og gi /gur khyim mtshungs pa khyod la bdag dga'o/ /dpe'i skyon sel las rtags tha dad kyang skyon med pa/ 'jam mgon khyod ni ga ka'i dpal mo ltar//'gro ba'i dag byed tshad mar gyur pa ste //khyod yum rdo rje dbyangs kyi rgyal mo yang //zla ba bzhin du srid pa'i nun 'joms nyid//tshig tha dad kyang skyon med pa/'dren pa mchog khyod phyogs bcu'i rgyal rnams dang //chos sgo grangs med 'byed la mthun pa ste//mdzad phrin rnam par dkar ba'i tshul rnams kyang / /ston mtshan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig pus mtshon/ /dpe don mchog dman byung yang skyon med pa/dri med lha yi lam las nyi ma bzhin/ /dka' thub can khyod gshegs pa'i sta‘bas mdzes la//zhi zhing dul bas 'tsham par 'chag pa'i tshul//ngur ba'i 'gros bzhin kun tu yi gar 'ong //sbyor ma shes na gong gsal rnams kyang skang1sa 'gar skyon can du 'gyur ba/dpa' bo lta bur dregs ldan mdzes ma 7 06

khyod/ /rgyu skar tshogs kyi mdangs bzhin dkar ba'i gdong / /sbrang bu'i 'dab ltar 'jam pa'i lag par brten/ /'jig rten mes po bzhin du gru snyan len/ /gsum pa gzugs can rgyan la/ bsdus pa'i gzugs cad ma bsdus pa//bsdus shing ma bsdus mtha' dag dang //cha shas dang ni cha shas can/ /yan lag gcig sogs ldan ldan min/ /mi mnyam khyad par 'gal dang rgyu//sbyar ba dpe bzlog 'gog pa dang //mnyam 'jog gzugs can gyi gzugs can/ /bsnyon dor gzugs can dang nyi shu/ /zhes pa ltar las/bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ khyod zhal pad+ma mtshar sdug 'dab yangs pa/ /tshems phreng ge sar ro 'dzin bung ba g.yo//lang tsho rmad byung dpyid dpal dar ba mo/ /dbyangs ldan mtho ris skyed tshal de kho na/ /ma bsdus gzugs can/lus kyi 'khri shing 'khyog po'i rtser smin pa'i//ral pa'i me tog tsam pa ka yi rdul/ /'thung 'dod mig gi bung ba kem kem g.yo/ /rgan po'i skyed tshal 'di ni ya re nga //bsdus shing ma bsdus pa/rtse dga'i gnyen gyur khyod gdong pad+ma dkar/ /so phreng ge sar tshogs pa'i tshar dngar la/ /smin ma 'khyog pa'i ra yig gnyis pa zung / /'dod pa'i sprang rtsis myos pa'i gar bsgyur ro/ /mtha' dag gzugs can/ 'khril ldem lus kyi lhug phran yid 'ong rtser/ /mtshar sdug rdzogs pa'i bzhin ras me tog dgod/ /zur mig bung ba gzhon nu'i 'phur lding bcas//lus mchog yongs 'du'i ljon par 'khyud de su//cha shas gzugs can/dka' thub ldan pas phrar gyur lag pa yi/ /mdzub rtse pad+ma'i skud pas nyer bzung ba'i/ /yid 'phrog bgrang phreng mdzes ma 'di dag ni/ /thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi rtse dga'i grogs/ /cha 707

shas can gzugs/ khyod thugs zag pa med pa'i me long la/ /sgrib pa'i tshogs kun gzhar yang mi gnas pa'i/ /rnam rtog med las skyes pa'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /rnam pa dpag tu med la ldang zhing 'jug /yan lag gcig gzugs/ 'dren pa khyod gsung rnam pa thams cad pa/ /legs bshad snyan pa'i gling bu rgyud gcig pas/ /gdul bya rang rang skal bar ‘ra tsham pa'i chos/ /ston par nus pa shākya'i rgyal po'o/ /sogs khong nas byung ba gnyis gzugs/ mdzes pa'i sku yi gsang ba mi zad rgyan/ /mtshan dpe'i me tog 'bar ba'i cha rer yang //blta bas mi ngoms zil dngar 'bum 'dzag pa//mgon de'i bka' drin yangs pa rjes su dran/ /gsum gzugs/ mdzes ma khyod kyi snying dbus pad tshal na/ /mdza' ba'i gsang gtam bung ba'i na chung ma//snyan 'gyur mgrin pa'i rgyud mangs steng ba 'dis//bdag gi yid ni dbang med phyogs der drangs/ /ldan gzugs/ khyod lus sa hā kā ra'i 'khri shing gi/ /lang tsho'i me tog ci yang 'bar bas na/ /myur du nu ma'i 'bras bu dud 'gyur zhes/ /shes ldan 'dab chags tshogs 'di ca co sgrogs//ldan min gzugs/khyod gdong ngam gnag mun pa'i 'khor sa che//smin 'khyog bskal mes rab 'khyud spyan gyi nyi//gzigs pa'i gar res snying la bdud rtsi'i ro/ /sbyin phyir dbyings das khros de tshogs bdag lha'o/ /mi mnyam pa'i gzugs/ lha yi lcam gcig khyod zhal lta na sdug /yid tsam bye ba'i mchu sgros pad+ma'i rlabs/ /mdzes byed tshems kyi ge sar ngang mo'i khyu/ /dkar ba'i phun tshogs gcig tu bkra ldan no/ /khyad par gzugs can/chos ldan rgyal po'i rkang sed phyogs kyi ni/ /dregs ldan gtsug gi la thod 708

g.yo ba'i rtser/ /bkod nas lha rnams kun dga'i rgyal mtshan cher/ /btsugs pas srid pa'i khyod 'di srung gyur cig/'gal gzugs/'chi med grong nas ngal bas ma phab cing //dbang phyug ral pa'i sto bar ma bsgyings pa/ /rnam 'dren khyod gsung ga ka'i chu rgyun 'dis/ /gdul bya'i rmongs pa mtha' dag bcad cing bsregs/ /rgyu'i gzugs can/ khyod ni phad pas snyoms phyir nyi ma dang / /bdud kyi las kun 'joms pas dpa' bo ste/ /'gro rnams 'khor bar mi lhung 'chel ba'i rten/ /yid la re ba ster ba'i nor bu'ang lags/ /sbyar gzugs/ kwa ye mdzes ma khyod lus tshal 'di na/ /rnyog bral pad+ma can gyi lang tsho 'bar/ /rtswa yi mdzes spyir lhan skyes rdul za ba'i//dga' ba'i rol rtsed ci yang nyams su myong //dpe gzugs/rdo rje'i 'dod la chags pas myos dmar gyi//rnal 'byor ma dpal khyod spyan pad+ma'i 'dab/ /dpyid kyi dpal du dregs pa'i mtsho las skyes/ /dmar ba'i phun tshogs de las lan brgyar rgyal//bzlog gzugs/ sbrang rtsi'i bu yis chu skyes bcud 'thungs la//bdag gis khyod zhal bka'i mdzes sdug 'thungs//pad+ma de ni gdos bcas bem chos te//khrod kyi zhal ni snang stong sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /'gog gzugs/ rnam par 'dren mchog khyod kyi ye shes 'phrul/ /ma nyams snying rje'i zla tshes 'dzum rlabs kyis//'dod pa'i dbang phyug snying la brnag dka'i nun/ /ster phyir zla ba'i dngos por gang gis 'grub//mnyam 'jog gzugs/ mdzes ma khyod lus ha ri tsan+dan na'i/ /'khri shing dpyid kyi rnam 'phrul la zhugs pas/ /bdag yid sreg 'di mdzes pa phul byung bar/ /ma zad bdag rang 'dod pas gzir bas kyang / /gzugs can gyi gzugs 709

can/ gang gi mkhyen dpyod nam mkha'i skyed mos tshal//shes bya'i rgyu skar me tog bzhad ldan pa'i/ /legs bshad 'od snang sbrang rtsi'i zegs ma tsam/ /thob pa'i blo gsal de dag skal ba bzang / /bston dor gzugs/ 'di ni khyod sku ma yin yongs 'du'i shing //gsung min dri za'i gling bus sbyar ba'i dbyangs/ /khyod thugs ma yin lha yi jing ring nyid/ /mi min 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos bla ma dran//bzhi pa gsal byed kyi rgyan las/rigs dang bya ba yod tad dang //rdzas kyi thog ma'i gsal byed dang //rigs dang bya ba'i bar gsal byed/ /de bzhin rigs dang bya ba mtha'/ /phreng ba 'gal don don gcig pa/ /sbyar ba'i gsal byed dang bcu gnyis/ /zhes pa ltar las thog ma'i rigs brjod pa'i gsal byed di/legs par bshad pas mkhas pa rnams kyi yid/ /kun dga'i dpal la rtag tu sbyor byed cing / /skye bo rnams yid rmongs pa'i rab rib kyang / /lhag ma med par drungs nas 'byin la dbang //bya ba thog ma'i gsal byed/snang bar byas so mtshar sdug rdzogs pa'i bzhin/ /rtog bral dngul gyi me long dwangs par te/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i chos tshul thams cad kyang //khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog la'o//'di yang/rgyas par byas so kun+da'i nags klung che//bsil ba'i zer brgya 'dzag pa'i zla bas te/ /blo gsal kun gyi rnam par dpyod pa yang //khyod kyis legs par bshad pa'i thur mas so//yon tan thog gsal/dmar ser nyid do phyogs kyis 'khor lo'i khyon//thun mtshams sprin gyi snang ba gsar bas te/ /'byung po 'dzin byed yum gyi phang ba yang / /ngur smrig rgyal mtshan sgreng ba rnams kyis so//rdzas brjod thog ma/chu bo'i gter 'di 710

rlabs kyi phreng ba mang / /dus las yol ba med par 'phen zhing de/ /ring nas rna ba'i grags 'bar don mthun tshogs/ /re ba snying la bkod de 'jug pa'i gnas/ /rigs bar gsal/ rgyu 'bras blang dor tshul la cher rmongs shing / /'phral snang 'dod bde ba la brkam zhing chags/ /snyigs dus skye bo ngan rnams g.yo dang sgyus/ /ngan 'gro'i 'bab stegs gzhol la snying por sems//bya ba bar gsal/ 'dir snang 'byor ba'i bun long rnam pa mang / /thar ba 'dod pa rnams la dug tu 'gyur//lus phra ma tshogs ral pa'i rnam 'gyur yang //brtse bral 'jigs rung gshed ma'i tshul du'o//yod tan bar gsal/ bya ba'i khur mang bzod pa'i rtsa khyud kyis/ /lus kyi 'khri shing las dpyangs khra ṣa ṇi ('bras bud/ /sngo skyar snang ngo grang dang tsha ba'i rgyun/ /'thung sa pa'i skye bo rnams kyi bzhin ras kyang //rdzas bar gsal/ skye bo sgeg 'chor can gyi mgrin pa'i rgyan/ /lag rtsis mkhan po'i bgrang bya'i nyer spyad kyang / /phreng ba nyid de lhag ba'i lha bsnyen dus/ /snying po'i sngags tshig dbyangs su len pa'i rdzas/ /rigs mtha' gsal/ 'ga' zhig rtsom 'chad rtsod pas gzhan rjes 'dzin//la la mi smra dben pa'i nags 'dabs bsten/ /gzhan dag bya ba las kyi 'khor lo yis/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa 'di kun dam pa'i mgon/ /bya ba mtha' gsal/ 'byung 'khrugs nad kyi zug rngus lus phung ste/ /rnam g.yeng thag zhags dam pos de bzhin yid/ /gzhan dbang sgrog gis don gnyer re ba'i gnas/ /gzhan du 'chug pa med par rnam par bsdams//yon tan mtha' gsal/dbyar sprin chu dang bcas pas 'chi med lam/ /rtswa lngang myu gu gsar pas 'dzin ma'i khong / /lang tsho rgas 711

pa'i tshon gyi kho bo yi/ /lus dang gdong gi pad+mo rnam par sngo/ /rdzas mtha' gsal/'thungs tsam nyid nas ca co 'phel byed cing //stobs dang grags dang gzi mdangs nyams pa'i rgyu/ /bag med rtsod dang 'khrug long mtha' dag gi/ /gzhi dang rtsa bar gyur pa chang nyid do/ /phreng ba'i gsal byed/'jam mgon bla ma'i thugs rjes bdag gi blo/ /rab tu rgyas des legs par bshad pa ste//des ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa de yis kyang //ris med 'gro ba kun gyi phan dang bde/ /'gal don gsal byed/ gser gyi 'od chags mtshan dpe'i dpal rdzogs pa/ /rgyal sku'i snang brnyan yid la 'phos pa'i mod//dad stobs 'bar ba'i spu long cher rgyas kyang //chags dang skrag pa'i lus skyes nyams par byas//don gcig gsal byed/byis blo'i dri ma can gyi chos shes kyang //nga rgyal dbugs rgod stod du cher brtsegs shing //gzhan la khyad gsod lud pa phyogs bcur 'phen/ /chos spang dam pa smod pa'i nyes pa bskyed/ /sbyar ba'i gsal byed/ khor yug bsung zhim ngad kyis dgar mdzad cing //kun la ci 'dod stsol ba'i dpag bsam dbang //ljon pa'i mchog de yongs 'du'i tshul nang brjid//thams cad gzigs de mos pa rgya mtsho'i ngor//lnga pa bskor ba'i rgyan la/don bskor tshig bskor gnyis ka bskor/zhes gsum las/don bskor ni/zla 'od zer gyis ku ka'i ge sar gsal/ /'od stong ldan pas pad dkar 'dab brgya grol/ /mdzes ma'i kha phrus ba ku la dbye zhing / /rkang pas mya ngan med pa'i me tog dgod/ /tshig bskor/ bka' rgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng tshogs kyi/ /yon tan gzur gnas blo yis brnag par(bsam par)dka'/ /dka' spyad rnam par thar 712

pa'i tshul bzang po//bstan 'dzin chen por sgom tshos brnag par(bzod pa)dka'/ /gnyis ka bskor ba/ srid pas yid byung thar pa don gnyer ba'i/ /'dun pas kho bo dbed par bag yangs rgyu/ /gnod pa med la 'drer mthong khyim mtshes rnams//dogs pa'i yul med rang khyim bag yangs rgyu/ /drug pa 'gog pa can gyi rgyan la/ byung ba mngon gyur 'byung 'gyur 'gog/chos dang chos can rgyu 'bras 'gog/rjes gdang dbang dang ma gus dang //shis brjod tsub mo grogs 'bad pa//gzhan dbang thabs dang khro skya ngan//'gyod dang the tshom sbyar ba dang / /don gzhan rgyus 'gog nyi shu gsum/ /zhes pa ltar las/ byung ba ('das)'gog pa'i rgyan ni/ mnyam med thub pa mchog des byams pa'i mtshon/ /gcig pus dpung dang sder bcas dregs pa'i bdud/ /bcom pa'i sngon byung gtam 'di 'ud po che/ /'on kyang rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab//da ltar ba 'gog pa/ rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ye shes ral gri'i phyag cha 'phyar nas ci/ /'gro 'di'i rmongs pa'i dngos po mtha' yas pa//bad zhal mthong bas cig car gzhon nus so/ /'byung 'gyur(ma 'ongs pa)'gog pa/ 'dred pa mchog khyod rnyed dang bkur ste la//dges sems cher rlom kho nar gdams pa'i bcud/ /phangs med lhug pard na dad ldan rnams/ /yi chad mig gis khyod zhal mthong mi 'gyur/ /'di yang / sa gzhi skyong khrod nang gi bang mdzod tsam/ /'gengs phyir rang gi chab 'og 'tshir nugs na/ /'bad pas bsags pa'i longs spyod nyung zad 'di//bsrung slad kho bo'ang yul gzhan cis mi 'khyams/ /chos 'gog pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang khyod kyi phyag 713

yangs kyis/ /khams gsum 'gro la dbugs 'byin mdzad pa rdzun/ /gzhan du 'dod lha'i snying la bzod dka' ba'i/ /mya ngan tshor ba drag pos ci la gdungs/ /chos can 'gog pa/ gtum chen khro bo'i dbang po rta mchog dpal/ /gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan nam mi ldan zhes//dpag par dka' ste dus mtha'i me dpung che/ /'bar ba tsam las—sku nyid mngon sum min/ /rgyu 'gog pa/ zangs zhun lhag lhag khol dang lcags kyi gzhir//gshin rje'i pho nyas tsub mo'i mtshon bstar te/ /'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrogs kyang mi dge'i las/ /ma spyad phyir na bdag sems ga la g.yo//'bras bu 'gog pa/lang tsho bdo las lus med lus zhugs shing / /nyin byed dbang po 'khrig pa'i khyim du rtsen//gzhon nu ma noms mngon 'dod dus 'debs kyang //kho bo bslab gzhi'i rgya las 'gong ma nus//rjes gnang 'gog pa/chos kyi rgyal mtshan sgreng khyod dag pa'i zhing / /don du gnyer bzhed mchis na de bzhin mdzod/ /chu bur dang mtshungs snyigs ma'i lus can 'ga'/ /bral ba'i gdung bas yun ring 'tsho mi 'gyur/ /dbang gis 'gog pa/ rnam par 'dren khyod gang du gshegs pa'i sar//gdul byar 'os pa'i 'gro ba bsam mi khyab/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'jug pa'ang de 'dra mod/ /'on kyang zhing 'dir rtag par bzhugs shig kye/ /ma gus pas 'gog pa/ bdag ni thub pas bcas khrims mchog tu 'dzin/ /dbang po gnyis sbyor chos la de lta min/ /grogs khyed gnas 'dir gzims sam mi gzims kyang / /rang gi gnas tshul tsam zhig gleng bar zad//shis brjod 'gog pa/ khyod nyid 'tsho ba'i lhag kun tha snyad la//bsgril bar bzhed na bskal brgyar bzhugs gyur 714

cig /bdag cag snying po don zab 'tshol ba rnams/ /phyi phyag bgyis te dben gsum bsten par smon/ /rtsub mos 'gog pa/ mgon khyod dag pa'i zhing du gshegs bden da/ /zhing 'di'i bstan pa 'dzid nus gzhan 'ga' tshol/ /bdag cag khyod kyi zhabs zung bsten pa kun/ /lnga pa'i gnas skabs thob las gzhan du ci/ /grogs kyis 'gog pa/ grogs khyod longs spyod bzhed na 'dren byed kyis/ /gzigs tshad byi ba bzhin du skog gsog 'tshal/ /phyis ni 'chi bdag gtum po'i shab rgyugs kyis/ /khab tsam 'khyer dbang med pa'i dus shig mchi/ /'bad pas 'gog pa/ khyed rnams dges phyir bag yangs mdzod cig ces/ /gleng bar sems kyang thub pa'i bka' rtsi bas/ /kun tu kha na ma tho'i spyod pa dag/ spongs zhes tshig gzhan thon la— ci byar yod/ /gzhan dbang 'gog pa/ bzad lung khro phu'i phyogs nas bstan pa'i khur/ /longs zhes bang yig dmar po zar du phab/ /bdag lus bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i bro nad kyi/ /khyim lags de dang khyed nyid bgro bar 'tshal /thabs kyis 'gog pa/ blo gros gzhon yang bstan pa'i khur lcid pa/ /'degs pa'i gdung ba re zhig bzod par bgyi/ /'phel zad 'khrugs pa kun gzhi4 shi ba yar / /slong nus lha yi bdud rtsi cung zhig sprul/ /khro bas 'gog pa/ deng dus blo chung 'ga' zhig zang zing gi/ ched du dbang bskur tshong la khyi bas brel/ /da ko zab don gdams pa'i khrid 'debs kyang / —/shes par ldan pa su zhig yid ches 'gyur/ /mya ngan dam snying rjes 'gog ba/mchod sprin ma spel sbyin pa'i char ma phab/ /gnyen 'khor 'bangs la bstabs min rang gis kyang / /spyod par ma phod pu sgyu shā tha'i mdzod/ /yud 715

kyis stongs par gyur 'di'i snang tshul gzigs//'gyod pas 'gog pa/tshul gnas khrims kyis lus ngag ma bsdams shing //gzhung lugs rgya mtshor rang blo ma sbyangs la//dben par yang dag 'jog la'ang ma goms pas//gnyis med seng ger gyur pa 'chi khar tshor/ /be tshom 'gog pa/ ci 'di 'bigs byed ngos kyi chu shing ngam//yang na mdzes sdug can de'i gzugs kyi dpal//dal bu'i 'gros kyis nye bar rgyu byed pa'i/ /rnam 'gyur mthong phyir de ni 'khri shing min/ /sbyar ba'i 'gog pa/ rab gtsang dri mas yongs btang sngo bsangs gdong / /gnyis skyes dbang po'i kun gsal yid 'ong ma/ /khyod zhal dag pa'i mkha' dbyings 'di mthong bzhin/ /'dab ldan lam gyi chu mthongs des ci bya//don gzhan 'gog pa/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i thugs//da dung yon tan 'tshol la rings 'di ci//'on kyang mi zad zab yangs chu bo'i gter/ /rtag tu chu phran ma lus sdud la ltos/ /rgyus 'gog pa/ dpa' zhing rtul phod snying gi stobs nyid du/ /gsos pas phyir rgol rnam par gnon to zhes/ /mi bdag khyod la bsngags brjod su zhig sgrub/ /sngon bsags legs par byas de'i mthu kho na/ /bdun pa don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ kud khyab khyad par la gnas dang / /sbyar ba rab dang 'gal ba can//mi 'os byed dang 'os pa'i bdag/'os shing mi 'os de bzlog brgyad/ /ces pa ltar las/ kun khyab kyi don gzhan bkod pa/ kye ma sngon gyi rgyal rabs mtshan ldan pa/ /mtha' dag mi srun skye bos rtsad nas phyung //'dus byas kun gyi rang bzhin 'jig pa'i chos//mkhas kyang gzhan du bsgyur bar ga la bzod/ /khyad par la gnas/ mgon khyod rang bde'i 716

dpal la ma mags par/ /gzhan la phan pa 'ba' zhig spub par mdzad/ /phongs par gyur kyang gzhan don la dgyes pa/ /dam pa dmas kyi lhan skyes rang bzhin yin/ /sbyar ba'i don gzhan bkod pa/ khyod nyid dben pa'i ri bor bag phebs pa/ /'du 'dzi 'khor ba'i rang bzhin mkhyen pa lags/ /gnyis skyes dbang phyug dwangs pa'i mkhar bsgrod la/ /grogs med na yang skye ba yod ma yin/ /'gal ba can/ gzugs dang lang tshos yongs dman bu ston rjes/ /gangs can mkhas pa kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog /bem por gyur kyang kun dga' skyed byed pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i khyad chos ma yin nam/ /mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa/ rgyal bas 'gro la phan dgongs bslab pa rnams/ /kun gyi rtsa ba so sor thar pa zhes/ /gsungs kyang rna bar khab bsregs lta bu yi/ /skal bas phongs pa rnams kyi sdig 'di 'dra/ /'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa/ snying sdug mdzes ma khyod kyi lag sor gyis/ /reg pa tsam gyis bdag lus gdung bar byed/ /dmar pa'i bdag nyid nyi ma las rgyal bas/ /byed chos de lhar snang yang rigs pa lags/ /'os shing mi 'os pa/ khro ldan brlang po'i tshig gis snying 'jigs mod/ /brtse zhing gcugs pa'i gtam gyis ci la 'jigs/ /rab rtsub mtshon chad na pos byed pa'i las/ da jam pa'i rang bzhin can gyis byed 'os sam/ /'di yang/log pa'i chos kyis nyon mongs spel byed mod/ /dam chos thos zhes dregs pa 'chang 'os sam//nun pas snang ba 'gog pa'i 'os yin gyi//snang bas gzugs la sgrib na thabs gzhan med/ /mi 'os shing 'os pa/ gzhung lugs shes nams rnyed dang bkur snyi'i phyir/4rnam 'gyur ston na spud rnams cis mi 'os nya 717

yi 'gro bar gyur kyang dug za na//glen rmongs dud 'gros blang dor shes pa dka'/ /'di yang / dben pa bsten kyang yul la sems 'phro na/ /tshogs nang skye bo 'dod la cis mi sred/ /bsil ldan skyed mos tshal du lus tshig na//mya ngam thang du gdung bar 'os pa lags//brgyad pa bzlog pa can gyi rgyan la/ gcig bzlog gnyis ka'i bzlog pa can/ /sbyor dang 'gog dang gtan tshigs can//sgras zin pa yi dper brjod lnga//dbye ba tsam dang lhag pa nyid/ /sgra mtshungs pa dang rtogs par mtshungs/ /rigs mthun ldog pa can dang bcu//zhes pa ltar las gcig bzlog ni/yid 'phrog mngar ba'i dri ldan 'jam zhing mnyen//dkar mdzes 'jig rten dbang phyug gzugs sku dang / /puṇ+ḍa rī ka mtshungs mod tha dad pa'i/ /'byed chos chos sku rnam 'gyur ldan pas so//gnyis bzlog lha yi rnga bo che dang mgon khyod gsung //snyan cing brjid chags chos sgra sgrogs pa ste/ /des ni sum rtsen gnas kyi khor yug dang / /khyod gsungs khams gsum gdul bya'i rna bar 'jug /sbyor ba'i bzlog pa/dpal ldan mkhas pa khyod dang mi yi dbang //'jigs bral gnas lngar byang zhing lugs kun shes/ /smra mkhas khyod kyis thub pa'i bstan pa dang / /mi yi dbang phyug des ni rang srid skyong / /'gog pa can/mthon por gnas kyang dman pa'i yul la byams//dus las mi yol gzhan don la dgyes kyang //rang nyid mi mthun phyogs las ma rgyal ba//nyin mor byed pas khyod la 'gran nus min/ /gtan tshigs can/ 'khor gyi nang na gzi brjid mtshungs pa med/ /kun la phan pas stoms pa'i phyir rgyu yang / /blun cing 'char nub dbang du gyur pa'i phyir//rgyal po khyod las nyin mor 718

byed pa dkun/ /don gyi go ba las dpe dang dpe can dbye ba tsam/ rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod kyi mdzod spu dngad /ston mtshan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di gnyis kyi/ /'byed chos de ni khyod kyi smin mtshams dang / /ri bong can de mkha' la gnas pas dbye/ /dpe can lhag pa/ ri bong can la 'dzum pa'i mchud sa dang / /rnam bkra'i mig zur g.yo bsab tshan pa med/ /dbyangs kyis la mo'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor di/ /mdzes pa'i khyad chos de dag rnams kyis brgyan/ /mtshungs chos 'byed byed gnyis ka can/ phyag gi yal 'dabazung dang pad+ma dkar/ /'jam mnyen reg na bde ba'i dbal ldan mod/ /phyag sor lha yi rgyud mangs sgra 'byin zhing //pad+ma ra bung ba'i na chung gru len no/ /'byed byed can/ dbang po'i gzhu ris 'khyog po nam mkha'i rgyan/ /rnam bkra'i tshig sbyor 'khyog pob da kyi rgyan/ /mkha' 'di dngos po kun gyi go 'byed cing / /bdag yid shes bya mtha' dag gzugs su 'dzin/ /rigs mthun ldog ba can/ gtsang byed 'bar ba'i phreng bas tshig min zhing //rab dngas chu bo'i rgyun gyis mi 'dag pa//lang shor blo yi dri ma ngad pa 'dis/ /rang bzhin dge bcu'i spyod bzang ngang gis bsgribs//dgu pa srid pa can gyi rgyan la/rgyu 'bras cung zad ston pa la//phyi dang nang gi khyad par gnyis//rang gi ngo bo nyid ston la//gcig ste srid pa can la gsum//zhes pa lhar las/phyi dus la sbyar ba ni/tshon gyis ma bsgyur mthon ka'i ne'u gsing gzhir/ /ma brkem sna tshogs me tog tshom bus mdzes/ /bskul ba min kyang bung ba'i mgrin dbyangs kyis/ /ma 'phrog yid kyi chom rkun dpyid kyi dpal//nang lang tsho bkar ba/ma bkrus dkar ba'i 719

mdangs 'phro gtsug phud dang / /ma bris gnyer ma'i ri mo nyin bzhin 'phel//ma bsdus par yang sems kyi 'phro 'du kun//cig car 'dus pa'i lang tsho bdag gis thob/ /ngo bo tsam ston pa/ ma bskyed sred pa'i 'khor lo yangs pa 'dir/ /ma phyis las dang nyon mongs cir yang bkra/ /ma btab bdag 'dzin mdud pa dam po yis//ma bzung thar dus med 'dis skyo ba la/ /bcu pa bsdus brjod kyi rgyan la/ spyi dang khyad gzhi tha dad dang / /khyad par tha dad tha dad min/ /sngon med bsdus pa brjod dang bzhi/ /zhes pa lhar las spyi'i bsdus brjod ni/ phun tshogs 'bras du'i khur ldan rab 'thor 'phags/ /grib bsil khor yug yangs pa'i ljon pa che/ /ring du btang nas shing skam yal ga la/ /'ga' zhig bsil ba'i dngos po re ba mthong / /khyad gzhi tha dad khyad chos gcig pa'i bsdus brjod/'khril ldem rnam bkra mdzes pa'i chu bar brten//'jam mnyen 'dab ma'i dpal rgyas dri bsung zhim/ /ge sar phun tshogs pad dkar sdong bu 'di/ /kho bo'i nyer spyad mchog tu rnam par rgyu//khyad chos tha dad mi dad pa/lus grims rkang pa brgyad pa'i sha tshugs kyis/ /dus kun da lar 'gying rngam rngam 'dra/ /don gyi bya bar zhugs tshe bem po'i dngos/ /de 'drar mtshar du 'dzin rnams byis pa'i blo/ /sngon med bsdus brjod/ lag 'gro gdug pa'i 'khril bag mi ldan zhing / /tsub mo'i tsher ma dag kyang mi snang ba'i/ /rab bsil gdung ba 'phrog pa'i tsan na shing //skal ba bzang por ldan pa'i dpal du thob/ /bcu gcig pa phul byung gi rgyan la/ khyad 'phags the tshom nges pa dang / /grags pa brjod pa'i phul byung bzhi/ /zhes pa lhar las/ khyad 720

'phags brjod pa'i phul byung ni/ rab dmar bse yi ya lad kyis brjid cing / /'char ka'i mdangs ldan gdong lag khrag gis gsher/ /dmar ba'i chibs ldan rdo rje bdud 'dul sku/ /bskal pa'i me dpung dbus na mtshon ma yin/ /the tshom phul byung ni/ bar kyi mkhyen pa'i lam du ma song pa'i zab rgyas chos kyi dgongs don phra mo 'ga'/ /'khor dang zu ngan 'das pa'i yul gar yang / /yod med ci zhes bdag yid 'phyang mo nyug /nges pa'i phul byung / ma/ga pa'i ye shes mchog de da dung yang / /shes bya'i khams la mngon par chags sbyar ba'i/ /rnam 'gyur mthong 'dis don du gnyer bya'i chos/ /da dung nges phar srid la the mi tshom/ /grags pa phul byung / rnam 'dren khyod thugs bslab gsum rin po che'i/ /yon tan phung pos mngon par khengs pa'i lcid/ /g.yo med 'degs par bzod pa'i nor 'dzin ma/ /chu gter klong du ma bying ngo mtshar che/ /yang na/ srid par 'tshal lo cog gi mi dge'i las/ /dal med bgyis pa rnam smin khur klu ba/ /thogs bar gyed du 'degs bzod 'dzin ma'i lha/ /ngal ba'i 'khun bu mi 'byin ya mtshan che/ /bcu gnyis pa rab rtog gi rgyan la/ don gyi sems ldan sems med gnyis/ /sgra yis snyam dang dogs dang nges/ shad dang min nam bzhin zhes drug /ces pa ltar las/ sems ldan rab rtog snyam sgra can/ gangs stongs bsil ba'i reg byas dbyangs lha mo/ /grang bas nyen te kho bo'i snying dbus su/ /dri za'i 'jig rted rdzogs pa'i snyad tshig gru/ /len pa'i zol gyis bag phab gnas sam snyam/ /dogs sgra can/ gang gi mig gi mdzes pa phul byung ba/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i mtshar sdug bang mdzod lag —gnus pa'i nyes pas 721

skrag pa'i ut+pal dang //ri dwags nams ni nags su bros par dogs//nges sgra can/mdzes ma khyod kyi bzhin gyi yon tan dmas//bag med bzung ba'i pad+ma gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /gang gi skra tshogs dag la bcings mthong ste/ /rgyu skar rgyal po mkha' la 'dzeg par nges//'dra ba'i sgra can/dpyid dus nyi ma gzhon nu chags pa yi//lus drod 'bar ba'i rngul thigs zags pa'i rgyun//smig rgyu'i dra bar 'dzings tshe pad+ma rnams/ /so phreng rab gsal dgod par byed pa 'dra/ /min nam sgra can/ mig sman mdog 'chang srod kyi phra men mas/ /nyi bzhon dum bur gtubs pa'i bye ma kun/ /mkha' la ster ba min nam skar tshogs rnams//rang rang 'od kyi snang ba 'phro zhing 'du//bzhin sgra can/g.yem la rjes chags sngo bsangs mkha'i bu mo'i//rgyu skar do shal thag pa chad pa'i tshe//skya rengs snang ba dang 'grogs srid pa'i mig/bgrad nas gling bzhi kun tu 'tshol bzhid rgyu//bcu gsum pa rgyu'i rgyan la/rgyu ni dngos por gyur ba dang / /rnam grangs 'ga' yis dngos med du/ /bgrang ba'i rgyu dang mtshar rgyu 'o//dngos po'i rgyu la byed po dang //shes byed rnam pa gnyis su yod/ /byed po la yang dbye ba gsum//'grub bya rnam 'gyur 'thob byed do//'grub bya la'ang rnam gnyis te//skyed byed rgyu dang nyams byed rgyu//shes par byed pa'i rgyu la gnyis//phyi dang nang gi shes byed rgyu'o//dngos med rgyu ni med dgag bzhi/ /ma yin dgag pa gcig dang lnga/ /snga nas med dang zhig nas med//phan tshun med dang spangs nas med//bzlog pa skyed byed rgyu rnams so//ring 'bras de dang lhan cig skyes//de bzhin 'bras ma thag skyes dang / /rigs min rigs pa byed ces pa'i/ /mtshar ba'i rgyu ni re zhig lnga/ /722

dril bas rgyu rgyan bcu drug go /zhes pa lhar las/ skyed byed kyi rgyu/ skye bo zags par byed pa'i rgyan rnams sga /chas sum gas bcug yan lag lnga rdzogs pa/ /nyams 'gyur gsar du rol ba'i stang stabs can/ /zlos pa'i gar gyis 'jig rten kun dgar byed//nyams byed kyi rgyu//lang tshos khengs pa'i gzugs kyi skabs dag dang //'tshams par yongs pe gos dang rgyan de yis/ /rab sbyangs nyams dang ldan pa'i gar mdzes pas thar 'dod snying gi dga' ba nyam par byas/ /rnam par 'gyur ba'i rgyu/ rin chen gzhal med khang dang rtse ba'i nags//lus ma ma rnams 'jo sgeg rol pa'i gar//bsam gyis mi khyab dpal dang 'byor ba'i sde//nges 'byung rgyas la gshin rje'i tshal 'drar snang //'thob byed rgyu/phan par 'dod rnams tshe 'di'i tre bya la/ /bskul ba'i snying gtam rna bar zo byed kyang / /tshogs gnyis dam pa'i lam las mi 'khyod pa'i/ /bsam dang sbyor ba'i—ri mo ci yang brtsams/ /'di yang / khyod nyid 'dod bsred pa skyungs shig ces/ /grogs dag rang gi bdag po'i brtul zhugs ma'i/ /gam du bkod der mdzes ldan gzhon nu zhig /rab tu 'dzum bcas mig zur 'phed par byed/ /spyi'i dus shes byed kyi rgyu1 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor snum bag zal gyur cing / /nyal 'gro ma rnams chab rom gur du 'ibs/ /nyin byed 'od zer yan lag bskums pa'i dus/ /bdag kyang mal chung gru bzhir mnyam par 'jog /nang shes byed kyi rgyu/ grogs khyod srid pa'i sgyu mas yid byung ba/ /'dir snang rtsed 'jo'i rol bas mi khugs shing / /mdza' gcugs gtam gyi snang bas mi gsal ba'i/ /ngo 'dzum gnying nas dkar ba min 723

'dis rtogs//snga ma med pa'i dngos rgyu/me tog lam la bgrod par ma byas shing / /gzhon nu'i brla yi 'khri shing ma bsrubs la/ /yal 'dab lnga pa'ang ngal bar byas min par/ /dran pa'i ka chen 'gyel 'dis snang ba skyo/ /zhig nas med pa'i byed rgyu/snying la rab chags dpyid kyi mthu nyams shing //lang tsho'i rims las 'bar ba'i gdung ba yal//yul gyi rjes su rgyug pa'i shes pa yang / /'grib phyir sgad ma'i gnas skabs kho na sems/ /phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu/ mkho dgu tshang ba'i dra phad rgyal srid min/ /pus 'khyud sgom thag skor cig chung ma'ang min//mnyam bzhag gnyen 'khor skyong ba'i 'og 'gyu la/ /'byams pa min 'dis skyid pa'i nyams shig shar/ /'di yang /rnam gsum chos kyi gos bzang go khrab mid/ /lung dang rigs tshul bzang po mtshon cha min//legs bshad smra ba'i grwa 'di g.yul gyi ngo //ma lags de phyir bdag gi sems dga' 'o//spangs nas med pa'i byed rgyu/zag bcas 'dod la chags myos 'dzin pa'i se sa/ /dgra bco 'phags pa'i tshogs la yod min pas//rgyu des de dag rnams kyi thugs rgyud la//zag med yon tan tshogs kun ngang gis 'phel//bzlog pa skyed byed kyi rgyu/ khyod kyis tshar gcod tshad ma'i lam bzang por/ /lang tsho'i dus su ma zhugs pa min na/ /lung rigs byang ba'i rlom 'chang gnyer ma'i rgyan//'dzin mkhas phal gyis gleng ba'i spobs pa bral/ /ring 'bras rgyu/ ngag gi dbang phyug sangs rgyas rdo rje yis/ /klu spub rgya mtshor 'phyar ba'i lung rigs zil/ /ma bzod thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i khrir//'gying ba'i mkhan slob gnyis kyang mnal thabs chag/lhan cig pa'i rgyu/ rnam 'dren ngag gi dbang pos dbyangs lha 724

mo//yid kyi khab tu bag mar phyin ba dang //mnyam du snyan tshig sbyor ba'i blo gros kyi//zhing khams mtha' dag cig car snang bar gyur//rgyu las 'bras bu snga ba/ rdul bral stong pa'i gzugs mdzes gzhon nu mas//sngar nyid 'khyud de sngon goms mthur nges nas/ /zab lam rdo rje'am rnal 'byor yan lag drug/slad nas rang gi rgyud la brtan par byas//rigs min rgyu/mkhas mang bzhed pa'i rjes su ba yis//tshig rgyan 'khyog por gyur pa ma bzod pa'i//nyam chung rmongs pas gzhung don drang po ru/ /bsrang ba'i dper brjod 'grub 'di rigs sam ci/ /rigs pa'i rgyu/skyes thob gsal ba'i blo de dam pa yi/ /mgon gyis zin pas dka' ba'i gnad rnams༅na//nur nur sub sub ma yin mtha' chod par/ /'grel nus 'di yang rigs shing 'os pa nyid//bcu bzhi pa phra mo'i rgyan la/zur dang rnam pas mtshon pa'i don//phra phyir phra mo zhes par brjod/ /ces pa ltar las/ zur gyis phra mo ni/ tshogs dbus lang tsho rab rdzogs zla bzhin mas/ /dngul dkar dri med las bsgrubs bzhin gyi snod/ —/mkha' la 'phyar te sa gzhir btsugs pa'i 'gram/ /kuna'i ba tog zung zhig bzhag nas song / /dam pa'i phra mo/ bud med sgyu ma'i tshul mthong gzhon nu de'i/ /mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal ba dmar ba'i bzhin/ /g.yo med lha yi rje sa song 'dren byed kyis//mthong nas snying la 'da' dka'i dam tshigs byas//bco lnga pa za'i rgyan la/rang lugs rang bzhin gsal sgrib la/ /'os pa'i cha dang mi 'os cha/ /gzhan bzhad cha las smad dang bstod//ces pa ltar las/zol gyis sped pa'i 'os pa'i cha/ /tshogs dbus gsung rab dka' ba'i gnas dag la/ /'bel mchid gleng tshe 725

ldab ldib sgra gzhan dang //glo 'gog lud pa lu 'di byang khog khyams//rnag gis zos pa'i rang nyams sba nus sam//mi 'os pa'i cha chas bzang mdzes ma'i dbus su dka' thub can/ /bzhin nyams lus kyi 'khri shing 'dar ba yang / /nges 'byung gsar ba rgyas pas 'khor ba yi/ /rang bzhin dran pas lags mod gzhan du ci//smad pa'i cha/snyigs dus 'dren pa mchog 'dis lang tsho'i dus/ /tha snyad rig pa'i chos tshul kun la sbyangs/ /nang gi rnal 'byor tsam la'ang ma chags par//rtsom 'chad rtsod pa'i bya bas rgyal bstan 'dzin/ /cha las bstod pa/ mgon khyod tha snyad bslu ba'i chos su gzigs/ /'byor pas bsod dmas bya ba'i gzhi mi rtsom/ /dben par gab pa'i yang dag 'jog tshul 'dis//da ni 'gro ba'i don kyang yal du dogs//bcu drug pa rim pa can gyi rgyan ni/ bgrang bya'i khur gyis yongs su ngal gyur pa'i/ /lus can khyod kyi mgo skyes 'dren byed lus/ /zla nyi nam mkha'i me long yongs bzhu ba'i/ /zhun mas byugs par nges so bgres po lags/ /bcu bdun pa dga' ba'i rgyan la/ dngos po thob dang gzugs brnyan las/ /byung ba'i dga' ba rnam pa gnyis//zhes pa lhar las//dngos thob kyi dga' ba/ 'gyur med lhod por gnas pa'i gshis legs po//snying gi grogs khyod bdag mdun speb pa yi/ /dga' ba 'di tsam gzhan gyis snyer nus su/ /da dung yang yang phebs dang sngon mo tog/gzugs brnyan gyi dga' ba/phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal rnams kun//ma lus 'dus zhal bye ba'i za ma tog /kun mkhyen dpag bsam yongs 'du'i dbang po'i zhal/ /legs byas yangs pa'i mig gis mngon sum mthong //bco brgyad pa nyams ldan 726

gyi lhon la/slob dpon ba ba 'grel pa las/dga' ba dgod bro mya ngan dang //khro dang spro dang de bzhin 'jigs//skyug bro ngo mtshar zhes pa rnams//gnas byed 'gyur bar rab tu grags/ /'gyur bar de 'phel nyams yin te/ /sgeg dang dgod dang snying rje dang / /drag po dpa' ba 'jigs byed dang / /mi sdug rmad byung ming can zhes/ /brgyad rnams gar gyi nyams su bshad//ces gsung /'dir gzhung las byung ba/ dga' ba'i 'gyur 'phel sgeg dang drag/dpa' ba dang ni snying rje'i nyams//de bzhin gzhan yang mi sdug dang / /bzhad gad rmad byung 'jigs rung brgyad/ /ces pa lhar las/snyeg pa'i nyams ni/ legs par byas pa'i tshogs rab rgya che bas/ /bskal par bsgrubs 'os rang sems chos kyi sku/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i drin las tshe 'di kar/ /tshegs med mngon du byas 'di ci zhig yin/ /drag shul gyi nyams/ rab 'jigs bdud kyi mgon po seng ge'i zhal/ /dmar ba'i spyan gsum yon por lha ba yi/ /mdun sar nyams pa bdun ldan bstan pa'i dgra/ /srog rtsa rdo rjer song yang tshugs sam ci//dpa' ba'i nyams/lo mang spub pa'i khang par ma yib cing //ra ka'i phreng gog zad zad ma mnyes la//ral pa'i khur dang sma ra'i rgyan med par//bstan dgra ming tsam lhag mar byas 'di ci//'di yang /'jam mgon bsnyen pa'i gsang sngags ma bzlas shing //thos bsam sgom la rtag par 'grus min kyang //gzhung lugs 'bum sde'i ngang tshul ma 'dres par//gsal por mthong pa'i blo mig 'di ci zhig/snying rje'i nyams/ dar zab mal du bder mnal rnga yab kyis//bsil ba'i dus su slong ba mi'i dbang phyug/gzhon sha lhag par rgyas gang mnar med 727

kyi/ /me sbo 'khrugs pa'i tshal du ji ltar gzims/ /mi sdug pa'i(sgyug bro ba)nyams/skra bzas phub lhar rab gdangs kha yi sgor//rang gi nang khrol phyir phyung slar za ba'i//ro langs tshogs rnams ser skya'i klad pa dag/lug kyang 'khyams shing 'khyams shing gar bsgyur ro/ /bzhad gad kyi nyams/ tshangs par spyod ldan khyod nyid be rgan gyi/ /lo mar dgyes pa'i me tog thos pa 'dzin/ /ser skyar kha dog mthun pa'i rang rigs kyang / /cod pan sgro them mdzes pas sgrib par mdzod//rmad byung gi nyams/lha dang grub pas bsten 'os dben pa 'dir/ /lhun stug gor ma nor du'i khri 'phang dang / /chu 'dzin gdugs dkar bser bu'i rnga yab g.yob/ /nyi zla'i 'od zer sgron mar gyur pa mtshar/ /'jigs rung gi nyams/ dug chen 'khyil 'dra'i sku dang srid pa gsum//kham du byed pa'i gdangs zhal ha har bzhad//mtshon cha'i char 'bebs phyag rgya zil gnon lha/ /mthong tshe khro bo'i tshogs kun lag cha 'brul//bcu dgu pa gzi brjid can gyi rgyan ni/lung rigs smra ba'i seng ge kho bo'i mdun//phyir rgol lag ldan stong gi snying 'gems zhes//bag 'khums mi 'os kho bo'i zhabs skyes rdul/ /spyi bor 'ching rnams spobs pa mchog tu dge/ /nyi shu pa rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ kho bo dben pa'i yon tan blta ba'i phyir/ /zhag 'ga' ri bo'i sul nas sul du rgyu/ /grogs dag yid 'ong khyim 'dir dus de srid/ /blo dang bag brkyangs lhan cig bzhugs 'tshal lo/ /nyer gcig pa kun tu phan pa'i rgyan ni/ ngan 'gro'i gnas lugs thos pas skyi g.ya' zhing / /rang gi las tshul dran pas zhe 'tsher dus/ /'du ba glo dur 'khrugs pa'i ltar snang nad/ /las sgrib sbyong 728

ba'i thabs su lha yis byin/ /nyer gnyis pa rgya che ba'i rgyan la/ bsam dang sbyor ba rgya che gnyis//zhes pa ltar las/bsam pa rgya che ba ni/bstan srung rgya mtshos ci bsgo'i las sgrub phyir//'gro mang dus kyi kha sgor 'jug spobs pa//rig sngags 'chang des rgyu 'bras ngang tshul la/ /gzigs nas bstan dgra 'ga' zhig byang grol bkod/ /'byor pa rgya che ba/ rin chen khams las yongs grub gzhal med kyi/ /khang par rab dgyes bcom ldan mi 'khrugs mgon//gcig nyid kun tu 'char yang 'khrul med du//gang drung zab mo'i chos nyan 'dus pa'i sde/ /'di yang / rin chen bye ba las grub ba la/ /gcig nyid la yang dam pa thams cad pa'i/ /rang gzugs dag pa'i snang ba rab 'byams su//res kyis 'char ba mngon par dga' ba'i zhing //nyer gsum pa bsnyon dor gyi rgyan ni/ chos la bston dang yul la bsnyon/ /rang bzhin bsnyon dor gsum du bshad//ces pa ltar las/chos la bston pa ni/rnam 'dren dus 'khor zhabs de'i mkhyen rab ni//gcig nyid yin na chos kun ji ltar gzigs//shes byar gang srid tshig don mtha' yas pa//mkhyen pas bye ba phrag brgya'i grangs kyang brgal/ /yul la bston pa/ zur phud lnga ldan lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid/ /nu stegs bye ba stong gi blo gros la/ /nun pa'i dngos po gsar du sbyin po ste/ /gzhan du shes rab gsal ba'i lha zhes grags//rang bzhin la bston pa/ dga' ba gsar ba gsar ba 'phel byed cing //yid rjes mthun la dga' byed ma zhes bod//bzhin ngan tsaṇ+ḍa'i 'di mthong ma thag /dbang med yi ga ldog par byed la ltos//nyer bzhi pa sbyar ba'i rgyan ni/don gnyis tshig gi gcod mtshams gcig/gcod mtshams tha 729

dad tshig 'dra dang //'ga' zhig bya ba tha dad min//gzhan pa bya ba 'gal min yod/ / 'gal ba'i las can dag kyang gzhan/ /sbyar ba nges pa can yang yod/ /nges par 'gog pa'i gzugs brjod dang //'gal min 'gal ba can dang dgu/ /zhes pa lhar las/ tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba ni/ gnyis skyes tshogs kyi dbus na mngon mtho ba//mgrin sngon can gyi gtsug phud la gnas pa'i//yid 'ong 'od kyi thig le gsar chags pa//dpal 'di 'jig rten kun gyi yi gar 'ong //tha dad tshig 'dra'i sbyar ba/las kyi rang bzhin sna tshogs shing rta yis/ /bskyod pa'i dpal gyi 'dab ma yid 'ong ma/ /yang dang yang du srid par 'khor 'gro ba//'di dag rnams la gtad so ji lhar yod//bya ba tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba/ rang bzhin mi brtan gya gyu'i bgrod pa can//kun gyi thun mong spyad byar gyur pa'i yul//dbyar gyi chu klung rab tu rgyas pa dang / /lang tsho mas kyang skye bo thur du 'dren/ /bya ba 'gal ba'i sbyar ba/ bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dri mar gyur pa rnams//dag byed tshad mas 'gro ba'i yid bsil ba/ /legs par bshad pa'i chos ni thos byas te/ /bslab gzhi'i rim pa rgyud la brtan par bya//'gal ba'i las can gyi sbyar ba/ lus can snying la nyal ba'i nus pa yis/ /lus skyes g.yo sogs 'gyur ba gsal byed pa//'dod la chags pa de ni yongs nyams nas//yon gnas mchog la dad pa rab tu 'phel//nges pa can gyi sbyar ba/ke sa ra dang rjes 'brel ka : kas//brgyan cing bdud rtsi brten las gnyis skyes phreng //mdzes ldan pad+ma can gyi chos de dag /snying sdug 'di yi lus la nges par gnas/ /nges pa 'gog pa'i sbyar ba/ phyogs 'dir sred ldan khyod kyis ma bgrod 730

pa'i/ /lus phra skye ba'i lam rab ster ba'i ma//'on kyang ma nges skye med tshal ldan pa'i/ /sngo bsangs nam mkha'i bu mo dag kyang mthong / /'gal med kyi sbyar ba/ pad+ma'i tshal gnas las bltams rang byung sku/ /'gro ba'i tog khyod 'khor los phyag zung mdzes/ /'chi med dbang phyug bdud rtsi spro ba'i lha/ /steng 'phur rgyal pos sum—brtsegs grong khyer 'jig/'gal ba can gyi sbyar ba/ kun mkhyen yin kyang rab chags kun rtog spangs/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug yin kyang lag 'gror rtse//sha ba ra ste khyu mchog gcod mi byed/ /lha nyid yin kyang 'gro bar gtogs pa yin/ /nyer lnga pa khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan la/ yon tan rigs dang bya ba rdzas/ /rgyu yi khyad par brjod pa lnga/ /zhes pa ltar las/ yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa/ tshangs par spyod ldan khyod kyi bla gos ni//mkhrigs min sra ba ma yin mthug pa'ang min/ /de lta na yang me tog gzhu can gyis/ /mtshon char ji tsam phab kyang ba ji ma lags//rigs ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa/sgyu rtsal mkhan 'di hor gyi rgyal khams dang //ku sha'i grong na spyod pa'i rigs min yang //'di na lang tsho'i stobs can snyems 'chang kun/ /ra skyes gzhon nu'i lang tshor mngon par sbyor/ /bya ba ma tshang ba'i khyad par brngod pa/ mdzes pa'i mig zur 'khyog pos ma btab la/ /yid 'ong 'dzum pa'i rlabs kyis ma bsus shing / /phebs par spru ba'i gtam gyis brid min par/ /bdag yid dbang med 'phrog mkhas mar ston rje/ /rdzas ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa/dpa' ba'i dmag dpung yan lag bzhi med cing / /sra zhing no ba'i go mtshon mi ldan yang / /rig sngags tsam gyis rte du'i tshul bzung ba'i/ /dgra 731

tshogs dus gcig gzhom mkhas thos pa dga'/ /rgyu ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa/ dka' thub gdung bas lus kyi mdangs nyams shing / /grogs med go mtshon lta ci gos kyang dman//'on kyang rtogs pa'i dbang phyug mi la rjes/ /'jig rten lha mir bcas kun zil gyis mnan/ /nyer drug pa mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan la/ bstod dang smad pa'i dbye ba yi/ /mtshungs sbyor rgyan 'di rnam pa gnyis//zhes pa ltar las/bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor/sngon byon 'phags pa'i yul du dka'i zhabs/ /bod 'dir 'jigs bral dbyangs can dga' ba'i lha/ /da lta de yi bstan la chos kyi grags/ /snyan tshig smra ba'i sgra 'di rnam par 'dzin//smad pa'i mtshungs sbyor/skye bo'i mig sngar 'khyer legs tshul 'chos khrims//las 'bras mi bsam kha bshad skam po'i chos/ /stong pa'i tshon gyis legs bris dbang po'i gzhu/ /mdzes kyang nam zhig snying po'i rang mtshang ston/ /nyer bdun pa 'gal rgyan la/ khyad gzhi tha dad bya ba 'gal/ /gzhi gcig yon tan gnyis 'gal dang / /rdzas 'gal rdzas dang las 'gal ba//bya ba 'gal dang sbyar 'gal drug/zhes pa ltar las/ khyad gzhi tha dad pa'i bya ba 'gal ba/ thar pa 'dod rnams dri med bslab gzhi'i rgyun//snying la sems pas rab dga'i snang ba rgyas//lus med phyogs gyur nag po'i rtsa lag rnams/ /dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur rab spangs mya ngan 'dzin//ga'i gcig yon tan 'gal ba/nges par rnam bkra 'dod pa'i yon tan tshogs/ /tshar du dngar bas thar pa'i bya ba rnams/ /'khrul pa ma rtags nyams su bde ba yi//rnam par g.yeng ba'i tshogs 'di nyin bzhin 'phel/ /rdzas 'gal ba/ mgo skyes rab tu dkar yang bzhin 732

ras sngo/ /yan lag gyong yang myos byed 'khri shing mnyen/ /lus nyid 'khyog kyang rang sems drang po ru/ /bgrang ba rgan po'i lang tshos su ma bcom /rdzas dang las 'gal ba/ rma bya'i mjug sgro'i zur phud zla ba'i bzhin/ /pad+ma'i mchu sgros rgyu skar phreng ba'i tshems/ /ri dwags mig dang ldan pa'i lus phra mas/ /bdag cag 'khor ba'i mal du ci phyir 'ching / /bya ba 'gal ba/ dgun gyi grang reg kha ba'i rdu la brtsegs dang / /'grogs pa mnga' ris stod kyi rlung ngar las/ /lus la reg pa min yang don mthun khyu/ /bzhin nyams ba spu'i 'khri shing 'dar bar 'gyur//sbyor ba can gyi 'gal ba/ rol pa'i gnas su rab 'khrungs ha ri taḥ / /'chi med bde ba byin la mthu che yang / /re zhig bcud mi ldan pa'i dbang gyur tshe/ /yid brtan byed pa'i ji rje su zhig /nyer brgyad pa skabs min gyi bstod ba'i rgyan di/ gzhan sems bsrung ba'i khral med rang dbang can/ /dri ldan me tog gsar pa'i bcud kyis 'tsho/ /bar snang yangs por bde ba'i snang glus 'khor/ /yid 'ong sprang rtsi'i bu 'di skyid pa la/ /nyer dgu pa zol bstod kyi rgyan la/ mthu dang dba' ba phun tshogs te//stobs kyis sbyar pa'i phun tshogs dang //zol gyis bstod pa'i dbye ba gsum//zhes pa ltar las/mthu dun tshogs kyi zol bstod/ 'khos bral mi 'u thung gis sa gsum po/ /mnan nas stobs ldan 'dzin ma'i 'og tu bcings/ /rgyal bo khyod kyis 'dzam sping sa'i dkyil 'khor//dbang du byas pa tsam la kheng da mi 'tshal//dpa' ba phun tshogs kyi zol bstod/ smra mkhas khyod kyis rgol ba'i spobs pa kun/ /blogs nas 'dar zhing zhum pa la sbyor ba/ /las 'bras41la la gzigs pa mi dman 733

pa'i/ /shākya'i sras po khyod kyis rigs sam ci/ /stobs phun tshogs kyi zol bstod/ khyod kyi slob tshogs ngang pa'i bu mo yi/ /longs spyod kun dang thun mong nyid gyur na//ci phyir khyod zhabs bsten las smra ba ni//chen por gyur pa'i khengs pa 'dzin rigs sam//sum cu pa nges bstan gyi rgyan la/dpe yi 'jug pa don de nyid//mchog gam mchog min ston pa gnyis//zhes pa lhar las/ mchog gi nges bstan/ ngag la ngag gi dpal ster dbyangs lha mo'i//phang par rab mdzes shel gyi nge rar/ /sen mos btab bskyod yid 'ong snyan sgrogs pa//brtse bas yongs bskul chos don smra ba mtshon//mchog min nges bstan/ lang tsho ldan ma de yi brang gi gzhir/ /rab rgyas nu ma'i shel bum zung mdzes pa//sra zhing mkhregs pas gang gi dbang gyur la//nam zhig snying nyid sra ba nges par ston/ /so gcig pa lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan la/yon tan las rnams lhan cig brjod//gzhi gcig bya ba gcig pa ste//lhan cig brjod pa'i dbye ba gsum/ /zhes pa ltar las/ yon tan lhan cig brjod pa/ lang tsho'i dpal las byung ba'i gzi mdangs dang / /yid 'ong pad+ma gzhon nu lhan cig mdzes/ /gang gi blo dang stobs kyi rang bzhin dang //dri bzang khang pa'i chu ba lhan cig bkra//las lhan cig brjod pa/kye ma 'byung 'khrugs nad kyi zug rngu dang / /lhan cig rus tshigs mdud pa rnam par rgyas/ /lus kyi nyams bag gzi mdangs tshogs rnams dang / /rbongs pa'i grogs po nyid ni mnyam du yal/ /bya ba gcig pa'i lhan cig brjod pa/ srid pa'i skyon gyis rab bskyed skyo ba dang / /thar pa'i yon tan dran pa'i dad pa dang //de rgyu dge la 'dun pa'i brtson 'grus te//gsum 734
