po 'di ni lhan cig 'phel bar gyur/ /so gnyis pa yongs brjes kyi rgyan la/spyan ras gzigs mgon khyod kyis 'gro rnams la/ /phan dang bde ba'i dngos po kun bstsal nas/ /de dag kun gyi yid kyi dbang po ni/ /lhag ma med par cig car nyid du phrogs/ /so gsum pa shis brjod kyi rgyan la/ smra bsam brjod pa'i yul 'das zung 'jug gi /ye shes rang gzugs nges pa lnga ldan yang / /ris med 'gro ba'i snang ngor de snyed skus/ /rjes 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtshos khyod la srungs//so bzhi pa rab spel gyi rgyan la/bsgrub bya spub byed 'brel mtshungs pa'i/ /skabs dang thams cad stobs mtshungs gnyis/ /zhes pa ltar las/ spub byed 'brel mtshungs kyi rab spel/ pad+ma gzhon nu'i dpal 'phrog dbyangs can lha'i/ /bzhin ras ma bris mtshan dpe'i ri mo can//yid 'phrog ke sa ras mtshan 'jig rten gyi//kun dga' skyed pa lhan skyes rang bzhin yin/ /stobs mtshungs rab spel/ zhi ba'i dbyings las drag por khros pa'i sku//ral pa'i nags su rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas lnga/ /thod skam zol gyis ma bos par 'dus pa/ /dpal gyi mgon pos dgra bgegs lhan cig thul//so lnga pa dgongs pa can gyi rgyan ni/snyan ngag mkhan po'i tshig gi rgyan/ sbyor ba'i bsam pas bstan bcos de grub pa'i bar du rgyun gyis yul la khyab pa/ ngag dmas phan tshun phan par byed pa'i 'brel ba can/ dgos don dang bral ba'i tshig spangs pa/ bstod pa'i gnas 'os pa kho nar bsngags pa/ brjod pa'i shugs las brjod 'dod kyi dngos po zab mo dag kyang gsal bar nus pa de rnams tshogs pa la rgyan de 'byung bas/ tshigs su bcad pa de lta bu tshe tshe ba'i rgyan min te/ slob 735

dpon ngag gi dbang phyug gi 'grel par de ni gzhung gi rgyun la yod pa yin pas tshigs bcad gcig dang gnyis la sogs pa'i yul la yod par 'dod pa nye bar gsal lo zhes dang //dpang los/dang po dang /bar dang /tha ma rnams su rgyun la rjes su 'jug pas 'di ni rgyan thams cad kyi yang rgyan du gyur pa'o//zhes gsungs pa de nyid legs par bshad pa'o//zhes pa ni/don gyi rgyan gyi yongs su bcad pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o//sgra yi rgyan la bya sga ba//zung ldan dang po gnas gsum gyi//bar ma chod dang bar chod dang / /chod cing ma chod khyad par las/ /rkang pa gcig gnyis gsum bzhi la/ /re re gnyis gnyis gsum gsum bzhir/ /bar ma chod pa'i khyad par gyi//dbye ba dam pa bco lnga yod//thog ma'i bar ma chod rkang pa dang por/ ldem ldem shel gyis lhug phran brgya byin gyi/ /tshon dang bcas par mtshan dpe'i 'od ris rnams/ /tshangs chen yid kyis bris 'dra'i mtshar sdug can//rdo rje dbyangs can ma des rjes su zungs//rkang pa gnyis par/ sgra rgyan bai zur dkar po'i da ra/ /snyan snyan rna ba'i bdud rtsir 'dod 'jo mkhan/ /ngag gi dbang mos yongs brtan mkhas pa'i mgrin/ /dri med shel gyi kun dga' ra ba bzhin//rkang pa gsum par/shes bya'i rjes song rnam dpyod yangs pa'i mkha'/ /chos tshul rdzogs ldan sprin phung can dbus na/ /dir dir legs bshad lha yi da nyiḥ//thos pa'i rna ba don ldan nyid du byed//rkang pa bzhi par/me tog 'bras bu'i mngon mtho nor gyi bu'i//'khri shing dra bas yongs bskor rgya mtsho'i 'gram//tshangs pa'i drang srong bsam gtan la chags pa/ /zim zim lta byed dbang po'i rnam 736

'gyur bral/ /bar ma chod gnyis la yod par dang po gnyis/ ling ling 'phur zhing lding ba'i 'dab chags khyu//kyur kyur mgrin pa'i gling bu bsgyur mkhas rnams/ /dri za'i 'jig rten las bzhin skal bzang gi/ rna ba bdud rtsi'i khang par skrub par brel/ /dang po dang gsum par/ lhag lhag gdengs can dbang po'i 'od tshogs kyis//kun tu gsal bar byas pa'i yid bzhin mtsho/ /chil chil rlabs kyi zegs ma 'phro ba dmas/ /nu nyig do shal thag pa chad pa bzhin/ /dang po dang bzhi bar/ 'dzum 'dzum lha phreng rab gsal zla ba dang //zil zegs rgyu skar phung por 'khrul 'dzin pa'i//yid bzhin mtsho dang ston dus dag pa'i mkha'/ /gsal gas 'byed chos mtho dman gnas kyis dbye/ /gnyis pa dang gsum par/ dal bus rlung gis 'dzum pa'i ba rlabs phreng / /chil chil g.yo zhing bsgyur bas lus gsher ba/ /snyan snyan mgrin pa'i rdza rnga khor yug tu/ /brdung mkhas chu bya 'bum gyis nye bar stod/ /gnyis pa dang bzhi bar/ gser gyi khu bas bran pa'i 'od kyi rlabs/ /'khyil 'khyil 'bar ba'i pad+ma chen po dang / /puṇ+ḍa rī ka ut+pal ku nud dang / /'grig 'grig tshar du dngar bas kun nas brgyan/ /gsum pa dang bzhi par/ dpal gos ral bar ngom pa'i mtshar sdug dang //dri bsung zhim pos gcus pa bung ba'i khyu/ /zir zir snyan pa'i gru len 'dab ma zung / /ling ling g.yo zhing 'phur ba'i sum rtsen no/ /bar ma chod gsum la yod par dang po gsum/ 'khyog 'a dag mgrin pa41gas pa'i phyi mig gis/ /yang yang dul bar blta ba 'ib ba sgyugs mo/ /'jam 'jam rtswa ljang mal na phru gur bcas/ /bag bag dwangs pa'i mtsho la zla ga sa bzhin/ /dang po dang 737

gnyis pa bzhi par/ 'khyil 'khyil mdangs 'od 'bar ba'i sgro tshogs rnams/ /mdzes mdzes klum por byas pa'i gdugs mtshar bo//bskor ba rma bya'i bu mo kun dga'i mig /ling ling char sprin sngon po'i dbus na blta/ /dang po dang phyi ma gnyis la/ lhang lhang 'gyur khugs rdzogs pa'i mgrin pa'i gru//dal gyis 'then pa'i khu byug bu mo'i tshogs//ljang ljang ma rgad lo ma'i gos gyon pa'i//ldem ldem 'khri shing gzhon nur 'khyud la dga'//phyi ma gsum la/ tsan+dan a ka ru sogs bzang po'i dri/ /'thul 'thul phyogs kyi glang po'i 'gram pa la/ /mdzes mdzes thig ler dgod pa'i dri bzhon rnams//khor khor rig 'dzin dga' ba'i nags der rgyu//bzhi ka'i thog ma na yod pa/ /mtshar mtshar 'phags pa'i zhing gi me long du/ /dung dung dad pas yid ngor shar ba'i lha/ /mdzes mdzes mtshan dpe'i skye mched rdzogs pa'i zhal//yang yang blta bar 'tshal lo dbyangs can lha//thog ma'i bar ma chod pa'i dbye ba bco lnga'o/ /bar du chod pa rkang pa ni/ /gnyis rer yod pa'i dbye ba drug /gsum rer yod pa rnam gsum dang //bzhi yod gcig ste bcu yin no/ /cha gnyis yod pa'i dbye ba gsum/ /bar du chod pa bcu gsum yod//bar du chod pa'i zung ldan las/rkang pa dang po gnyis/dkar 'jam yid 'phrog pad+ma'i lte ba ru/ /dkar bsil 'dod lha'i me long lhung 'dra ba'i/ /ri bong 'dzin pa 'od kyi 'phro 'du can/ /byang chub sems kyi lang tsho gang bar mtshon/ /dang po dang gsum par/ yid 'ong sgeg cing 'gying bcas tsog pu'i stabs//mdzes pa'i zhabs sor bkram des pad rtsa li'i/ /yid 'ong khengs pa bsnyil tshe pad+ma'i dgra/ /rab dga'i 'od zer so 738

phreng dgod pa bzhin//dang po dang bzhi par/'jam mnyen sor mo'i gdu bu 'khrol ba'i sgra/ /snyan par sgrogs la rab 'khu bai blo ru'i/ /rgyud stong phang par 'dzegs pa las skyes pa'i//'jam mnyen dbyangs kyis chos kun cig car 'doms//bar pa gnyis/mig sman char gyis brlan pa'i zur phud rtse//yid tsam ldem par byas la nor bu dang / /yid 'ong me tog phreng ba'i rgyan bkod pas/ /'jig rten kun gyi mdzes sdug 'phrogs pa bzhin/ /gnyis bzhir/rnam bkra lha yi gos bzang sna tshogs kyis//kun nas bklubs kyang mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i gzi/ /mi 'gog srid pas byas pa'i mdzis pa rnams/ /kun nas mog por bsgyur pa'i btso blag mkhan/ /phyi ma gnyis la/hog bral 'o ma'i rgya mtshor lan stong du/ /nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bkrus pa bzhin/ /dkar mdzes dri mas dben pa'i bzhin ras dang / /dkar mdzes tshems kyi phreng ba lha na sdug /bar du chod pa gsum la yod pa'i dang po gsum la/rnam bkra smin ma'i 'khri shing 'khyog ldan cing //rnam bkra spyan ras zur mda' 'phangs pa'i mod//rnam bkra'i blo yi mchog sbyin dbyangs can lha//dus kun khyod las gzhan pa'i skyabs gnas su//dang po dang gsum bzhir/ rab dmar mchu sgros byi ru'i tshal nang du/ /smin ma'i tshems dkar nu tig phreng ba can/ /rab dmar ljags kyi mdzes pa phul byung bas//rab dmar glog gi 'phrul la skyengs pa sbyin//phyi ma gsum la/lha de'i mgul gyi bum bzang las thon pa'i/ /snyan 'gyur chos kyi rol mor 'bab pa'i glu//snyan 'gyur rgyud du sprung bas dri za yi//snyan 'gyur ma lus phyogs der bos pa bzhin//bzhi ga'i thog ma la/bdag sogs 'khor ba'i 739

'khor lor 'khyams rnams la/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa 'khor ba'i 'khri shing nags/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i ral gris gcod nus mthu/ /bdag gi lha mchog khyod kyis grub par mdzod//bzhi la cha gnyis su yod pa las/dang po gnyis mtshungs phyi ma gnyis/chos rnams thams cad rmi lam sgyu 'dra zhes//chos kun gzigs des legs par gsungs na yang //'khrul pa'i yid ngor rtag brtan ther zug tu/ /'khrul pa bdag 'drar gzigs shig dbyangs can lha/ /dang po gsum dang gnyis bzhir/ gya gyu'i za rlabs 'khrug pa'i yid kyi mtsho/ /rnyog ma can gyis gang ba'i dus mtha' na/ /gya gyu spangs pa drang po'i brtul zhugs pas/ /rtog med sems kyi bzod pa ji lhar thob/ /thog mtha' 'dra zhing bar ba gnyis 'dra/ dben pa'i ri bo lha dang dka' thub pas/ /yongs bsten bag phebs ri yi bya skyibs dang / /yongs 'du'i khengs 'phrog ljon pa'i grib bsil las//dben gsum bdud rtsi'i mal du 'dug la dga'//bar chod pa'i zung ldan bcu gsum mo//chod cing ma chod pa yis gsum//snga ma gnyis 'dra phyi ma gnyis//sil sil snyan cha g.yo zhing bsgyur ba mos/ /sil sil phyag gi gdub kor 'thab pa'i sgra/ /snyan snyan 'khrol dang lhan cig chos kyi sgo/ /snyan snyan rna ba'i dpyid du 'jo zhing ster/ /thog mtha' gnyis dang bar ba gnyis/ ling ling dran pa'i snye mas bsgyur pa yi/ /kyur kyur gru yi rig byed dang lhan cig kyu ra kyur lus kyi 'gyur bag de dang de//ling ling ston 'di ma brtags nyams dga'i chos//rkang pa bzhi ga'i thog ma la/ mtshar mtshar srid gsum mdzes pa'i snying po kun/ /mtshar mtshar byed pos gcig tu bsdus 'dra ba/ /mtshar mtshar 740

mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rdzogs pa mos/ /mtshar mtshar nyams brgya'i rgyud mangs sbong bar mdzod//thog ma'i zung ldan gyi dbye ba sum cu rtsa gcig go/gnas gzhan yod pa'i bya dka' la//bzhi ga'i dbus na yod pa dang //de bzhin mtha' dang bar mtha' dang / /thog bar dag dang thog mtha' gnyis/ /gnas gsum mnyam par yod pa la/ /bar chod chod cing ma chod pa//gnyis gnyis sbyar bas bcu gnyis so//zhes pa'i bzhi ga'i dbus kyis chod cing ma chod pa/lha mchog 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can lha'i bu mor//rab dgyes gsung dbyangs dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i gru/ /nyer zhi'i sgra dbyangs dbyangs kyi rgya mtsho ru//'khyil ba'i rnga dbyangs dbyangs kun bla na mtho//bzhi ka'i dbus kyis chod pa/ khyod zhal mdzis kyang mjos pa gzhan rnams la/ /yod pa'i mdzes sdug mdzes pa min bgyid phyir/ /gang de'i mdzes chos mdzes pa mtha' dag las//'das pa'i mdzes ldan mdzes ma rgya mtsho'i lha/ /rkang ba bzhi'i mtha' chod pa/ khyod sku'i mtshar sdug 'gro ba'i mig ngor 'bab//zab rgyas chos kyi snyan 'gyur rna bar 'bab//thugs rje'i gzigs pa mkha' mnyam 'gro la 'bab/ /'phrin las chu bo bskal pa'i lam gsum 'bab/ /bzhi ga'i mtha' chod cing ma chod pa/ chos kun longs la spyod pa'i gsung snyan snyan//phyag sor gdu bu 'thab pa'i sgra snyan snyan//dri za'i pi wang sbreng ba'i dbyangs snyan snyan//kun nas blo mchog sprul ba'i grags snyan snyan/ /bar mtha' chod pa/ rgyal sku mtshan dpe'i mtshar sdug rdzogs pa mtshar//zag med yon tan mtshar po'i rgyan 'di mtshar//bsam yas mdzad 'phrin mtshar po'i dpal 'di mtshar/ /rnam pa thams cad 741

mtshar ba'i mgon khyod mtshar//bar mthar chod cing ma chod pa/zla ba'i sku mdzes mdzes ldan zhal mdzes mdzes/ /skye mched rab mdzes mdzes ma'i spyod mdzes mdzes/ /rgyud mangs phyag mdzes mdzes bkra'i rgyan mdzes mdzes/ /dbyangs can lha mdzes mdzes ma'i rtser mdzes mdzes/ /thog bar du chod pa/ rab dkar zla ba rab tu phyis pa'i zhal/ /rab bkra'i spyan zur rab 'khyog smin ma'i gzhur/ /rab tu bkang des rab mang 'gro rgyud kyi/ /rab rib mtha' dag rab tu bcom par gyur/ /dang po dang gsum pa'i thog mtha' gnyis bzhi'i thog bar gyis chod cing ma chod pa/mtshar mtshar pad+ma dkar po'i dpal mtshar mtshar//mtshar mtshar zla bas mtshar mtshar 'od 'grems pa'i//mtshar mtshar gdan la dbyangs can lha mtshar mtshar//mtshar mtshar mdzad pas mtshar mtshar 'gro ba 'dul/ /bzhi ga'i thog mtha' bar chod pa/dkar mdzes pad mtshor ngang pa'i rlabs phreng dkar//dkar bsil nyar ma 'thor dbus chu bya dkar//dkar ba'i gnyis 'thung khyus bskor gdan pad dkar/ /dkar mdzes steng na mgon po 'jam dbyangs dkar/ /bzhi ga'i thog mtha' bar chod pa/ ldem ldem gzhon nu thor bu'i sku ldem ldem//ldem ldem bde ba'i 'du byed 'gying ldem ldem//ldem ldem ral gri 'phyar ba sngo ldem ldem//ldem ldem yon po'i thor tshugs 'khyog ldem ldem/ /gnas gsum ga'i chod pa/ snang byed bdag po'i snang bas phyogs kun snang / /snang gsal sgron me'i snang bas rang khyim snang / /snang mchog chos kyi snang bas thar lam snang / /snang mdzad rgyal ba'i snang bas 'jig rten snang / /gnas gsum ga'i bar chod cing ma chod pa/ /snyan snyan 742

'dab ldan khyu nas snyan snyan khu byug rtsos pa'i gdangs snyan snyan/ /snyan snyad rol mo'i nang nas snyan snyan lha yi rnga chen sgra snyan snyan/ /snyan snyan glu dbyangs tshogs na snyan snyan rab dga' dri za'i gru snyan snyan/ /snyan snyan srid gsum kun na snyan snyan dpal ldan rgyal ba'i grags snyan snyan//mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zang ldan/ mtha' yas yon tan phung pos rab mdzes sku/ /mdzes—sku 'gro ba'i yid ngor chu zla bzhin//zla bzhin rnam bar rgyas pa'i sgra lha mo//lha mo kun gyi gtso la spyi bos 'dud//yang na/ legs byas rmad byung ri mo bkra ba'i phul/ /phul byung mtshar sdug rgya mtsho'i snying por smin/ /smin legs ngag gi dpyid 'jo dbyangs can lha//lha mchog khyod kyi skye bar rjes zungs shig /bzhi pa kun tu zung ldan la/ /zud zlas yang dag sbyar ba yi/ /dbye ba gsum dang de las gzhad//rkang pa lan gcig bzlas pa drug/lan gnyis bzlas pa'i dbye ba gsum/ /lan gsum bzlas pa gcig ste bcu/ /tshigs bcad bzlas pa gcig rnams so//zhes zud bzlas yang dag sbyor ba la/ rkang pa dang po gsum pa dang / gnyis pa bzhi bar bzlas pa ni/ yon tan phung pos mngon mtho ba kaḥ //'jig rten kun la ci 'dod zar du 'bebs//yon tan phung pos mngon mtho da kaḥ //'jig rten kun la ci 'dod char du 'bebs/ /dang po gnyis pa dang gsum pa bzhi par bzlas pa di/ rab dkar ri dwags mtshan mas mdzis pa'i lha/ /rab dkar ri dwags mtshan mas mdzes pa'i lha/ /gdung ba kun sel bdud rtsi'i 'dzum rlabs can/ /gdung ba kun sel bdud rtsi'i 'dzum rlabs can/ /dang po bzhi pa dang /gnyis pa gsum par bzlas pa/dkar mdzes lang tshos sgeg 743

pa'i pad+ma can/ /skye bo kun gyi yid la bde ba ster/ /skye bo kun gyi yid la bde ba ster/ /dkar mdzes lang tshos sgeg pa'i pad+ma can/ /de las gzhan pa'i rkang pa la/lan gcig bzlas pa'i bye brag dang po gnyis par bzlas pa/dkar mdzes ngang pa'i bu mo yid 'ong ma//dkar mdzes ngang pa'i bu mo yid 'ong ma/ /'dab ldan ma de pad+ma'i jing bu dang / /ngag dbang lha mo gdul bya'i yid mtshor rol/ /dang po gsum par bzlas pa/ snyan cing brjid chags chos kyi sgra 'byin mkhas//lha yi rnga chen chos kyi shugs 'chang ste/ /snyan cing brjid chags chos kyi sgra 'byin mkhas/ /ngag gi dbang phyug sangs rgyas rdo rje'i gsung //dang po bzhi par bzlas pa/rab 'byams shes bya kun la longs kyis spyod/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes me long ste/ /thams cad mkhyen gzigs puṇ+ḍa rī ka yang //rab 'byams shes bya kun la longs kyis spyod//gnyis pa gsum par bzlas pa/mthong ba tsam gyis 'khor ba'i gdung 'phrog pa//kun mkhyen dpag bsam yongs 'du'i dbang po gang //kun mkhyen dpag bsam yongs 'du'i dbang po gang //rtag tu gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mos ngor 'char//gnyis pa bzhi par bzlas pa/rgyal ba'i dbang po gang gi gzugs kyi sku/ /sna tshogs gdul bya'i yid dang mthun par 'jug/ de bzhin chos kun ston pa'i gsung 'di yang / /sna tshogs gdul bya'i yid dang mthun par 'jug /gsum pa bzhi par bzlas pa/ rtag par gzhan la phan pa'i don gzigs nas/ /lha brgya'i dbus na 'dod bzhin chos ston pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug brtse ba'i bdag nyid can/ /'jig rten dbang phyug brtse ba'i bdag nyid can//lan gnyis bzlas pa la rkang 744

pa dang po nyid gnyis pa dang gsum par yang bzlas pa/rab dkar mdzes pa'i dpal ldan gnyis skyes dbang / /rab dkar mdzes pa'i dpal ldan gnyis skyes dbang / /rab dkar mdzes pa'i dpal ldan gnyis skyes dbang / /dbyangs can tshems dkar ston zla dang po'i rgyal/ /dang po nyid gsum bzhir yang bzlas pa/ bsung zhim ngad ldang mchog gi nyer spyad 'os//khyod lus pad dkar ha ri tsan na yang //bsung zhim bad ldad mchog gi nyer spyad 'os/ /bsung zhin ngad ldang mchog gi nyer spyad 'os/ /gnyis pa nyid gsum bzhir yang bzlas pa/ /khyod zhal ri bong can dang bad dkar//mtshar3ga za rdzogs kun dga'i ro dang ldan/ /mtshar sdug cha rdzogs kud dga'i ro dang ldan/ /mtshar sdug cha rdzogs kun dga'i ro dang ldan/ /gsum pa lan gsum du yang bzlas pa ni/dkar mdzes 'gro ba'i dpyid gyur pad+ma dkar//dkar dzes 'gro ba'i dpyid gyur pad+ma dkar/ /dkar mdzes 'gro ba'i dpyid gyur pad+ma dkar/ /dkar mdzis 'gro ba'i dpyid gyur pad+ma dkar//tshigs bcad bzlas pa ni/ gcig tu 'phan med (skyon med ming)sa 'dzid chen po'i dun/ /dus kun 'khyog por bgrod pa'i lce gnyis pa/ /ltar snang kha dog tsam gyis mdzis pa la/ /yid brtan 'cha' bar 'dod pa de blun po/ /gcig tu 'phan med sa 'dzin chen po'i mdun/ /dus kun 'khyog por bgrod pa'i rtse gnyis pa/ /ltar snang kha dog tsam gyis mdzes pa la/ /yid brtan 'cha' bar 'dod pa de blun po/ /gsum pa zung ldan ched po gcig dbang phyug mchog brnyes khyod rgyal dbang phyug mchog brnyes khyod rgyal ba/ /dbang phyug mchog brnyes khrod rgyal dbang phyug mchog brnyes 745

khyod rgyal ba//dbang phyug mchog brnyes khyod rgyal dbang phyug mchog brnyes khyod rgyal ba//dbang phyug mchog brnyes khyod rgyal dbang phyug mchog brnyes khyod rgyal ba//lnga pa 'dres pa'i zung ldan gcig mdzes pa mdzes pa'i nang nas mdzes pa mdzes pa'i dpyid phul byung /phul byung dam pa'i rtser 'dzeg dam pa'i spyod tshul gyis mdzes ma/ /mdzes ma khyod gsung snyan tshig gsung snyan dam chos sgra dbyangs can//dbyangs can lha mo srid zhi'i lha mo kun gyi mchog lags so/ /drug pa bzlog pa'i zung ldan/ lugs bzlog rkang pa gcig bzlog dang / /tshigs bcad phyed bzlog tshigs bcad ni/ /rangs por bzlog pa rnam gsum 'dod//dang po rkang pa gcig bzlog pa/thar pa grub dang mkhas pas rig nyid de/ /de nyid rig pas mkhas dang grub pa thar//'khrul ba blun dang byis pas rtogs mi srid//srid mi rtogs pas byis dang blud pa 'khrul//tshigs bcad byed bzlog/dzun phyir de nyid 'khrul la med bzhin snang //dngos kun de nyid stong ste zab don rig/rig don zab ste stong nyid de kun dngos/ /snang bzhin med la 'khrul nyid de phyir dzud/ /tshigs bcad rangs po bzlog pa/ shes par ldan pa mdzes shing mkhas la gsal/ /btsun na dul dang des la zhi zhing 'jam/ /khengs shing chags la nor 'dod ngan la sdang / /blun pas 'khrul phyir de nyid mthong ba min/ /min pa mthong nyid de phyir 'khrul pas blun/ /sdang la ngan 'dod nor la chags shing khengs/ /'jam zhing zhi la des dang dul na btsun/ /gsal la mkhas shing mdzes pa ldan par shes//spyi don gnyis pa bya dka' ba'i//khyad par gzhan dag bstan pa la//746
/sbyisbyosbyisbyisbyisbyisbyisbyi sgyusbyospyisbyongh+rungh+rusbyosbyisbyosbyisbyosbyisbyosbyosbyosbyo bar ba ba ba ba ba bde de de ba ba ba sbyo

'di nyid kun tu 'khor ba ste/ /kun tu bzang po zhes byar grags/ /klog lugs re'u mig brgya nyer brgyad/ /'khor lo cha gnyis byed snga phyi/ /g.yas g.yon steng 'og go rim bzhin/ /lugs 'byung lugs bzlog spel mar 'khor/ /zur rgyugs re rer yig gzugs gcig /gru chad phan tshun phyogs cha mtshungs/ /legs pa'i cha shas gzhan yang mang / /rnam dpyod ldan pas gnyer bya'o/ /dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' la/ /dbyangs dang gnas dang gsal byed gsum//re re bzhi gsum gnyis gcig gi /dbye bas rnam pa bcu gnyis 'dod/ /zhes pas/ dbyangs a i yo e bzhir nges pa pad+ma rab yangs gdan la mnyam bzhag nas/ /ji bzhin nyid gzigs mi dmigs teng 'dzin gyis/ /'gro tshogs mos ngor chos 'khor yongs rdzogs bskor/ /dpe med ye shes brnyes des nges legs ster/ /i sa u gsum du nges pa/ gnyis 'dzin 'khri shing mi dmigs dbyings thim zhing / /sa dang lam rnams mthar 'dzad bag mags zad/ /dus gsum kun tu phul byung brtul zhugs grub/ /phan par mdzad pa gang la bdag cag dad/ /i e gnyis su nges pa/ sgrib gnyis 'ching zhing srid zhi ji bzhin gzigs//yid gnyis sprin gyis mi sgrib nyid drin gyis/ /dge legs me chen cher 'phel bden zhen bsregs/ /bde chen ye shes mkhyen brtses mdzes de brnyes//sa gcig pur nges pa/bsags pa rab mdzad gnas pa mthar 'gags pas//thams cad yal bar bzhag nas yang dag las//rtag chad spangs pa nags tshal nyams dga' bar//bdag la chags pa rab btang 'bad na bzang //gnas mchu mgrin rkan so bzhir nges pa/ ba mo ma babs pad+ma spungs pa'i 748

spor/ /ngag dbang mkhas bad ba khengs 'gog dbyangs/ /lce rtse bde bde'i klag cor ca co'i sgra/ /rtag tu btang la dad dad lhar du 'dud/ /mchu so mgrin gsum du nges pa/ dpag med pha ma bur 'brel 'bad med phal/ /ma smad spobs pa dpag par mi spobs pas/ /rtag tu nan tad gdams te bdag lta btul/ /ma ho sa ho mkhas dbang ngag gi dbang / /mchu dang so gnyis su nges pa/ ma pham dpa' po'i dpung pas dpal 'phel mang / /sprang pos 'bad pas 'phral phugs dpal mi 'phel/ /rtag tu bdag don nan tan bsten legs na'ang / /mtha' dag bde sdug las 'bras dag la gnas/ /mchu gcig pur nges pa/ dmigs du med par smag rum 'phangs snyam pa/ /phan bsam 'bral med pha ma du 'bal phal/ /dmag dpung dpag med dpa' bo 'phangs 'phen pa'i/ /spar mor sprung dbyug mi sprad sma mi dbab/ /gas byed bzhir nges pa/ kye kye ka kaḥ ka'i skya ka ka'i//re ro ru ru'i ro res ra ro rung / /sa sa so sos so so so so sos/ /da de ded do de do de de ded/ /gsum du nges pa/ la la la lung sa sa so so song lang leng ngang la lus ngal le los lus/ /sal sal ba sa la lang long las su lang / /sems ngal sos la sna lu sil sil sems/ /gnyis su nges pa/ swa ra su ti su ra gaḥ sa sa/ /sems sam sa sa so sor sems song sa/ /de 'dod dad dad dung dung de dang de/ /da dung de der dud de dung dung 'dud/ /gcig tu nges pa/ las la la la la la la lud la/ /lam lam la la la la le lo la ling ling la la lang rngo 1 1 7 la la la lab lob la bar lu lur lus/ /sgra'i rgyan gyi dbye ba rnams so/ / 749

gsum pa gab tshig gi rgyan la/kun tshogs slu byed rim pa zal rab bcom mthun gzugs tsub mo'i tshig /grangs dang rab btags ming du 'dus/ /sgribs dang mthun sgra rmongs pa dang //yongs 'phrog gcig sgribs gnyis ka sgribs//yongs su 'dres dang bcu drug go/zhes pa ltar las/kun tu tshogs pa'i gab tshig ni/rigs dang ldan zhing mchog tu bzhin bzang ba//snying la 'bab de ma ma lags kyang ni/ /rnam pa kun tu sred pa'i 'khri shing gis/ /bdag yid 'ching ba sgrub phyir dga' ma yin//slu byed kyi gab tshig dpal gyi 'bras bu dam par mtshan pa yi/ /mchog tu yi gar 'ong pa'i lo legs dang //mdzes pa'i ze'u 'bru ma nyams pad+ma'i 'dzum//mthong bas sred ldad yid la dga' ba 'phel//rim pa bral ba'i gab tshig 'dren pa khyod thugs zab yangs 'jig rten na/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chos tshul zung 'jug lam//blang dor bcas ldan bzang po'i ngang tshul gyis//rigs can gdul bya 'dul la bstan pa'i zhabs//rab bcom gyi gab tshig sprin gyi gos can nyan byed chu'i srin po'i/ /rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i 'og pag bzhis 'khyud pa//phyag rgya'i snod du bgyis pa'i pu kirti//lus med sgra yis gnas kyi 'od snang bzhin/ /mthun gzugs gab tshig 'dab phreng sna lngas yongs 'khyud yal ga'i lhag /'jam mnyen snyan pa'i dbyangs 'byin khu byug can/ /mdangs mtshar me tog mchog gcig rtser dgod pa'i//'khril ldem gsar ba'i ljon shing de ring mthong / /tsub mo'i gab tshig chu las skyes rnams chu mtshor lus bsten nas/ /rab tu dkar ba'i 'dzum bcas rnams par rol/ /lnga par gyur kyang shis pa sgrub pa'i sgras/ /kun yid 'phrog de gdos 760

bcas bem po'i chos/ /grangs kyi gab tshig sna ldan dbus gnas beg pa rim gsum gyis//rtser son 'gyur med bkra shis grangs tshang ba'i/ /mkhas pa 'ga' yod gang gi legs bshad ni/ /dngul chu'i thigs phreng sor mos bcom pa bzhin/ /yang na/ lag pa'i tshogs las rab 'khrungs yon tan sku//mnga' bas 'gro ba dus kyi mos pa bzhin/ /mdzad pa'i tshul ni nyi mar bstan dbus na//dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo me ru bskor//rab btags kyi gab tshig yid kyi shes pa rnal du phebs bral zhing //rig rig phyogs su lta ba'i stangs zhan pa//lus kyi 'khri shing 'dar ldan skyabs med la//mtshan mo spyod pa khyod nyid brtse bar rigs//ming du 'dus pa'i gab tshig lang tshos khengs ldan khyod 'jam nyag phran can/ /thog mar pu snye —ka zhes snyan sgrogs pa//brnag dka'i zug rngu 'byin par byed pa po//dpa' bo ma yin ge sar can yang min/ /sgrib pa'i gab tshig gyen du drangs pa'i bya ba rab dka' zhing //'bad pa med kyang thur du ngang gis 'jug/rang bzhin gcig tu mi gnas gya gyu'i tshul/ /kun tu ston de 'bab ldanas yin no/ /mthun pa'i sgra'i gab tshig ye ge bzang po'i mngon bar brjod pa yi/ /khams las yongs grub rgyan gyi rnam mdzes pa/ /khyod kyi ge sar ming mthun shar gyi rir/ /nyin mor byed pa 'phos 'dras bdag yid 'phrog /rmongs pa'i gab tshig khyim gyis yid byung nges par bsgab gzhi'i tshul/ /rang gir mdzad pas dul ba ngang du bzhes//de tshul ma nyams mngon 'dod las skyes pa'i//ri dwags mig can mchu yi sprang chang gzhib//yongs 'phrog gi gab tshig ri yig skyes mgon dgra bo'i kha zas kyi//rtsa lag las 'ongs bcud kyis 'tsho 751

ba'i khyu/ /kha 'jam grogs mid 'dzin la dga' rnams dang / /lhan cig gru dang zlos gar 'grad pa bzhin/ /gcig sgrib pa'i gab tshig phra rags 'byung ba'i khams las 'das gyur cing / /kun tu mi snang stong pa cang med ming / /yon tan ldan pa la la'i gzugs mtshar ba/ /bar snang khams la dbang po'i gzhu bzhin ston/ /gnyis ka sgrib pa'i gab tshika bla na med pa'i yon tan tshogs kyi gter/ /gang gis phongs pa med pa su zhig la/ /sbyin pa yang dag phul ba'i sgra snyan po/ /thos pa'i rna ba de yang don ldan byed/ /yongs 'dres kyi gab tshig khyod kyi mdzes chos ge sar ming ldan pa//mchod par bya ba rin po che yi ming / /mi yi 'khyud des srid pas byas pa'i skyon/ /chu bo rnams las nges par sgrol bar byed//gab tshig gi rgyan rnams so//spyi don gsum pa skyon sel la/don nyams don 'gal don gcig pa/ /be tshom can dang rim pa nyams//sgra dman gcod mtshams nyams pa dang //sdeb sbyor nyams dang mtshams sbyor bral/ /yul dus sgyu rtsal 'jig rten dang / /lung rigs dag dang 'gal ba ste/ /skyon bcu 'di dag snyan ngag la//snyan ngag mkhan gyis spang bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar las/ don nyams skyon ni/chu bo 'di rnams thur du mgyogs par rgyug /bem po'i dngos kun rnam rtog gya gyu med/ /stod ka zla ba'i rang 'od lhag par gsal/ /kho bo snying la nyal ba'i bde ba 'dod/ /don 'gal skyon/ rnyed bkur nor bu'i khrir 'khod phyogs dang gling / /kun las rnam rgyal 'byor bas mi ngoms pa/ /rgyal khyod chog shes ga pur 'thul ba'i dris/ /'du 'dzi bdud kyi 'ching ba ring du btang //de'i dmigs bsal/ 'dod ldan sgeg mo'i gzugs gsar dbang 762

po'i gzhu/ /mjos kyang 'jig pa'i chos la su zhig chags/ /yid 'ong skye mched rdzogs pa'i bzhin bzang ma/ /nam zhig mig gi bdud rtsir 'thung 'gyur ram/ /don gcig skyon/ sar skyes ljon shing sdong po'i gel ba'i rtser1 /snyan pa'i gru dang dbyangs mi 'gyur khugs can/ /'dab ldan dpyid kyi pho nya ko ki la/ /sngo ljang 'dab gshog sgro tshogs ngom bzhin rgyu/ /de'i dmigs bsal/ thar pa 'dod pas yid drangs dben pa'i dgas/ /lha dang grub pas bsten de yid la dran/ /bag phebs ljon pa'i grib bsil yid la dran/ /gtsang ma'i chab rgyun bder 'bab yid la dran/ /the tshom can skyon/ skyed mos tshal nang jing rtsi'i pho nya 'di/ /'dab ma rab rgyas yan lag rnam 'gyur gyi/ /mngon 'dod bsgab pa ster sod de rang nyid/ /srog dang bcas pa yin—min cha ma 'tshal/ /de'i dmigs bsal/ /yi ge khaḥ zhes 'byung ba chen po yi/ /rang bzhin dngo dag 'gro 'ong las byed pa'i/ /gnyis skyes 'di dag 'gro ba'i gnas tshul gyis/ /mi rtag g.yo ba'i rang bzhin mtshon par byas/ /rim pa bral skyon/ bdud 'dul thub pa'i dbang des gdul bya yi/ /mos pa mchog dman 'bring po'i lam gsum du/ /'tsham pa'i bslab bya so sor thar pa dang / /byang sems sngags kyis 'dul ba de de bsten/ /de'i dmigs bsal/ gang zhig mtho ris thar pa mngon 'dod phyir/ /sbyin tshul bsgoms pa las byung bsod nams kyi/ /thog mtha' yon tan khyad par gzhan sgrub kyang / /bar ma kho na dal 'byor rten gyi rgyu/ /sgra nyams skyon/ snan shar sgo bzang ma khyod rdu ra'i rgyan/ /stag shar yongs kyi snying sdug bu mo'i gtso/ /rgyang gru bde bar 'khyug pa'i gru gzhas kyis/ /lha yul mdzes ma'i 753

khengs pa 'phrogs kyis dogs/ /de'i dmigs bsal/ rtse dga'i sa gzhir lus phra mtshar sdug can//khyod mthong mig la bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pa//gzhan— yid 'phrog pa'i bya ba yongs rdzogs 'di/ /rgyan dang gos kyi khyad par las byung min//gcod mtshams nyams skyon/rgyal ba'i yum mchog gyur dbyangs can lha mo//mdzes sdug dpal phun tshogs pa gang de yi//phyag sor gyis bsgrun ba ra dbyangs kyi/ /thos pa 'dzin bdud rtsi yi khengs par mdzod/ /de'i dmigs bsal/ dus gsum gshegs yum rdo rje dbyangs lha mo//mtshan dpe rab rdzogs mdzes pa'i phyag sor gyis//'gying zhing bsgyur ba dri za'i pi wang sgras//thos 'dzin bdud rtsi'i khang bar 'gyid 'tshal lo//sdeb sbyor nyams pa'i chad lhag gi dpe/zin med 'dir snang 'khrul pa'i bya byed mang / /rgya mtsho chu yi gnyer ma lta bur/ /'dzad med nyin re bzhin du rnam 'phel la/ /btang nas zhi ba'i nags 'gro de 'dra bsngags 'os/ /mtshams sbyor nyams skyon/ bsod nams mthu las dza ya i shā ra//chen po'i dpal gyis gser ldan dga' ma'i khyon//ma lus dge ba rnam bcu'i bka' khrims kyi/ /phyag rgyas 'debs de mnga' bdag khri ral pa/ /de'i dmigs bsal/ 'gro ba'i don gzigs rgyal rnams mthu stobs gzugs/ /gsang pa'i bdag por rnam sprul ku mā ra//in+d+ra ba ra'i mdangs 'od 'phrog khyod kyis/ /bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rgya bar mdzod/ /yul 'gal skyon/ lho mon nags kyi 'brong du ra sngon dang //byang phyogs kha ba'i ri rgyud glang chen gnyis/ /bai dka yi tshing khra'i nags khrod na/ /dzā ti'i me tog mdzes pa'i dpal la chags/ /dus 'gal skyon/ mtshan gung nyi ma'i zer gyis yongs 754

smin pa'i//dgun gyi pad+ma yid 'ong ge sar can//sos ka'i smon shing 'bras du la 'khu yang //dbyar dus za 'od dwangs bas zil gyis mnan/ /sgyu rtsal dang 'gal skyon/ drag shul 'jigs su rung ba gar gyis ros/ /dgod cing rtse ba'i 'gyur ba rnam 'phel ba'i//mgrin pa gru yi nges pa lnga pa dang //bar ma'i dbyangs kyis 'gro ba'i yid 'phrog byed/ /'jig rten dang 'gal skyon/nun pa'i kha dog 'dzin pa kha ba'i rir/ /gdong lnga ldan pa'i sngo sangs ra rdo bas/ /ba lang mche ba bcag pa'i sgra bo che/ /'on pa'i ra bas yang nas yang du thos/ /nang pa'i rigs pa— dang 'gal skyon/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig par/ /mdo rgyud kun nas lad mang gsungs mod kyang / /mtshar sdug snying po phyin pa'i spen legs ma'i/ /lus skyes reg pa'i mchog 'di shin tu bde//phyi rol pa'i rigs pa dang 'gal skyon/ srid pa'i dri ma bcil slad 'jug ngogs su/ /dag byed khrus kyi ril ba sbying brtson mod//lus nyid bkrus las rang sems dag pa'i ngos//'byung ba min par bdag yid mngon sum mthong / /'dul ba'i lung dang 'gal skyon/ nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pas bzung min par/ /sde lnga bskab bya'i phra zhib dam zu nas//skyon bral tshangs par spyod pa'i brtul nugs can//rnam par grol ba'i dpal la rang gir spyod/ /mdo lung dang 'gal skyod/ rgyu 'bras rten 'byung chos la ma rag par//glo bur grub pa'i ba spyod tshul nges med ston/skas la rim gyis 'dzegs min 'thor byed bya/ 1yangs pa'i mkha' la thog babs lta dur spyod/ /de dag di dmig da bgal yul 'gal yang skyon med pa/ phyag na brjo can gshegs da chub ba'i gnas/ /bung bra'i tshogs chen 755

rab dkrigs 'jam pa'i sgra/ /sgrogs pa bka'i jing bu yid 'ong gis/ /yongs bsten char zim dal gyis 'bab par gyur/ /dus 'gal skyon med/kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang phyug bu rtse'i zhabs/ /chos dbyings zhi bar gzhol la mngon phyogs tshe/ /dgun dus kha ba'i rdul zags dang 'grogs pa'i//me tog gsar du dgod pa'i ngo mtshar mthong / /sgyu rtsal dang 'gal yang skyon med/ lang tsho'i chang gis rab myos go rims dag /'khrugs shing stangs stabs bral ba grong khyer ma'i/ /gyi nar —spyod pa'i gru dang gar gyis kyang / /chags par ldan pa'i yi ka 'gugs par byed/ /'jig rted dang 'gal ba skyon med/ rgyal sku'i 'od zer phyogs kyi mthar 'gro bas/ /reg tsam nyid nas ba'og nun pa'i klu/ /long ba yis kyang mtshan dpe'i dpal mthong zhing / /rmongs pa'i blo yis tshe rabs dran pa thob/ /rigs pa dang 'gal ba skyon med/ spros dang bral yang spros pa rmad byung gang / /'bad rtsol med bzhin 'bad pa kun ston pa/ /gcig nyid kho na sna tshogs gzugs spyir yang / /'char ba rgyal sku'i gsang ba bsam mi khyab/ /lung dang 'gal ba skyon med/ bcos ma'i 'ching ba kun las nges grol phyir/ /blang dang dor bya'i rgyu 'bras 'ga' ma gzigs/ /spyod pa bsam mi khyab pa'i gar gyis rol/ /'phags yul grub— chen rgya mtshor bdag dang ngon /zhes pa bya dka' ba'i rnam par bcad pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o//de ltar shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa/ /'char bzod snyan ngag bstan bcos me long gi /rgyan gyi don 'grel dper brjod kyis mtshon pa/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i3da mangs sgra las byung / /gzhung don mtsho las 156

skyes pa'i rgyan gyi phreng / /mang yang khyad chos tshon mdangs ma 'dres pa/ /bshes gnyen dam pas bskyangs pa'i zil mngar can//blo gsal bung ba'i nyer 'tsho shin tu mtho/ /kyi hud snyigs dus gzu bor gnas pa dkon/ /rmongs pa'i tshig gis gzhung don 'khyog por 'grel/ /rgyan kun 'chol ba thags cha 'dzings 'drar gyur/ /de 'drar sems kyi gtad so ji ltar 'cha'/ /'on kyang rgyu skar dbus na zla nya bzhin/ /gzur gnas shes par ldan 'ga' deng mchis na//legs par bshad pa 'di ltas dgyes gyur te//gzhan du rgyal ba'i bka' las dbyug pa btsan//srid pa sgyu ma'i rgyal mos legs bskrun duḥ kha'i tshor ba nyer len pa'i/ /lnga phung me tog ge sar tshogs la dus kyi bung bas kham zas su//byed pa'i 'byung 'khrug zug rngus mnar yang lhag bsam 'khar ba la brten das/ /tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i legs byas gang thob bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpal du gyur/ /de ltar snyan ngag me long gzhung gis bstan pa'i dper brjod legs par bshad pa sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba/bsil ljongs kyi snyan ngag smra ba bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam par rgyal ba'i lhas/ lam 'dir 'jug pa gsar du'i blo can 'ga'i don du legs par spel ba'o////757
ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//ba phrin mas ba gnyis pas brtsams/

༄༅ / /na maḥ swa ra ga sgyu/ ming gi mngon brjed pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ shes byar rmong mun kun zos lang snang gzi/ /rnam kun ༷sa po—ngo / man bkyi ba kun gzig—༷—ba ba pa ba~Xka kaXstobacadaXrdo——bye————zug dran pa rje dgra na po thams cad da shes go sde de stod du la / sa bu khyu rnam 'dren hū ཾ —snye—snye——༵ba ba ba ——ldan sku gsum pe/ /'di noms sang se rgya sa spyi yi—ma mi de/ /shākya'i rgyal poshāhūṃ~Xng—sras dang sgyu rje~X1ḍi rdo rje ldan ba dod ༵sna~X—ba)/ ༵sna—dbang—phyug—rdo——|༵༵ldana~Xgs—pa lha~X—bye~X|༵shā~X—chen—༵—sogs—byas sa pa'i mdzad/ /'jam mgod—'ji ma ba'i rdorje dang / /rdo rje non po seng dge rtsen/ /yi shes sku3dang shes rab bsku/ /11mchog snang dang ngag gi 761

rgyal/ /'jam dpal blo gter blo yi bdag /ngag gi dbang phyug smra ba'i rgyal/ /shes rab 'khor lo smra ba'i lha/ /gzhon nu'i sar gnas gtsug phud lnga/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo seng ge rtsen/ /zur phud lnga pa ral gri can/ /ye shes me long 'jam dbyangs mtshan/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'jig rten mgon/ /phyag na pad+ma chu skyes can/ /thugs rje chen po snying rje'i lha/ /mnar med gzigs dang brtse ba can/ /gru 'dzin dgyes sogs spyan ras gzigs/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje dbang phyug rdo rje can/ /mthu stobs bdag po gsang ba'i rgyal//phyag na rdo rje gsang ba 'dzin//lag da rdo rje gnod sbyin rgyal/ /gsang ba'i bdag sogs phyag rdor mtshan/ /oṃ mdzad ma dang myur skyob ma/ /zhi ma 'jig rten dbang sras mo/ /dpal chen mo sogs sgrol ma'i mtshan//zhal gsum phag gi shing rta ma//rnam gtsug 'od zer can ma'i mtshan/ /ngag dbang lha mo tshangs sras mo/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo dpal mo dang //rgya mtsho'i lha mo zla sring mo//shes rab lha mo blo gter ma//dri za'i na chung dkar mo dang //ston sbyin mo dang mtsho ldan ma//rdo rje dbyangs kyi dbang phyug ma/ /gzhan yang su ra su ste sgyu/ /smra ba'i lha mo dbyangs can mtshan//rmugs 'dzin chu yi dbang po dang //chu yi thub pa nor du bzang //sngon gyi gnod sbyin gter 'chang dang / /gnod gnas ba la yi mtshan/ /sangs rgyas chung ngu thos sgrog dang / /gsung skyes dang ni brtul zhugs dbang / /beg chung skyes du sangs rgyas 'khor/ /sbyangs yon la gnas nyan thos mtshan/ /nyi che'i sangs rgyas sangs rgyas 'bring / /bswe ru lta bu zhi la sred/ /rang zhi don gnyer zhi ba 'tsho/ /pra ta ka ba dang ni/ /rten 'brel 762

bcu gnyis don la rtogs//sgra med chos ston rkyen cig rtogs//theg 'bring skyes bu rten 'brel sgom/ 1rang byang chub rnams rang rgyal mtshan/ /blo ldan gsal mchog sems dpa' che/ /rgyal byed rgyal sras rgyal ba'i gzhi/ /'phags mchog ded dpon brten pa dngad /rgyal ba'i myu gu byang sems mtshan/ /mtho ris gnas bzang skabs gsum gnas/ /rol pa bde ldan dpal 'dzin dang / /sdig med gnas dang skyo med gnas/ /bde 'gro lhas rtsen lha yi grong / /steng gi 'jig rten sum rtsen gnas/ /grub pa'i gnas sogs lha gnas ming / /tshe ring rgas med 'chi med dang / /bdud rtsi zas cad bdud rtsi skyes//bcud ldan rnam sad mi la ma med//yid bzang tshigs bzang tshogs bzang dang / /mkhar nyal sum rtsen skabs gsum pa/ /tshig mda' ngag gi mtshon cha dang / /sbyin sreg za dang me yi zhal/ /me sbyin skyes dang re yig bu/ /yī dri'i du dang legs bris dang / /mkha' spyod mkha' gnas mkha' la 'gro/ /mchod sbyin zas dang mig mi 'dzum//sbyin skyes dgra sogs lha spyi'i ming / /gzhu rgyal sbyin skyes sbyin ma'i bu/ /sngon gyi lha dang dbang po'i dgra/ /pa sangs slob ma sa 'og gnas//bcud mi ldan dang lha la dmod/ /mchod sbyin dgra sogs lha min ming / /lha mo phag gi shing rta can/ /'og gi phyogs skyong brtan— ma'i ming / /rang byung byed po mes po dang //'jig rten dbang phyug skye dgu bdag /mi mjed bdag po dbyig gi snying //chu skyes mngal dang gser mngal can//bdag skyes pad skyes lha las rgan/ /gdong bzhi rna ba brgyad pa dang / /sna tshogs de byed gnyis skyes dbang / /ngang pa'i shing rta rig byed gdong / /rig byed drag po tshangs pa'i 763

ming / /tsā ra ya ṇaḥ sred med du/ /sbrang rtsi'i bu dang sprang rtsi'i dgra/ /rdul mo'i bu dang tha gu'i lto/ /mkha' lding rgyal mtshan rwa gzhu can/ /glang rdzi gos ser pad dkar mig /lag pa bzhi pa 'khor lo'i lag /pad+ma'i lte ba nor du yi/ /nye dbang sde cad gom gsum mnon/ /sbyin byed dgra dang sgra gcan gsod/ /mkhar ba'i dgra dang 'og dbang skyes/ /dpal be'u sa mtshan dang go brnyi/ /a shu ze thos dpal gyi lags/ /mi yi seng ge mi'u thung / /nag po mi 'jigs khyu mchog lto/ /dbyig gi lto ba nabs so skyes/ /zla ba'i snying po mthon po'i lha/ /'phrog —byed thig le drug pa dang / /'jug pa bcu pa dga' byed dang / /'gro skyob rdeb byed stobs ldan 'joms/ /ser skya zhi ba khyab 'jug ming / /mi 'dzag sngon skyes rab 'phyong gsod/ /nam gru dga' byed stobs bzang dang / /gtun shing can dang ha las mtshan/ /'dod skyong legs mgul stobs ldan rnams//khyab 'jug gi ni phu bo'i ming / /myos byed yid srubs yid las skyes/ /me tog gzhu can me tog mda'/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan nya yi tog /dga' byed lus med dga' ma'i bdag /dregs byed tshangs 'joms dka' thub dgra/ /na tshod skyes dang mda' lnga pa/ /sprang rtsi'i kha lo mi zad mtshon/ /rtse dga'i 'khri shing rgyal dka' dang / /sred byed chags bde yid la nyal/ /dga' rab dbang phyug stobs 'phel dgra/ /dran pa'i shing rta 'gro rtsen sogs/ /khyab 'jug bur gyur 'dod lha'i ming / /sna tshogs tog dang 'gro ba'i tog /nyag phran bdag po ma 'gag pa/ /tshangs pa skyes dang gos sngon can/ /'dod lha'i bu yi ming yin no/ /ka ma la can 'phrog byed yum/ /pad+ma'i gnas can 'phrog byed dga'/ /dpal mo dpal 764

gnas pad+ma can/ /khyab 'jug gi ni chung ma'i ming / /'khor lo legs mthong dung lnga skyes/ /dbyug pa sa mos nor bu ni/ /sa brtan byed dang sa rings dang / /ral gri dga' byed la sogs pa/ /khyab 'jug gi ni phyag mtshan ming / /mkha' 'gro'i dbang shā da skar ma'i bu/ /khyab 'jug shing rta klu mthar byed/ /'dab bzang gser 'dab dug 'das sa dang / /skya rengs nu bo rdo rje'i mchu/ /ga li gnas gser gyi lus/ /'dab chags seng ge rnam 'dul skyes/ /lto 'gro'i zas can 'dab chags rgyal/ /khyab 'jug shing1rta mkha' lding ming / /khyu mchog rgyal mtshan1u ma'i bad ga /gangs ri'i bdag po raka khur can/ /drag po 'phrog byed bde 'byung dang / /gtsug na zla ba sna tshogs mig /mig gsum pa dang thod pa 'chang / /dpal mgrin mgrin dag mgrin sngon can/ /dgra sta'i dum bu me'i khu ba/ /grong gsum mthar byed gaṅgā 'dzin/ /ga las g.yos dang lha chen go /ri khrod pa dang phyogs gos can/ /skye brtagazhu can long ba'i dgra/ /grong 'jom phyug bdag dpa' mo'i dpal/ /ha ming can dang khri kang cig /mchog dga' mdung thogs dbang ldan dang / /sim byed bde byed 'byung po'i dbang / /pags pa'i gos can 'chi las rgyal/ /mig mi bzang dang g.yon phyogs lha/ /nam mkha'i skra can mchod sbyin 'joms/ /dran pa'i dgra dang rtse gsum can/ /sngon dmar can sogs dbang phyug ming / /dkar rgo ri sras ri skyes dang / /ka t+ya'i bu mo dka' bzlog ma/ /rdzong ma nag mo ma mo'i ma/ /zhi ba'i sring mo skra 'dres ma/ /khyab 'jug sring mo gtum mo dang / /zhi ma drag mo ser skya ma/ /sim byed ma dang ri khrod ma/ /gangs ldan bu mo lo ma rdo med/ /dpal mo seng ge'i shing rta ma/765

dbang phyug gi ni chung ma'i ming / /mche ba gcig ma glang po'i gdong / /bgegs kyi rgyal po log 'dren dang //lto 'phyang lus gnyis ma gnyis ma/ /ha la gnas dang dgra sta can/ /dbang phyug du che tshogs bdag ming / /gzhon nu skom byed sa ga skyes//khrung khrung 'joms dang gdong drug pa//gaṅgā skyes dang 'dam bu skyes//gtsug phud can zhon lha'i dmag dpon//ri sras dga' byed ma drug pa/ /bya gag rgyal mtshan mang po skyes/ /sde can me skyes mdung thung can//dbang phyug bu chung smin drug ming //legs bris dbang po skabs gsum bdag /bde sogs bdag po mig stong can/ /dbang po 'phrog byed rdo rje 'chang //mchod sbyin brgya pa stobs ldan dgra//gtsang byed mgon po mtho ris rgyal/ /gzhan snyems bzod dang sprin la zhon/ /ko shi ka shis brjod nyan//gang po 'bod dang smin pa gsod//rgan las thos dang rta ljang can/ /ri 'joms legs skyob dbyig ldan dang / /khyab stobs kun 'joms bzod dkas rengs//pu lo ma'i dgra bcud ldan bdag /ha ri'i rta can brgya byin ming //'chi med dbang po bde sogs dang //sha rtsi dang ni legs brjod ma/ /nor sbyin ma dang lha'i btsun mo/ /brgya byin gyi ni chung ma'i ming //sum cu rtsa gsum lta na sdug/brgya byin gyi ni grong gi ming //rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang / /rnam par rgyal byed ba dan can/ /brgya byin gyi ni pho brang ming //lha yi 'dun sa chos bzang dang //dga' tshal shing rta sna tshogs tshal/ /rtsub 'gyur tshal dang 'dres pa'i tshal/ /brgya byid gyi ni tshal gyi ming / /'tsho skyes dang ni sa srungs du/ /sgra sgrog sgra 'byin sprin gyi glang //sprin sgrol ma yi khyo la sogs//brgya byin zhon pa glang po'i ming ma ta 766

li di kha lo pa//'thor thos brgya byin rta yi ming //'jigs byed lag nyal rtse brgya pa/ /sgra gcan za byed bgyings 'gro dang / /gnam lcags bde byed ri bo 'joms/ /skabs gsum mtshon cha rdo rje'i thog /sgra sgrog sgrogs zhum ri 'gems rnams//brgya byin mtshon cha rdo rje'i ming //'chi med btung ba 'chi med bcud//btung byed tshim byed ro brgya pa//gdung sel lha yi bdud rtsi'i ming / /nam mkha'i gang gra mtho ris klung / /bcud ldan ring po lha'i rdzing ring / /dal 'bab lha yi chu bo'i ming / /'tsher byed lhun po gser gyi ri/ /rin chen rdul brtsegs lha'i ri bo//ri rab ri rgyal ri yi dbang //lha gnas ri bo mchog rab ming //de ba da ru lha'i ljon pa//dpag bsam yid mos rgya mtsho skyes//yongs 'du sa brtol rje ra//ha ri tsan dan bsil byed dang //ko ji da ra la sogs pa//lha yi ljon shing rnam gyi ming //kun byed gzhon nu rnam 'byed bu/ /mtho ris sman pa tha skar skyes//rgod ma'i bu dang nad sel dang //sna skyes lha yi sman pa'i ming //til mchogs ma dang pad dkar ma//lag bzang dga' ba'i shing rta ma/ /muñdza skyes ma legs brgyan ba/ /me na kā dang skras rtsen ma/ /glog 'od chu shing brla can ma/ /skad snyan ma dang skra 'dres ma//rab tu myos ma dbang mo che/ /lha yi smad 'tshong rnams kyi ming / /sngon gyi glu dbyangs len pa dang / /sgra ngan sgangs pa'i gru dbyangs can//glu snyan dbyangs snyan mgrid— snyan rnams/ /lha yi gru mkhad dri za'i ming / /byin za rnyed za rten za dang / /mtshun za srog za sna tshogs za/ /za byed za phogarlung gi grogs//dag byed gtsang byed 'khyog 'gro dang / /shing 'phel 'bar byed gtsug phud can//nyer zhi rta dam pa'od nor can//'od bkra sreg byed 767

chu'i skye gdas//lha zhal mtshun zhal nor las rgyal//smin byed gser gyi jig le dang / /gyen 'gro 'od 'grib snga dro 'bar/ /gser gyi khu ba 'od bdud pa/ /gsal byed lam nag chu mkhris dang / /skems byed 'phrog byed 'bar ba'i skra/ /zun sel nun 'joms du ba'i tog /'tsho byed lus 'phel rtse mo can/ /me dang me lha'i thun mong ming / /brang skyes rgod ma kha yi me/ /lho yi me dang rgya mtsho 'thung //me ri rta gdong me yi ming //'phro byed 'khyug byed yal me dang / /me'i yan lag me rtse'i ming / /'phros 'gros me yi zeg ma dang / /rab 'phro me skar me stag ming //shin tu gdung dang yongs su gdung //tshad pa can dang tsha gdung can//rngul byed me yi reg bya'i ming //sprin gyi bzhon pa skra yi phreng / /me 'bras nam mkha'i ta ma la/ /me yi gtsug phud me'i rgyal mtshan//gyu gyur 'gro dang me yi skra//me mang skyes sogs du ba'i ming chos kyi rgyal po mtshungs 'jug dang / /pha yi bdag po dbyug pa can/ /dbyug 'dzin be con 'chang ba dang / /'chi bdag lnga pa'i bdag dang ni/ /'phrog byed dus 'dzin yi dwags bdag /mthar byed grangs can nyi ma'i bu/ /ma te'i rgyal mtshan mtshun gyi lha//ya mu na spun ma mo'i rgyal//lho phyogs bdag po gshin rje'i ming / /gdong bcu mgrin bcu bka'i bdag /sgra sgrogs ro zan sha rjen za/ /sha za khrag 'thung mtshan mo rgyu/ /'jigs byed bden bral mtshan mo spyod//gsod bdag skyes dang za byed dang //sna tshogs mdog can srin po'i ming / /mchog sems mchog sbyin zhags pa can/ /chu bdag char 'bebs 'brug sgra can/ /nags tshal can dang chu ldan dang / /bsil ba 'dzin sogs chu lha'i ming //dbugs 'byin 'gro byed yang dag rgyug/nam 768

mkha'i srog dang nam mkha'i dbugs/ /dri bzhod dri led dri'i shing rta//rtag 'gro myur 'gro mgyogs 'gro dang / /'phrog byed reg ldan 'gro ba'i srog /reg 'dzin reg byed kun tu rgyu/ /kun byed 'gro ba'i ngang tshul dang / /dag byed mkha' bdag rta dmar can/ /rta khral ngal med bsil byed dang / /g.yo byed gnas med ma mos 'phel/ /rlung dang rlung lha'i thun mong ming / /srog 'dzin thur sel mnyam gnas dang / /gyen rgyu khyab byed las kyi rlung / /rlung gi bye brag so so'i ming / /gnod sbyin rgyal po gsang ba'i bdag /mi gsum grogs po lus ngan dab / /mi'am ci dbang nor sbyin rgyal/ /mi la zhon dang rkang gsum pa/ /dmar ser mig dang bsod nams skyes/ /e la'i rgyud dang ngal gsos po/ /ku be ra dang nor sbyin bu/ /nor gyi dbang zug gnas srung po/ /gter gyi bdag po rnam sras ming / /shing rta sna tshogs de yi tshal/ /lcang lo can ni de yi grong / /gar mkhan mchog ni de yi bu/ /mi'am ci dang ci'i skyes bu/ /rta yi gdong can 'gro mgyogs 'khor/ /de yig ter ni dung can dang / /pad chen pad ma chen po dang / /chu srin can dang rus sbal can/ /rnga yab can dad dga' ba can/ /sngon po 'dzin byed la sogs dgu/ /lha lam rlung lam sprin gyi lam/1bya lam mkha' lam khyab 'jug gnas/ /mtha' med kun gsal sgra sgogs dang / /kun khyab lus med rgyu skar lam/ /myur khyab rgyas byed bar snang lam/ /lhas rtsen rol gnas skye med gdas/ /kun khebs go 'byed tshu mthongs dang / 1lha yi rdzing ring nam mkha'i ming / /kun khyab 'phrog byed nyi mas ston/ /gas gnas phyogs sgo phyogs kyi ming / /dbye na phyogs bcu de yi ming / /tshangs pa dbang pod me1 gshin rje bden 769

bral chu dang rlung //lus ngan dbang ldan phyogs rim bzhin//mtsho skyes pad dkar g.yon phyogs dang / /sa mos gsal byed me tog so/ /sa steng grags dang cha mdzes dmas//phyogs kyi glang po brgyad kyi ming //sprin grol ma dang ser skya ma//dmar ser ma dang dpe med ma//zangs sna can dang so legs ma/ /yan lag mdzes ma mchod ldan ma/ /phyogs kyi glang mo brgyad kyi ming / /khor yug nu khyud lcags ri'i ming //tshad 'joms dga' byed chu khur can//chu 'dzin rgyun 'dzin rlan 'dzin dang / /chu 'bebs chu 'gyed mkha'i rgyal mtshan/ /du ba'i skyes gnas nam mkha'i gling / /sgrol byed chu yi bzhon pa dang / /glog ldan nam mkha'i ta mā la//chu yi sprud ldan chu mang 'dzin//myos byed nam mkha'i du ba dang //char ldan chu skyed nags tshal skye//nam mkha'i glang po sgra sgrogs dang / /chur nyal bsil byed mkha' gso can//ka dam pa can sprin gyi ming //sgra sgrogs sgra can sgra brgya pa//sgra 'gyed sprin skyes lha'i rnga dbyangs/ /nam mkha'i rnga chen rnga gsang dang / /sprin gyi sgra dang sprin gyi rnga/ /dbyar skyes rnga sgra 'brug gi ming / /sprin lce 'khyug byed skad cig gsal/ /bde 'byung rnam gsal g.yo ba'i 'od/ /rnam bkra 'jug pa brgya pa dang / /lcug ma'i 'od dang se gol 'od/ /sprin gyi lhag ma glog gi ming / /sprin gyi bcud dang mkha' las babs//rgyun 'babs yongs lhung sprin las byung //dgung char gru char zim bu'i char/ /sbrang char char rgyun char zil dang / /sprin zegs chu zegs bde zil can/ /sprin gyi me tog char ba'i ming / /dbang po'i shing bal dbang po'i gzhu/ /dbang po'i mtshon cha brgya byin mtshon/ /lha yi tshon ris rgan po'i thig /rlung 'bras rlung 'khyog ro hi ta/ /770

sos ka bshad dang chu las 'bar/ /bde sogs bdag po'i mda' stan dang / /'ja' 'od 'ja' ris 'ja' gur gzha'/ /sprin gyi 'od zer 'ja' tshon ming / /'phrog 'joms ri 'joms lce 'beb pa/ /rdo rje'i zer 'phro 'jigs byed dngad /'gems byed chad nyams thog gi ming / /rdo rje'i char dang sdang byed dang / /'joms byed me char ser ba'i ming / /zhod 'gags cha— med than chen dang / /gdung byed drod 'bar than pa'i ming mi gsal mi snang 'thibs po dang / /mi mngon smag rum nun rum dang / /kun khebs sgrib byed nun pa'i ming //sim byed bsil byed 'od dkar can//ri bong 'dzin pa bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /bdud rtsi'i dbang po gnyis skyes dbang / /bde 'byung gtsug rgyan bsil zer can/ /tshes bdag mtshan mo'i nor bu dang / /cha shas gter dang rgyu skar bdag /chu shel dbang po'i ri dwags mtshan/ /ga dur 'dzag dang ku nud gnyen/ /bdud rtsi'i 'a byung gnas pad+ma'i dgra/ /'grib byed byed can rtag can dang / /shar gyi thig le ri bong can/ /cha byed mtsho skyes kha ba'i 'od/1nam mkha'i rna ba snar ma'i bdag /rgya mtsho skyes dang chu las skyes/ /steng 'phur chags skyed rgya mtsho dga'/ /cha gter nun 'joms ga bur dbang / /bsil sbyin mkhan dang thos ldan dbang / /rgya mtsho'i mar gsar bdud rtsi spro/ /rgyu skar nu khyud cha shas can/ /bcu drug cha ldan mtshan mo'i mgon/ /'od lus kud phan zla ba'i ming /rol 'gro sa skyes lus dmar dang / /pa sangs bu dang sa las byung / /'od zer dgu pa sa yi bu/ /bkra shis rtsibs ldan mig dmar ming / /zla ba'i bu dang snar ma skyes/ /sngo bsangs lus dpa gsere ldan dang / /tshim byed skyes 771

rnams lhag pa'i ming //tshig gi bdag po lha'i slob dpon//lha yi sgra mkhan smra ba'i bdag /dbyangs bdag 'tsho byed gtsug phud bkra/ /dum skyes pha bdun phur bu'i ming / /dal 'gro dal rgyu nyi ma'i bu/ /'od zer bdun pa gos sngon can/ /gshin rje'i ba dan spen pa'i ming / /sbyin byed bla ma snyan ngag bu//ngan spong bu dang 'od can dang //khu ba mdog mdzes sne gu'i du//lha min bla ma dkar po dang //bcu drug 'od ldan pa sangs ming mtho ris gsal dang seng ge can/ /skabs gsum 'dzin byed nyi zla za/ /drag po'i gzugs cad mig sman mdog /srid gsum rnam rgyal bdud rtsi za/ /mgo klum seng ge mo yi bu//sha za lam nag zla ba 'joms//mun can gza' yi rna ba 'dzin//sprin las rnam rgyal sgra gcan ming / /nam mkha'i nor du rta ljang can/ /khyim gyi bdag po bcu gnyis bdag /gza' yi bdag po me sbyin skyes/ /snang byed nyin byed 'od stong can/ /'od bkra 'od gsal rta bdun pa/ /dbyig gi khu ba pad ma'i grogs/ /bla med 'od 'byin nun pa'i dgra/ /'od kyi nor can tshangs pa'i rta/ /nam mkha'i tog dang mkha' lam pa//chu yi chom rkun gdung byed dang / /srid pa'i mig dang pad+ma'i gnyen/ /khyab gsal 'od ldan 'od nor can/ /rta dmar can dang snang ba'i bdag /pad+ma'i rtsa lag tsha zer can//sgrol byed mchod 'os char 'bebs pa//bdun gyi bdun pa bdud las rgyal//'gro ba'i sgron— ma 'phrog byed dang //dus kyi byed po nyi ma'i ming //gsod byed dmar ser dpyad ldan dang //gtum po 'od skor nyi ma'i 'khor/ /nyi ma'i kha lo khyung sngon skyes/ /'od dmar brla med 'od srungs dang //nyi ma'i pho nya skya rengs ming //'od kyi dkyil 'khor 772

'od khyim dang / —/'od lha gur khang yongs su bskor/ /'od kyi lding khang 'ja' yi gur/ /nye ba'i nyi ma nyi za' thog /nyi ma'i rna cha nyi khyim ming / /tsha zer gdung byed mtshan ka'ajoms/ /skems byed chu 'thung gdung ldan 'od/ /kun gsal kun snang 'od chags dang / /nyi zer gnyi zer nyi 'od ming / /snang ba gsal ba 'od kyi tog /nun sel rab 'phro phyogs su 'gro/ /snang byed gsal byed snang gas dang / /'od byed 'od mdangs srin du 'joms/ /mdangs 'od zer mdangs zer phreng dang / 'od zer 'od phreng 'od spyi'i ming / /'gro byed 'od can sgrol byed dang / /'phur byed rnams ni rgyu skar ming / /gya rgyud ri mo ri dwags sred/ /khrag khrig snang ba g.yo ba'i 'od/ /'chir 'jug rgyang ring chu bo dang / /bar snang chu rlabs smig rgyu'i ming / /bgrang bya nyer1'gro yang dag 'gro/ /tshod dang gnas dang tshig dang ni/ /bstan bya 'dor byed dus kyi ming / /'phel ba 'grib pa cha shas dang / /gral tshes tshes grangs tshes kyi grangs / /nun bsal mun bral nyi bcas gdugs/ /skabs yod rtsen dus snang ba ldan/ /nyi ldog bya mang nyin mo'i ming / /nub mo bya bral phra 'jug dang / /nun canas la ldan thun gsum pa/ /snang med zhir 'jug thun tshod can/ /sngo bsangs mdang mel tshe ma/ /dal byin ma dang gnyid snan ma/ /gnas dus 'khrig dus yi dwags rgyu/ /dgung dang nges nyal bsam gtan ma/ /zla 'od can ma mtshan mo'i ming bde dus mi sgrib rab rib sel/ /nyid mo'i thog ma nyin mo'i sgo/ /nam langs nyi shar snga dro'i ming / /nyi rgas dgong mo nyin mo'i mtha'/ /dgong thun nyin mjug phyi dro'i ming / /nyin dkyi da / nyid byed nyid mo'i da dus/ /nyin zud 773

dgung tshig nyin gung ming / /mtshan mo'i dang po mtshan mo'i sgo/ /nam stod yi dwags glag lta'i dus/ /sa rub nam rmus srod kyi ming / /byang chub dus dang mtshad mo'i mtha'//mtshan mo'i mjug dang nam smad dang //skya rengs ldan pa tho rengs ming / /nam phyed mtshan phyed nam gyi dbus/ /mtshan mo'i dkyil rnams nam gung ming //mel tshe zhes pa thun mtshams ming //snga dro phyi dro nyi ma gung / /nyin mo'i thud tshod dag gi ming / /srod dang nam gung tho rengs rnams//mtshan mo'i thun tshod dag gi ming //'dod pa'i dus dang tsha ba'i dus/ /myu gu'i dus dang sbrang ldan dus/ /me tog dus dang bde byed dus/ /drod ldan nges sreg tsha gdung can/ /tshad zla so ga dpyid kyi ming / /char dus char ldan chu ldan dang / /sprin 'byung sprin skyes dbyar gyi ming / /'bras ldan 'bras bu smin pa'i dus/ /gser ldan ma ni ston gyi ming / /kha ba'i dus dang grang ba'i dus/ /bsil ldad ma ni dgun gyi ming / /lo yi cha shas lo'i yan lag /nyin zhags tshogs pa lo yi mdzod//phyogs can 'jal byed dus zla'i ming //dkar phyogs 'phel phyogs phyogs snga ma//cha shas rim rdzogs cha shas dar//gang phyogs zla stod yar ngo'i ming //nag phyogs 'grib phyogs phyogs phyi ma/ /cha shas 'dzad dang cha nyams dang / /dmar phyogs zla smad mar ngo'i ming / /dga' ba bzang po rgyal ba rnams/ /stong pa rdzogs pa 'di dag rnams/ /ngo gnyis dag la lan gsum re/ /phyogs kyi dang po tshes dang po/ /phyogs kyi thog ma tshes kyi thog /phyogs kyi rtsa ba tshes kyi rtsa/ /'di rnams tshes gcig dag gi ming //zla ba gang ba zla ba nya//dkyil 'khor gang ba cha rdzogs dus/ /nya gang ri bong can gyi zhag /mngon byang chub dus bco 774

lnga'i ming / /zla ba zad pa cha mnyam dang / /nyi zla kha sbyor lhan cig gnas/ /rjes 'du nam gang gnam stong ming //zla tshes zla ba gzhon nu'i dus//zla ba mthong ba'i dus kyi ming / /nyi bsgyur sgra gcan gyis zos dang / /spyang kis zos dang me tog ldan/ /nyi zla gcig sbyor sgra gcan zhugs/ /nyi zla gza' yis bzung ba'i ming / /mig 'dzum gcig gam se gol gcig /drug cu tsa bzhi zu ba'i cha//dus mtha'i skad cig mig 'dzum kyang //bco brgyad mthar gnas de sum bcu/ /cha shas sum cu de skad cig /de ni bcu gnyis yud tsam ste/ /de sum cu la nyin gcig /nyin zhag bco lnga la phyogs te/ /phyogs gnyis bsdoms pas zla ba gcig /mgo zla la sogs gnyis gnyis la//dus tshigs de gsum bgrod pa gcig /lho byang bgrod pa gnyis la lo/ /zhor la nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i ming //thad kar bgrod pa 'phel 'grib med//nyin mtshan mtshungs dang dus mnyam mo//mgo dang zla nya 'dzom pa'i zla//ming ni mgo can rgyal la sogs//lhag ma bcu gnyis kyang de bzhin//zla ba de dag so so'i ming //ju'i yol phag gi zla ba dang //dgun zla ra ba smal po'i zla//rga shi'i zla ba kā ma na/ /'dod pa'i zla ba mig 'byed pa/ /lo mgo sa yi dbang phyug zla/ /mṛ ga shi ra ri dwags mgo /mgo can gyi ni zla ba'i ming / /zhu'i yol byi ba'i zla ba dang //nyi zlog zla ba dgun zla 'bring //ma rig zla ba ro nyi ta/ /rgyu skar bzang po'i zla ba dang / /'phel ba'i zla ba su n+ya rnams/ /rgyal gyi zla ba yi ni ming / /ne'u yol dang ni glang gi zla/ /'du byed zla ba dgun tha chung / /mo nyi ta dang gti nug zla/ /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba dang / / dka' thub zla ba mā ga rnams//mchu can gyi ni zla ba'i ming //la'u yol dang 775

ni stag gi zla//dpyid zla ra ba khra'i zla ba//rnam shes zla ba gdung byed zla//snya tra'i zla ba bzang po'i zla//'bras zla phal gu niḥ ka rnams//sbo 'am dbo yi zla ba'i ming //thur yol dang ni yos zla dang //dpyid zla 'bring po byi'u zla//khyu mchog zla ba bri ṣa bha//ming gzugs zla ba 'dod dus zla//rtsa tra nag pa zla ba'i ming //lung yol 'brug gi zla ba dang //dpyid zla tha chung rnam mthong zla/ /skye mched drug gi zla ba dang / /kurma dang ni rus sngal zla/ /me tog ldan dang sprang ldan dang / /mgu byed dang ni bai sha kha/ /sa ga can ni zla ba'i ming //zhe'u yol dang ni sprul zla dang //dbyar zla ra ba gdu bu'i zla//reg pa yi ni zla ba dang //ma ra ka dang chu srin zla//'dod 'phel dga' byed zla ba dang //thu bo'i zla ba khu ba'i zla//rje sbon gyi zla ba'i ming //ma yol rta yi zla ba dang / /dbyar zla 'bring po bre phul zla/ /tshor ba yi ni zla ba dang / /daṇ+ḍa yugs sa ma'i zla ba//nyi 'od ldan zla mi bzod zla//sa ṣa rnya rnams chu stod zla/ /yang yol lug gi zla ba dang //dbyar zla tha chung bya sbo'i zla//sred pa yi ni zla ba dang //mi ki ra dang spe ba'i zla//nam mkha'i sgra sgrogs zla ba dang //chu 'dzag zla ba shra ma ṇaḥ gro bzhin can gyi zla ba'i ming / /hu ru yol dang sprel zla dang //ston zla ra ba led pa'i zla//'gugs pa'i zla ba rnyi tri ka /sprin bzang khyu mchog rkang pa dang / /ba lang zla ba ba lang rkang / /bha tra pa dāḥkhrums zla'i ming / /kyi yol bya yi zla ba dang / /dbyug gu'i zla ba ston zla 'bring //srid pa yi ni zla ba dang //bya ku la dang 'phyo ba'i zla//ston mo'i zla ba a shī ni//tha skar can gyi zla ba'i ming //ga'u yol dang ni khyi'i zla ba//nya drug zla ba ston tha chung //ga sna dang ni mi lam zla//mang ster zla ba spro dga' 776

can/ /skye ba'i zla ba ba ka /smin drug can gyi zla ba'i ming / /mgo rgyal gnyis ni dgun stod dus//mchu dbo gnyis ni dgun smad dus//nag pa sa ga dpyid kyi dus/ /smon dang chu stod so ga'i dus/ /gro bzhin khrums stod dbyar gyi dus//tha skar smin drug ston gyi rdus//rang skyob 'dor byed bgrang bzhi dang / /dus kyi tshigs dang zla ba'i phreng / /bgrang bya dus kyi cha shas can/ /mi zad pa rnams lo yi ming / /zhar la lo ni so so'i ming / /byi glang stag yos 'brug sgrul rta/ /lug sprel bya khyi phag bcu gnyis/ /shing me sa lcags chu khams lnga//pho mos bsgyur ba drug cu ste//rab byung (me mo yos)rnam byung (sa lo 'brug)dkar po (sa mo sprul)dang / /rab myos (lcags pho rta)skyes bdag(lcags mo lug)maṅga ra(chu pho sprel)//dpal gdong (chu mo bya)dngos po (shing pho khyi)na tshod ldan (shing mo phag)//'dzin byed (me dza byi)dbang zug (me mo glang)'bru mang po(sa dza stag)//myos ldan (sa mo yos)rnam gnon (lcags pho 'brug)khyu mchog (lcags mo sprul)dang //sna tshogs (chu pho rta)nyi ma (chu mo lug)nyi sgrol byed(shing pho sprel)//sa skyong (shing mo bya)mi zad (me pho byi)thams cad 'dul(me mo phag)//kun 'dzin (sa dza byi)'gal ba (sa mo glang)rnam 'gyur (lcags pho stag)dang / /bong bu (lcags mo yos)dga' ba (chu mo 'brug)rnam rgyal (chu mo sprul)nyid//rgyal ba (shing dza rta)myos byed (shing mo lug)gdong ngan (me pho sprel)dang //gser 'phyang (me mo bya)rnam 'phyang (sa pho khyi)bsgyur byed (sa mo phag)dang //kun ldan (lcags dza byi)'phar ba (lcags mo glang)dge byed (chu pho stag)dang / /mdzes byed (chu mo yos)khro mo (shing pho 'brug)sna tshogs dbyig(shing mo zul)/ /zil gnon (me 'o rta)spre'u (me mo lug)phur du (sa mo 777

sprel)dang / /zhi ba (sa mo bya)thun mong (lcags pho khyi)'gal byed (lcags mo phag)dang //yongs 'dzin (chu dza byi)bag med (chu mo glang)kun dga'(shing pho stag)dang //srin po (shing mo yos)me dang (me pho 'brug)dmar ser can(me mo sprul)//dus kyi pho nya (sa pho rta)don 'grub (sa mo lug)drag(lcags pho sprel)//blo ngan (lcags mo bya)rnga chen (chu pho khyi)khrag sgyug (chu mo phag)dang / /mig dmar (shing pho byi)khro bo (shing mo glang)zad pa'o(me pho stag)//yongs 'joms (bskal pa'i ming)rab thim rab nub dang / /zad pa dang ni mthar phyid byed/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtha' dang //zad dus dang ni lo'i phung po//dus bzhi rdzogs pa bskal pa'i ming //rab bsngags 'dzin pa yang dag sbyor/ /bde skyed bde ster legs byas dang / /legs ldan dge legs mtho ris gnas/ /rab zhi zhi ba bde legs dang / /bde ba'i 'byung gnas dge ba'i ming / /nyes pa nyes spyod nag nog dang / /nyes byed ltung ba rnyog pa dang / /smad bya nun pa zug rngu dang / /smas byed dngos sdig sdig lta dang / /nyams byed rigs 'phel ngan 'gro'i lam/ /nyung byed spang bya sdig pa'i ming / /bsngags 'os phan 'thob mchog sbyin dang / /legs byas khyu mchog yid bzhin 'grub//re skong dge ba'i cho ga dang //lhas bskos gnam bskos skal pa'i phul//lhas bstan bsags rgyab sngon bsags mthu//bgo skal kha rje bsod nams ming //grol ba rnam grol zhi ba dang //nges legs dbugs 'byin mya ngan 'das//ma 'dres tshangs pa nges 'byung dang //bdud rtsi rab tshim bsil ba'i dngos/ /rdul med rdul bral rdul spang ba/ /rnam byang byang chub mi gnas pa/ /dga' ba che dang yang srid med/ /byang grol bde ldan 778

thar pa'i ming //blo dang rnam dpyod rig pa dang //blo gros yid gzhung rnam rig byed/ /don sems don rtogs don rab mthong / /rab tu rnam 'byed khong du chud/ /go ba dpyod pa shes rab ming / /yid dang dran pa sems pa dang //blo dang rig pa snying dang ni//shes pa nang gi byed pa dang //rnam shes kun gzhi sems kyi ming //yang dag rtog dang kun tu rtog/yid byed sems byed rjes su dpag/sems kyi longs spyod mno bsam dang / /brtag dpyad 'jal byed don bgrang ba/ /yid la byed pa rtog dpyod ming / /skye dgu skye 'gro 'gro ba dang / /skyes bu gang zag sems pa can/ /tshe ldan sems ldan yid ldan dang / /skye ldan srog ldan 'tsho ba can/ /lus can srog mags sems cad ming / /smra ba brjod pa gleng mo gtam/ /gleng brjod smra brjod mngon brjod dang / /rjod byed mgrin skyes ngag tshig ming / /nges sgrogs grags pa lhang tser dang //ding 'ur 'ur tir 'ar 'ur sgra//ca co ku co klag cor dang / /dbyangs dang sgrog pa sgra tsam ming //rab gus nyer sems rtag tu sems/ /rab dad rab mos dad dang mos/ /gcig tu sems dang snying nas sems//mgu byed mnyes byed gus pa'i ming //brnyas dang kun brnyas brnyas byed dang / /'tshe sems 'gran sems phrag dog sems/ /gnod sems zil gnon zhum byed dang / /zhe 'gras zhe 'khon ma gus ming / /bsngags dang rab sngags bstod bsngags dang / /yon tan sgrog dang yon tan brjod/ /legs sgrogs legs brjod bstod pa'i ming / /nyes brjod spyo dang nye bar spyo/ /smad dang nges smod yongs spyod dab / /gshe dang phyar kha g.yas gdags pa//sun 'byin skyod brjod bsku 'debs dang / /mi 779

bsngags brjod pa smad pa'i ming / /yid gnyis som nyi snyam sems dang / /nem nur dogs pa 'phyang mo nyug /'dra ba cig min the tshom ming //gtan la phebs dang dpyis phyin pa/ /the tshom bral dang som nyi spang / /nges shes mngon gyur yid ches ming / /bzhin dud dmig dma' zhum byed dang / /'dzem dang khrel yod ngo tsha'i ming / /zhe 'khon khong khro khong nas 'khrugs/ /gdung sems mnar sems mi zad sems//bzhin bsdus mig g.yon smin 'khyog dang //mi bzod sdang sems khro ba'i ming //zhi ba dul ba nyer zhi ba//mi 'khrugs khro bral brtan pa dang //ngang tshul bzang ba bzod pa'i ming //ku re kyal ka ga zha dang / /'dod gtam dgod bag bzhad gad ming / /mchod dang dus ston dga' ston dang / /dgod dang nyer dga' dngos po dang //rang bzhin rang gzugs ngo bo nyid//'dres pa la sogs dga' ston ming //'og phyogs rkang 'og stobs ldan gnas//bcu 'og 'og gnas klu'i 'jig rten/ /lto 'bye che gnas sa 'og ming / /khung dang glo bug skar khung dang / /khung bu du ga pad mig dang / /gsal mthongs rlung 'byung sa yi mthongs/ /dong po bug sgo du ga'i ming / /nun stug ldongs pa snang med dang / /rab rib smag dang nun nag dang / /mun 'thib nun 'khrigs she nun dang / /nun can nun rum nyin mthar byed/ /nam mkha'i pags pa mtshan mo'i pags/ /nyin mo'i sgo nga nun pa'i ming / /ri gnas ka dru'i bu rnams te//de yi gtso bo mtha' yas dang //lhag ma 'jig pa nor rgyas bu//sprul gyi rgyal po yul 'khor skyong / /gdengs ka bdun pa nor las rgyal/ /gdengs can bdag po lag 'gro'i mgon/ /phyugs bdag gdengs can 780

'dren pa dang / /klu yi dbang phyug klu rgyal lo/ /ba lang sna dang thig le'i lus//dong gnas nyal byed rlung zas can//shun pa brje dang go cha grol//sa la 'khyog dang sa la ba/ /lag 'gro myur 'gro gya gyur 'gro/ /'khyogs 'gro brang 'gro sto 'gro dang //dug 'dzin sto 'bye 'khor lo can//'khyil ba rkang sbas mig gis thos//mche ba'i dug can gzer bu mgo /rgyab ring zas ngan khung du nyal//gdengs can lce gnyis rkang mi 'gro//bum sna can rnams sprul gyi ming / /kā ko la(shun pa'i dug kyang zer)dang nag po brtsegs(ka la ku ṭa)//ha la ha la (rtsa ba'i dug kyang zer)brtan pa'i dug/so'i ke ya('bras du'i dug kyang zer)tshangs pa'i bu//rab tu gsal dang 'joms (lo ma'i dug kyang zer)byed ster/ /be'u'i lto ba (sdong po'i dug kyang zer)lha bu ste/ /dug gi dbye ba dgu yi ming / /dug sel dang ni dug 'joms dang / /sprul khas 'tsho dang dug nad gso/ /sprul 'joms dug gi sman pa'i ming / /ngan song ngan 'gro ngan 'gro'i mthil//'dod bral zal dang dga' med dang //tshe ring po dang bzod dka' ba/ /na ra ya ṇaḥ ba ba'i ming / /rgya bcas chu 'dzin zla bas 'phel//pha rol 'grib dang chu klung bdag /chu srel chu gter dug can gnas/ /rin chen 'byung gnas chu bdag dang / /chu srin 'byung gnas chu srin bdag /chu yi phung po te ma'i mdzod/ /zla ba'i ma ma ro ldan ma/ /gaṅgā 'dzin dang she bdag /chu dbang mtsho dang mtsho chen dang //rus sbal che ldan rlabs phreng can//ri yi thod can tri mi'i grong //chu srin rgyal mtshan rgya mtsho'i ming / /gzhi can thur 'bab thur du lhung / /'dod byed 'bru phan nor ldan dang / /btung ba 'chi byed mi ba dang / /'tsho byed 'byung byed 781

brten gnas dang //lus 'ching 'dzag ldan gso byed dang //rgyas par byed dang sgo kun 'gro//sprin gyi me tog sprin gyi bcud//sprin gyi myu gu gzhol ba —dang / /skyong byed 'ju byed gnyan byed dang / /skom sel btang 'gro chu yi meng / /chu klung chu bo 'bab ldan ma/ /dal 'bab gling ldan klung ldan ma/ /sgyu rngol 'gro rgyun ldan nya sprubs can/ /dba' rlabs can ma skyod ldan ma/ /sgogs ldan dang ni gzhol 'bab dang / /skya nar ldad ma zla ba'i lag /chu rgyun dang ni gya gyur 'gro/ /gtsang po ngogs ldan g.yo ldan dang / /gser ḍa snan ma rnams 'bab chu'i ming //khyab 'jug rkang pa lha'i chu bo//skal ldan hūṃ/nga rta lam gsum 'gro/ /dza hu'i bu mo gsum 'bab dang / /'jigs sde skre snyed ma rgyun gsum pa/ /nam mkha'i chu bo ga ka'i ming / /nyi ma'i bu mo kā 'i1sdi//zhi ba'i sring mo ya nu tsā//e ra ba ti lo nyi ta//bka yi ni ming yin no//ri— bā dang ni karma dā//zlas byung ri bo'i bu mo dang //lag pa'i chu bo rtag tu 'bab//ba yi ni ming yin no//dpung pas byin dang dkar 'bab ma//shi ta druḥ dang brgyar gyes dang / /zhags pa grol dang bi pa ṭa: si tā yi ni ming yin no/ /dba' rlabs dba' klong rlabs 'phreng dang / /rba rlabs rba klong chu'i 'khri shing //dba' chen lha mi rba dang klong //steng 'phar steng 'phyo rab 'khrug dang / /chu rlabs chu 'khrug mchil sgrol dang / /chu gnyer khrem gnyer chu rlabs ming //dbu ba dbu phreng spu phreng dang //chu yi gad mo chu yi 'dzum//phe na zhes pa spru ba'i ming //chu thigs thigs pa thigs phran dang //chu 'thor chu zil chu yi zer/ /nyar ma chu yi zegs ma'i ming / /'gram dang 'gog byed chu ngogs dang //pha rol tshu rol phan tshun ngogs//'gram ngogs 782

'jug ngogs chu 'gram ming //'byin byed rdzab dang 'dam dang ni//'dam pa 'jim pa 'ji ba dang / /chu rtog 'jim rdzab 'dam rdzab ming / /gru chen gzings dang gru gzings dang //jings dang sgrol byed sgrol pa dang //bskul 'gro 'phyos 'gro seng ge can//rta mgo can dang gru shad dang //chu yi shing rta gru yi ming //gru mkhan gru bdag dbyug pa 'phen//gdos pa 'dzin dang skya ba 'dzin/ /rna ba 'dzin dang gru'i skyes bu/ /kha lo pa rnams mnyan pa'i ming //gru skya g.yob byed gru'i rnga yab//gru'i gshog pa gru'i yan lag /gdos pa rnams ni skya ba'i ming //sgong skyes rnam 'phyo go cha can//'gro ldan rnam rgyu rnam par skyong / /bye ma la gnas bum par rgyu/ /gser mig can dang rgyab ༄mtho dang / /mig mi 'dzum dang chus mi 'tshub/ /chu nyal chur rtse nya spyi'i ming / /na kra nya mid ma ka ra/ /chu yi srin po ba ra: bum pa'i mgo dang chus phag pa//'dzin khri chu yi zas can dang //chu yi srin ring chu srin ming //bul 'gro dal 'gro shubs ngan dang //khog pa can dang 'gram rkyong dang //dam por 'dzin dang spa kong dang //ba rnams ni rus sbal ming //karka ṭa dang ku lī ra//kha gyen phyogs dang 'phrog byed mig /'phar 'gro char skyes rma yi gnas//lce med bshang sbas sbal pa'i ming//nu tig skye gnas nu tig phor//nu tig 'byung gnas nu tig ma//nya skyogs rnams ni nya lcobs ming //za ma rtog can rus pa'i zer//cho lo'i sa bon mgron bu'i ming //sham kha chu yi ka ri ka/ /sham kha dung dang chu srin gshed/ /khab kyi kha zhes dung dkar ming / /rgya mtsho 'khyil ba bkra shis dung / /de'i mchog dka ṇa wa rte/ /brgya byin sham kha dung dkar mchog /skye ba lnga pa g.yas 'khyil ming / /'dam 783

skyes chu skyes mtsho skyes dang //'dab stong 'dab brgya chu yi rgyan//chu yi lang tsho chu nyal dang / /sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan ge sar cad/ /dri bzang khang pa 'dab ldan dang / /ge ser bzhad dang ze'u 'bru can/ /nyi mas bzhad dang dpal gos dang / /sprang rtsi'i 'dzin pa pad+ma'i ming / /pad+ma'i ze ba pad+ma'i skra/ /ke sa ra dang ze'u 'bru//pad+ma'i gtsug phud ge sar ming //sdong bu ngar ba chu ba dang / /shā lu kā dang rkang pa dang / /rtsa ba snal ma yu ba'i ming / /chu skyes sngon po steng 'thung dang //in+d+ra ba ra stobs ngan dang //rtsib 'bigs dang ni mig gi gnyen/ /sa yi gdu bu chu ram dang / /sa stobs sa 'ching ut+pal ming / /ut+pal dkar po sa mos dang / /zla ba'i dri dang zla bas dga'/ /ku nud da dang kun da dang / /mtshan mo bzhad rnams ku nud ming //brtan pa 'dzin ma nor 'dzin ma//nor ldan nor gyi blo gros ma//sa gzhi nor 'dzin mi g.yo ba//dbyig gi blo gros ma gling 'dzin//dbyig ldan ma dang dbyig 'dzin ma/ /mi g.yo rgya mcho'i ska rags can/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can zhag ldan ma/kun bzod ma dang sna tshogs 'dzin//bcud ldan mtha' yas yangs ldan dang / /skyed byed srun byed rten byed ma/ /gser ldan ma dang 'od srungs byin//chu skyob ri yi rna ba can//gser gyi snying po sa gzhi'i ming //shul lam bgrod bya grod byed dang //'jug bya 'jug ngogs 'gro sa dang //bgom bya bcad bya lam chen dang //bgrod lam lam srol lam byi'i ming / /lam mchog lam zab yang dag lam/ /lam gsang bde lam lam gyi snying / /myur lam thar lam thabs lam dang / /'khrul med lam dang 'chug med lam/ /rnam grol lam grol lam bzang ming / /lam logs lam 'chug 784

lam gol dang //'khrul lam dman lam g.yang sa'i lam//ngan 'gro'i lam dmas lam ngad ming //rten gnas skyong byed rgyal lam dang //'bab gnas dang ni tshong bdal dang //'jigs med gnas dang mi bskyod gnas//grong khyer grong brdal yul sngongs dang / /grong khyim mi khyim grong spyi'i ming / /dga' mgur spyod gnas rtse dga'i gnas//skye bo kun 'jug 'khrig gnas dang / /g.yem gnas smad 'tshong gnas kyi ming / /tshong pa tshong 'du tshong lam dang / /zong lam srang dang tshong khang dang / /rgya 'grem pa rnams tshong gnas ming //ra ba bskor dang mtha'i mu khyud//'obs dang tshal dang phyi ra dang / /khor sa khor yug lcags ri'i ming / /khyim dang khang khyim sdum du dang / /gnas dang 'dzugs bya gnas gzhi dang / /gnas khang phebs 'og 'dun gnas dang //rten gnas rten gzhi bla gab can//khyim dang khab dang khang khyim— dang //'dug gnas khang pa spyi yi ming //gzhal med khang dang pho brang dang //khang mchog khang chen khang brtsegs dang //ba gam can dang ba gam brtsegs/ /rgya phibs can dang bya 'dab can/ /rgyal mtshan can dang tog can dang / /rta babs can rnams khang bzang ming / /byed la dang dri gtsang khang / /dri 'dzin byang chub snying po'i gnas/ /gtsug lag khang dang lha'i khang pa/ /kun dga' ra ba 'du khang rnams/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bzhugs gnas ming / /chu skyob char skyob snyeng gab dang / /bla gab yibs rnams thog gi ming / 1brten pa 'gyur med steng 'dzin dang / /gdung 'degs 'degs byed ka ba'i ming / 1'dzul byed srung byed sgo mo dang / /'jug byed glang rgyab glang po'i sen//sgo 'phar sgo glegs sgo snam dang //rta 785

babs 'dzin dmas sgo yi ming //snang gsal dkar gsal skar khung dang //glo dkar glo bug snang ba'i khung //dra mig rnams ni sge'u khung ming //dkar mthongs bla mthongs bla bug dang //rgya mthongs steng sgo mthongs khung ming //them skas 'dzeg skas gdang bu can//ya gad gru skas skas ka'i ming //pu shu mda' yab lan kan dang / /kra ma ba sbos srung dang / /phug ron skyong rnams kha bad ming //sa 'dzid rdul brtsegs rtse mo can//gyen brtsegs gyen 'phyur sa gzhi 'chang / /tshigs ༅da sa skyob rdo ba brtsegs/ /mi g.yo 'gro med chu skyob dang //sprin gyi so can sa'i phur bu//brten pa can dang mgrin pa can/ /sprin 'dzin 'dzin byed ri spyi'i ming / /gling bzhi'i lte ba gling bzhi'i spo//lhun po nyi zla'i ska rags can//ri yi dbang po ri yi rgyal//bang rim can rnams ri rab ming / /kai la sha dang kha ba'i ri/ /kha ba'i rdul brtsegs gangs ldan dang / /nyi ma la ya bsil ba'i ri/ /ka bur rdul brtsegs gangs ri'i ming / /rdo ba sbod byed gor ma dang / /tsog po ju bo gtun bu dang / /sra mkhregs rnams ni rdo yi ming / /ri rtse ri zom rwa rtse dang / /lhung gnas g.yang sa ri gzar dang / /ri bo ri ngogs ri'i bya skyibs//ro zhol ri shod ri yi steng //ri khrod ri sul ri yi khug/bang rim ri ljongs ri yi 'dabs/ /ri sdings sman sngongs ri yi sbo/ /ri yi khyad par rnams kyi ming / /'brog dang dgon pa dben pa dang / /nags ri dben gnas nags tshal dang / /nags klung nags mthong drang srong gnas/ /dka' thub gnas dang bste gnas dang //dgon pa chen po nags stug po//nags tshal spyi yi ming yin no//khyim gyi tshal dang skyed mos tshal//nye 'khor 786

tshal dang byas pa'i nags//nye ba'i tshal dang nye spyod tshal//bza' shing ra ba sdum ra dang / /me tog ra ba yid mos tshal/ /rtse gnas rol gnas rol rtsed gnas//sgyu rtsal tshal dang dga' ba'i tshal//skyo bsang gnas dang yid bde'i gnas//grong khyer mtha' yi skyed tshal ming //ljon pa sa skyes yal ga can//'dab ldan rkang 'thung chur mi lhung //'gro 'gog 'gro med 'dab ma can/ /sdong po druḥm steng skye dang / /rtse mo can dang mgo ling can/ /ljon shing rnam rgyal shing spyi'i ming //'bru ldan 'bras ldan shing tog can//snye ma cad dang bza' shing rnams/ /'bras bu can gyi shing gi ming / /'dab ma yal 'dab lo ma dang / /phyogs su rnam rgyal sgrib byed dang / /gdung skyob tshad skyob shing gi gos//lhung byed yal tshogs mgo ling dang //mar gad lo ma lo 'dab ming //rab rgyas kha bye yang dag rgyas//spubs grol rnams dbye 'phro ba can//phul+la su ji ku sa ma//rgya grol yid dga' ze'u 'bru can//ge sar can dang shing gi tshon/ /rab shar 'dzum ldan bzhad ldan dang / /shing gi lang tsho me tog ming //gang bu snye ma ma lnga ri//dog pa the'u 'bras ldan dang //shing 'bras shing tog 'bras bu'i ming //she dru maḥ 'dab ma bskyod//pispa la dang glang po'i zas/ /a shad dang klak+ṣa dang / /mchod rten shing dang 'dab ma rdzum/ /mchod sbyin lo ma khyad par gnas/ /bo rnyi brik+ṣa byang chub shing / /sa ha ka ra:sa za zhim/ /tsu ta ro ldan sbrang shing dang / /shin tu ro zhim sa mra'i ming //dri zhim dkar po dri zhim btags//go shir+ṣa dang ba lang mgo/ /ha ri tsan dan me'i srub shing / /sa mchog tsan dan dkar po'i ming / /til mar can dang 'dab ma'i lus/ /tshos byed sgrum ldan sa'i 787

tsan+dan/ /tsan dan dmar po'i ming yin no/ /gdong lnga pa dang kha lnga pa/ /ri dwags rgyal po ri dwags dbang / /gcan gzan dbang po gcad gzan rgyal/ /sder chags rgyal po nags kyi bdag /ri dwags dgra dang glang po'i dgra/ /ri dwags 'tshe dang glang po 'tshe/ /ri dwags zas can gnya' ral can//ral can 'phrog byed 'phrog byed mig/stag za dred za gung za dang //gtsug phud lnga pa seng ge'i ming //steng rkang can dang sgra sgrogs dang //rkang pa brgyad pa gyen mig can/ /mdangs sgo ka dang bswe kha sgo/ /ru ru sha ra bha yi ming / /spos kyi glang po thal dkar dang / /mche ba drug pa glang po'i mchog /gnyis 'thung yan lag bdun pa dang / /so gnyis sna yi zhags pa can//lag ldan glang chen spyi yi ming //ra gcig pa dang gcig pur gnas//bse dang khad bse ru'i ming / /chur 'dres sa nyal rta yi dgra/ /ma da rnams ma te'i ming / /rdo yi sna can sa slog dang / /sa rko sa rlong mche ba can//sna ring spu long sgra ldan dang //mang skye spu rengs khab spu can//gtsang byed sa 'joms sa 'byed dang //ngur sgra can rnams phag pa'i ming //byi ba gsod dang byi ba za//byi la khrus mkhan g.yon can dang //bshang ba sbed pa zhum bu'i ming //rgyug mchong mchong byed ma rka ṭa//yal ga'i ri dwags gnyer ma'i gdong / /nags gnas nams ni spre'u ming / /'phrog byed sa lus rlung gi srog /mig mdzes bṛ ga nags su spyod/ /pags pa'i skye gnas ri dwags ming //ri dwags 'tshe dang ri dwags dpyod//ri khrod pa dang sha ba ri//rgya yi 'tsho ba rngon pa'i ming / /mkha' 'gro mkha' spyod mkha' la 'phur/ /'dab spyod bdab rkyang 'dab gshog can//mkhar nyal sgro ldan 'dab mas skyob//788

'dab ldan gshog ldan nam mkha'i rta/ /sgong skyes ga nyis skyes 'dab skyob dang //steng 'gro shing gnas me yi mgrin//yan lag drug pa sha ku ni//tshang skyes 'dab chags srid bu za//'dab ma'i shing rta bya spyi'i ming //dpyid kyi pho nya ngag snyan dang / /gzhan gyis gsos dang nags na bde/ /ku hu'i mgrin ldan ko ke la//'phrog byed gtam dang ku hu 'don//'dod pa'i pho nya sprang rtsi'i mgrin//dbyangs snyad ngag snyan sbrang rtsi'i dbyangs//sprang rtsi'i sgra ldad bya rog gsos//dpyid kyi dbyangs snyan khu byug ming //sa 'gro gar mkhan sprin gyi sgeg /mdongs ldan snyeg ldan mdongs mtha' yas/ /rna rgyan can dang sen mo'i gar/ /lag 'gro'i zas can mgrin sngon can/ /sprin la dga' dang 'brug sgra'i gar/ /ke ke'i sgra ldan mjug sgro can/ /gtsug phud can dang gtsug ldan dang / /legs bris sgro dang rtse mo can/ /blos gar mkhan rnams rma bya'i ming / /zangs kyi gtsug phud zangs ze can/ /byi ru'i skog shal bya gag can/ /rkang mtshon can dang ku klu ṭa/ /skad ring khyim gyi gtsug phud can/ /dus tshod smra dang nam tshod 'dzin/ /ku sku'i sgra sgrog khyim bya'i ming / /mar gad gshog pa mar gad 'dab/ /gshog ljang 'dab ljang sum phreng can/ /bya lho gnyis pa ne lha'i ming / /'khor lo'i yan lag rkang dmar dang / /sgra sgrog chur sgrog ma dros gnas/ /mkha' lding dkar po yul 'khor 'dzin/ /mgrin pa'i rdza rnga lus dkar dang / /'gros mdzes dal 'gros zhi 'gro can//sgra 'byin chen po ku ra ta//bya khyung dkar po mgrin rnga can//ston gyi dbyangs snyan ngang pa'i ming //bya khyung dmar po dbyangs snyan dang //ngur ba ngag gi 'khor lo dang //shing rta'i lus dang 'dod pa can//789

ko ka rnams ni ngang ser ming //chu sreg chu skyar ka dam pa//nya yi zas can skyar mo'i ming / /bzhad dang bya dkar sā ra ha/ /ha ha sgrog pa bzhad bya'i ming //kru rto mgrin ring khrung khrung ming //mthing ril chu bya nag mo'i ming //zla 'od zas can ku nud zas//ku nud bcud 'thung ku nud dga'//tsa ko ra ka'i ming yin no/ /char sdod bya dang chu nyung dang / /tsā ta ka rnams khug rta'i ming / /kā ka khā ta gtor mas rgyal/ /'chi med sgra ldan gzhan gso dang //sgra sgrog dang ni lan cig skyes//grong khyer spyod dang 'khrig pa sped//ka gnyis pa dang tsher ma'i tshang //gtor ma'i 'tshag ldan bya rog ming //sna ring hūṃ sgrog bya rog dgra/ /gos ser can dang mig ser can/ /nun pa'i mig can 'byung po'i bya/ /sram gyi mchod pa 'ug pa'i ming / /nyin mo yib dang nyi mas long / /mig sngon rnams ni srin bya'i ming / /g.yo chen pags 'dab pha wang ming //sgro dang gshog pa 'dab ma dang //'gebs byed lus skyes 'dab gshog ming //tshang rtsi can dang sgo nga skyong //tshang mal bya khyim bya tshang ming / /gnyis skyes sa bon sa rtse ka /srubs dang mdzod rnams sgo nga'i ming / /bya 'dzin bya skon skon pa dang / /rnyi dang bya rnyi bya rgya'i ming / /sprang rtsi'i zas can sbrang rtsi spyod/ /sbrang byed sprang rtsi'i brtul zhugs dang //bung ba rkang drug sbra ma ra//zadaḥ dang ni me tog 'thung //sbrang rtsi myong dang sbrang rtsi skyong / /ra yig gnyis pa me tog 'jug /me tog zas can me tog rtse/ /sbrang rtsi skyes rnams sbrang ma'i ming / /me tog rdul dang me tog bcud/ / mngar ba'i rdul dang sbrang ma'i zas/ /ge sar bcud dang sbrang chang dang / /me tog rtsi dang bung rtsi dang //rdul zhim bcud ldan sprang rtsi'i ming //'dus 790
