pa bkod pa yang dag 'dus/ /bsags pa rab bsags 'phung ba dang / /spungs pa tshogs dang yang dag tshogs/ /phung po don mthun sde dang dpung / /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor tshogs pa'i ming / /shed bdag skyes bu shed las skyes/ /yid skyes yid ldan ma nu'i bu/ /shes ldan sprin mgrin ta la'i rkang / /tshe ldan gang zag rkang gnyis ba/ /nus ldan rnams ni mi spyi'i ming / /mi pho lnga skyes skyes bu dang / /stobs ldan brtul phod mtshon cha can/ /skyong byed rnams ni skyes pa'i ming //mi mo sbyor byed stobs med dang / /'ching byed g.yo byed mtshams ldan ma/ /dga' ba'i sa gzhi g.yon ma dang / /na chung tsā dri'i skyes ba dman/ /nu ldan bud med spyi yi ming / /dpal mo yan lag mchog ldan ma/ /'jigs can 'dod ma g.yon mig ma//rab spyos snyeg mo yid 'ong ma/ /mdzes ma dga' ma dga' byed ma/ /smad rgyas ma dang khro med ma/ /rab skyes ma dang lus mchog ma/ /mtshan dang ldan pa sdug gu ma/ /rigs ldan ma dang bu mo deng / /lang tsho ma dang gzhon nu ma/ /bzhad ma dud med mchog gi ming / /bag ma lag pa 'dzin ma dang / /khyim 'dzin ma dang gnyed 'dun ma/ /'gog byed ma dang skyed byed ma/ /bden ma bdag po'i brtul zhugs ma/ /gnyen byas khyim gsar bag gsar dang / /rdul can ma dang rigs skyong ma—/ /khyim bdag ma dang khyem gnas ma/ /chos bcas ma dang dbang bskur ma/ /mchis brang dang ni rdul mthong ma/ /khyim bdag byan mo chung ma'i ming / /gzugs 'tshong sprul 'tshong 'jud mthun dang / — /g.yon ma 'phyon ma skra 'dres ma/ /'dod ldan ma dang chags ldan me/ /mo gsham 'dod 'gro rigs myur ma/ /grong khyer ma dang tsho gos tsand /'dzika skye 'as ma khyo mang ma/ /791

byi mo grong khyer spyod ma dang / /dus byas ma rnams smad 'tshong ming / /rdul ldan bud med chos ldan ma/ /rked nad can ma khyag ldan ma/ /dus ldan ma dang me tog can/ /rdul 'bab zla mtshan can ma'i ming / /mngal chags ma dang mngal ldan ma//phru gu chags dang mig blo langs//bu che bu chags lus mi bde/ /sprum ma du che ma yi ming / /btsas ma thag dang skyes ma thag /zho 'thung 'o 'thung nu ma 'dzin//khye'u byis pa byis bu dang //dus pa se'u can shed ma byed//pang gnas gog 'gros gzhon nu dang //rtsed mos 'tsho ba bu tsha'i ming / /shed ldan dar bab lang tsho dar/ /lang tsho bdo dang shed bdo dang //rtsal ldan 'tshag bzang yan lag rgyas//stobs ldan dregs ldan dar ma'i ming //smin dang yongs smin da tshod yol//lo yi khur can lo mang po//mgo skya 'dar ldan gnyer ma can//rgas pa 'khogs pa rnying ba can//'khar ba'i mdza' bo rgan po'i ming //yab dang yab rje bkur 'os dang //skyed po bslab ston gso ba po/ /skyed byed skrun byed pha yi ming / /yum dang ma ma 'byung byed ma//mchod sbyin 'don ma 'dzin ma dang //skye byed ma dang lus skyed ma/ /skyed ma skyong ma ma yi ming / /khyim thab gtan grogs bza' zla dang //bza' tshang bza' tsho steng zhal dang //khyo shugs gnyis sdebs bza' mi'i ming //sngon skyes rgan shos dang por skyes//gcen dang dral po phu bo'i ming / rjes skyes gting skyes phyi nas skyes/ /gzhon shos gcung po nu bo'i ming //sha med nyam chung rid pa dang //lus rid lus skems lus speg pa//keng rus lus can skems pa'i ming / /sha rgyas 'tshag ldan yan lag rgyas/ /lus sbom lto 'phyang gsus po che/ /gsus brjid can rnams tsho ba'i ming //792

bro dang bro 'tshal bro nad dang / /gdung ba zug rngu nyams mi bde/ /mnyel dang snyun dang snyung ba dar / /nad dang nad gzhi khams mi bde/ /mnar dang gcong nad dag kyi ming / /nad gso nad 'tsho gso dang dpyad/ /rtsi dang sman dang rkyen sman dang / /nad sel 'tsho byed yo ṣa dha/ /skyon shes tshe yi rig byed ma— /bde byed nad 'joms phan pa dang / /nad kyi gnyen po sman gyi tsang / /rig byed pa dang gso rigs 'dzin/ /lha rje tshe yi rig byed pa/ /'tsho byed 'tsho mdzad gso dpyad mkhan/ /gso dpyad pa rnams sman pa'i ming / /zla ba bdud rtsi thig le dang / /sa bon stobs ldan dbang por 'gro//ri bong 'dzin pa jig le'i ming / /khyab gnas mi pung ru ldi ra/ /rak+ta rma skyes rgyun ldan dang / /rab skyes lus skyes sha'i khu ba/ /rma las 'dzag pa khrag gi ming / /phung po tshogs pa 'dus pa dang / /gzugs po khog pa yan lag can/ /dbang po'i skye mched lus kyi ming / /rgyu byed 'gro byed 'dor byed dang / /yug pa bgrod byed rkang pa'i ming / /'jug byed gcod byed len pa dang / /glang po'i sna 'dra dpung pa'i 'dab/ /yal ga lnga pa sug pa dang / —/byed po sor ldan lag pa'i ming / /mgo stegs mgo 'dzin ri mo gsum/ /mgul ba mgrin pa dpal mgur mgur/ /dung ltar 'khyil ba ske yi ming / /yan lag dang po yan lag mchog /rus pa'i rgyal po skra 'dzin dang / /dbu dang mig 'dzin klad pa can/ /dung chen shi ra mgo yi ming / /slar skyes 'khyil ba yang phrin can/ /mgo spu mgo skyes mgo nyal dab / /thor to lhas ma ke sa ra/ /ral pa 'dor byed skra yi ming / /thor tshugs do ker skra cog dang / /ral pa'i cod pan thor cog ming / /lus skyes pa ma pa'i myu gu dang / /793

pags pa'i me tog ba spu'i ming / /lta byed mthong byed 'dren byed dang / /dbang po dwangs ma lha'i sgron me/ /gzigs byed khyab byed snang byed dang / /gsal byed tsakyu mig gi ming / /mig 'dzum zur mig yon por blta/ /khra mig gdong mig mig bgrad pa//smin bsdus smin 'khyog smin ma bsgyur//khro gnyer bzhin bsdus khro bas blta//mig gi rnam 'gyur so so'i ming //skra lo skra zhags lhas ma dang / /lan bu lan tshar bud med skra yi ming / /sgra 'dzin thos 'dzin sgra yi gnas/ /nyan byed thos byed sgra len dang //snyan dang kad rna ba'i ming / /sna bug dri len dri 'dzin dang / /dri skyong dri 'bab snom byed shangs/ /dri yi gnas rnams sna yi ming / /ro myong ro 'dzin ro can ljags/ /ro shes ro ma bdud rtsi 'dzag/bcud kyi ma rnams lce yi ming / /gcod byed ldad byed gnyis skyes dang / /rus pa'i me tog so yi ming / /smra byed za byed zhal dang gdong / /kha sgo ngag 'dod kha yi ming / /pho mtshan pho dbang liṅgā rtags/ /bde byed stsos byed lcags kyu dang / /spyos byed 'khri shing rdo rje dang / /dran pa'i ka ba pho rtags ming / /nyer gnas skye gnas gnyis dga'i khyim/ /bha ga pad+ma kak+ko la/ /dran pa'i khron pa 'khor ba'i lam/ /skye ba 'dzin dang mo dbang dang / /dga' ba'i bu ga mo mtshan ming / /brang skyes sta na ku tsa dang //'o 'dzid bcud 'dzin 'o ma 'dzag/logs skyes dkar 'dzin nu tog dpo //nu rgyas nu 'bur nu ma'i ming //'og sgo srin zhal srin po'i sgo//'phongs dang bshang lam rkub kyi ming / /bgo ba g.yogs ma gcer skyob dang / /gos bzang na bza' gos kyi ming / /rgyan cha rgyan cha'i legs byed dang / /mdzes ma mdzes rgyan rgyan gyi ming //ha ri tsan dan kha cher skyes//me 794

yi rtse mo ka du ma/ /bde byed 'thung byed yang dag 'khums/ /dri zhim lus dmar me ldan dang / /tshim byed dmar po gur gum ming / /srin gyi snying po gar bu dang //kha ba'i bye ma 'od dkar can/ /rdul gyi snying po zla ba'i thal//shing gi snying po ga bur ming / /ri dwags lte ba ri stags 'chang / /ri dwags rgyos byed dri yi thod/ /ri dwags rtsi dang sprul skrag byed/ /ka sdu ri rnams gla rtsi'i ming / /dmar po sprin skyes rgyal mnyes byed/ /thal ba'i snying po tsan+dan ser/ /dri zhim shing dang shin sha sa/ /nus ldan a ga ru yi ming / /ma la yar skyes dri'i snying po/ /tshad skyob tshad sel bsil ba'i dri//dri zhim dri yi snying po dang / /sprul gyi snying po bzang po'i dpal//tshim byed bsil byed gdung skyob dang / /dpal gyi dum du tsardo na ming / /mi dbang mi bdag mi skyong dang / /spyi bor dbang skur dpung las skyes/ /lha gcig dang ni jo bo dang / /sa srung 'dzin pa sa yi bdag /sa skyong sa bdag sa spyod dang //sa yi tshangs pa sa'i brgya byin/ /sa 'tsho gnam bskos skye dgu'i bdag /'jigs pa sel byed rgyal po'i ming / /bka' las gtogs dang bka' las dbang / /nang blon dbang blon zhang blon dang / /gros dbang can pa mdun na 'don/ /gtso bo sna chen kha lo pa/ /phyi bsang 'phrul blon blon po'i ming / /pho nya mngag ba bya ma rta/ /'phrin pa ci bgyi king ka ra/ gtam skyes khyer rnams bang chen ming / /'bangs dang mnga' 'bangs lha 'bangs dang / /bka' 'bangs mnga' zhabs mnga' 'og dang / /chab 'bangs chab 'og mngag gzhug bran//rtse rgod phyag brnyad 'khor g.yog ming //gnyis skye sngon skyes sa yi lha/ /tshangs pa'i bu noms bram ze'i ming //zhi ldan dul ldad 'dul khrims can//7954

nyer zhi sdom can dbang po sdom//brtul zhugs can dang tshangs spyod can//bslab ldan sdom brtson khrims ldan ming //dben pa gnas dang ri khrod pa//sgong ba pa dang rnal 'byor can//bya ba bral dang bya ba btang //yo byad nyung dang drang srong dang / /bsam gtan pa rnams sgom chen ming / /rig ldan rnam gsal nyes pa shes/ /blo bzang blo ldan blo chen dang / /blo gros chen po kun rig dang / /smra mkhas smra dbang smra yi rgyal/ /rtogs ldan dpyod ldan shes ldan dang / /thos mang thos ldan ba ta/ /mkhyen ldan mkhyen bzang mkhyen pa yangs/ /mkhyen rab can dang gnas lnga pa/ /bstan chos rig rnams mkhas pa'i ming / /brda sprod dbang po brda sprod pa/ /skad gnyis dbang phyug skad gnyis smra//'jig rten 'dul dang 'jig rten mig/mchan bu'i gnas 'dug sgyur byed dang / /zhus chen pa dang sngo ts+tsha dang / /legs sbyar smra ba smra mkhan ming / /tshig rgyan smra dang tshig rgyan mkhan/ /dbyangs can dga' byed dbyangs can ngag /dbyangs can mgrin par byas pa dang / /snyan tshig smra dang snyan ngag mkhan/ /rgyan mkhan snyan ngag smra ba'i ming / /dpung gi khyu mchog rtul phod dang / /dpung gi ru 'dren dgra las rgyal//rgyal byed 'phrog byed 'joms byed dang //pha rol gnon dang g.yul na brjid/ /thub dka' gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /khro ldan rtsal chen sgyu rtsal can//dpal chen gtum chen dpa' bo'i ming //mgo khebs tshem zhwa rmog zhwa dang / /rmog zhu lcags zhwa rmog gi ming / /lus skyob khrab dang ya lad dang / /lcags kyi bgo ba 'khrug gos dang //mtshon skyob ba go khrab ming //mda' 'phen mda' stan mda'i 'khrul 'khor/ /dha nu gnam ru gzhu yi ming sgro 796

ldan ring 'gro rtse mo can//drang 'gro mkha' 'gro myur 'gro dang //nyag phran nag phran 'begs byed dang / /sha ra gshog ldan mda' yi ming / /stobs ldan so ldan lag ldan dang / /mche ba gnyis pa mche ba cad/ /mang po skyong dang gnyis 'thung dang //dbyug 'dzin glang chen sa lud nyal//nags tshal dga' dang thig le can//khyu yi mgon dang khyu yi bdag/chang dregs po dang chang gis myos//gom tshugs kyis 'gro glang po'i ming //'dren byed chu 'thung myur 'gro dang //'gro mgyogs mgyogs 'gro rngog pa can//'gro byed bzhon pa rgya mtsho skyes/ /bang ldan cang shes gyi ling dang / /legs 'gro bzhon pa rnam par dul//skal ldan ldag rgyug par sig skyes//rgyab ldan bgrod byed rta yi ming / /ka na ka dang pu wad/ /gang gā skyes dang ri las skyes/ /mdog bzang zong mchog sa le spram/ /tshong 'dus 'grim dang dum brgya skyes/ /lcags mchog me yi sa bon dang //sa yi zla ba sa'i snying po//rid ched chen po gser gyi ming //de ltar mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 'chi med mdzod rtsa 'grel dang /sna tshogs gsal ba nu tig phreng ba sogs rgya gzhung dang / tshig gter rtsa 'grel dang /gser phreng rol pa la sogs bod gzhung rnams dang /gzhan yang bka' dang bstan chos ci rigs nas nyer mkho btus te/dpal sa'i steng gi mdzes rgyan gcig po lha 'jig rten dbang zug dgyes pa'i zhal ngor karma phrin las gnyis pas bris so// 797

mjug gi gtam/ bod kyi bcu phrag rig mdzod chen mo las bka' brgyud pa'i gsung rab pod nyi shu phyogs sgrig byas pa'i slob deb par skrun 'gro song yongs bsdoms sgor brgyad 'bum bdun khri bzhi stong tsam dgos par 'dugad sngon 'dzam gling rogs pa(ma0ya2ma)tshogs pa'i dbu khrid sa dkon rin po che sogs kyi rgyu sbyor dang rang dgon gyi mkhan po dpa' brtan gyi rogs ram la brten te2༷༷1lor pod2༷ 19 18 17 15 14 8 7 6 5pa bcas par spun legs 'grub byung yod/da dung slob deb cha tshang bar byed pa la pod bcu tsam par skrun thub med pas2༷༷2lor ma dkon rin po ches yang sgor sum khri/ zhang kang(chozachos ka1) nas sgor lnga khri/ dad ldan(mam11ma)nas sgor bzhi khri/ zur mang bya btang rin po ches sgor chig khri/ kaḥ thog drung pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan nam zla ba don 'grub rin po ches sgor chig khri/ dpal spungs phyag mdzod tshul khrims lags nas brnyan 'beb 'phrul chas gcig bcas kyi rogs pa gnang ba thugs rje dang bka' drin che zhu/sgad mar pod rjes ma rnams kyi par yon dang der ma zad nga tshos rig gzhung nyams gso tshogs pa zhes skye rgu mdor gsar 'dzugs byas nas bzung dpe dkon mang rab rnyed pa 'di dag par skrun 'grem spel dang / ma rnyed pa rnams slar yang 'tshol bsdu sogs mdor na bka' brgyud pa'i rig gzhung yig bshad lung gsum gyi rgyun nyams gso rnam dag cig byed dang byed mos yod pas/799

lo rgyal bstan bshad skrub tu ba cing chos 'byor stobs gsum ldan pa'i dam pa dang / rang rigs kyi rig gzhung la mthong rgya che ba'i shes yon can rnams dang / lhag blo gcig tu dkar ba'i dad 'byor gtong phod ldan /re/sbyo /) rjes byed rjed /) 11 /sgopa na bdag rnams sa nga gas par ra rgyab ra/ ma g.yar gnang / yig rgyun khyab spel gyi 'brel ba gang zab re mdzad par mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes rig gzhung nyams gso tshogs pa'i 'gad 'dzin skyo brag dam chos zla bas spyi lo20༷2lo'i zla3tshes5nyin bris/800

ji'i nus 'god ba/ lhun grub rdo rje mo/ /rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ bkra rgyal/ mdun shog ma rjes ris ba/ skar ma 'od gsal/ lha ris pa/ shug gu rdo lha/bar sgrig bar 'god ba/ la ha'i da /〈 bod kyi bcu zag rig mdzod chen mo / kas bka' brgyud pa'i gsung rab pod gnyis pa/snyan ngag dang mngon b.rad/ 'brug khams spul sogs kyis ma da/ mkhan po dam da za bas bsgrigs/bar spyan 'grem sgyum spel/ mtshod da mi gas dpe spud kang /(ji ming dang lo da rin ba sgo nga 10)snag ma 810001 kha par 6143426ba da 'tshob 1 mtsho sngon 'ing chen zhin hwa dpe khang /bar 'deb / kad su'u jid sgyu par khang /de b.rad/ 860ba 1168bab 1732dbar da ga 25 626gas bdag/ sbyo 62 bar bangs/ 2002 po'i zla1༷par bar gzhi dang po bsgrigs/dbar rjebs/ 2002 lo'i zla10par dpar thengs dang po dpar/dbar grabs/ 2 000 1shā rdo1di/ sgora~X 7che5420—0917—671 139 bar gzhi 'di gar dbab ba bar bshu brgya na khrims da dzag(shog ngos chad nor spog skyon gang rungs da par khang la dri gtug bya)
